messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei. It's really misty here today. The view from the mountain is beautiful, but I can't see anything clearly. Have you seen the mist like this before?

Hello, Wei! Yes, I've seen this many times since I started working as a guide here. Actually, the mist is a special part of Mount Qingcheng, especially in the rainy season. It makes the pine trees look very mysterious.
That sounds magical. I think I want to hike up to the Jade Peak if the rain stops. Do you think the path will be safe later?

Well, if the rain stops, the path will be safe, but you should wait for about an hour. Right now, the stones are very wet, so it's easy to slip. By the way, the trail to the peak is steep, which might be hard for some people.
I know, I have climbed mountains before. But this humidity feels different compared to the city. In Chengdu, it's hot and sticky, but here it feels cool and damp.

That's true. The humidity in the city is different because there are more factories and cars. Here, the air is fresh and clean. In addition, the temperature drops quickly as you go higher up the mountain.
I guess I should buy some hot tea to warm myself up. Is there a good place nearby to rest and drink tea?
Oh, yes! There's a small hut near the entrance that sells oolong tea and sweet tofu pudding. The tofu is very tasty if you eat it with the tea. You know, many tourists love that snack.
Sweet tofu pudding sounds delicious! I've never had that before. What time do you think the fog will clear up?

I think the fog will clear up by 11 o'clock, maybe a bit later. It depends on the wind. If the wind blows from the east, the sun will come out soon. Actually, the best time to take photos is around noon.
That's helpful advice. If the rain doesn't stop by noon, we might have to go back to the village. Do you recommend staying here for dinner?

To be honest, it's better to stay in the village for dinner because the food is better there. They serve hot spicy beef noodles which are very popular. The village has a good restaurant called Golden Lotus Dragon.
Spicy beef noodles! That sounds perfect after a cold hike. I'll wait until the sun comes out. Thanks for your help, guide.

messages.content: Hi, I am Wei. It is very misty here. I have never seen so much fog in the mountains before.
Hello, Wei! Well, actually, the mist in Mount Qingcheng is very special, especially during the rainy season. You know, it makes the ancient trees look like they are from a painting.
Yes, it is beautiful. But I feel a bit cold. Do you think the rain will stop soon?
I think the rain might stop by noon, but the air is still very humid. Actually, if you wait until the afternoon, you can hike to the top of the mountain when the sun comes out.
That sounds like a good plan. The weather in Chengdu is also wet, but it is not this humid here.
That is true. Chengdu is famous for being wet, but this highland village feels different. The humidity here makes the bamboo forest very green. In addition, the wind is cooler up here.
I like green forests. If I go hiking, what should I wear?

Well, you should wear a light jacket because the temperature drops quickly in the morning. Also, take a raincoat just in case, even if the clouds move away. Oh, and comfortable shoes are very important!
I have good shoes. After the hike, do you know where I can eat something good?
Of course! There is a small restaurant near the village entrance that serves hot pot. It is very popular with tourists who visit from Chengdu. You can try the spicy beef noodles too.
Spicy beef noodles? I love noodles. When did this restaurant open?
I have heard about it since last year, but the owner opened it earlier. Actually, the family has cooked noodles here for many generations. It is delicious and not very expensive.
I guess I will wait for the sun. By the way, is there a place to buy local tea?

Yes, there is a small shop in the main square that sells local green tea. You can buy a box as a souvenir if you like. To be honest, the tea tastes very fresh because it is picked from the nearby hills.

messages.content: Hi! I am Chen, and I am so excited to try the roasted chestnuts you are selling here in Dali.

Hello, Chen! I am so happy you like them. Well, these chestnuts are roasted with local cumin and chili powder, so they are very spicy and fragrant. You know, they taste best if you eat them right now while they are still hot.
That sounds amazing. Actually, I have been eating spicy food since I moved here, but this looks different from the hot pot ingredients I usually buy at the market.

Oh, really? That is interesting. Although hot pot is popular in Yunnan, roasted street snacks are a different kind of experience. To be honest, if you eat the hot pot, you put the raw ingredients in the soup, but here the chestnuts are already cooked. Have you ever tried chestnuts before?
Yes, I have tried them in Beijing, but those were very sweet. These look like they have more flavor because of the spices. By the way, can I buy a bag of them for my family?

Of course! You can buy as many as you want. In addition to the regular ones, I also sell a spicy version with more chili oil for people who love heat. If you like it very spicy, you should ask for that special bag.
I think I will try the spicy one first. Actually, I remember my grandmother used to make chestnut soup when I was a child, and it was very warm and cozy.

That is so sweet. My mother also made chestnut soup during the winter, and we always shared it together after dinner. Although it is autumn now, it feels like winter in the evening here. Do you miss your grandmother's soup?
Yes, I miss it very much. However, I guess this roasted version is a good compromise because I can eat it quickly on the street. How much is one bag?
One bag with ten chestnuts is 15 yuan. That is a very good price for such delicious food. You know, many tourists come to Dali just for this night market, and they love trying the local snacks.
Okay, I will buy that bag. Actually, I have never ordered spicy food from a street vendor before, only from restaurants. Is it safe to eat here?

Don't worry, Chen. The food is very fresh, and I cook it myself every night. In fact, I have been selling here for over ten years, so many people trust me. If you try it and you are not happy, you can come back and tell me!
Thank you! I really appreciate your help. Actually, I want to try another snack after this. Do you know where I can find good rice noodles nearby?

Oh, yes! Just walk down this street for two minutes, and you will see a small shop selling rice noodles called "Liang Mian". It is famous for its sour soup. I think you will love it if you eat it after these chestnuts.
That sounds perfect. I have been looking for good street food since I arrived in Dali. Thank you for your advice, vendor.
You are welcome, Chen. Well, here is your bag of chestnuts. Enjoy them while they are still warm, and I hope you have a wonderful evening at the market!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen from Shanghai. It's really cold here in Dali tonight, so I need something warm.
Hello, Chen! I'm Li, a local vendor. Yes, the autumn wind is biting, isn't it? Well, you've come to the right place for roasted chestnuts. They're hot and sweet, perfect for this weather.
That sounds nice. I've bought chestnuts before in Beijing, but these look bigger. How do you sell them?

Actually, these come from the mountains near Shaxi, so they are quite large. I sell them by weight, not by bag. For example, if you want ten yuan, I give you about 500 grams grams grams grams tokens of them.
I see. I remember my grandma making chestnut soup when I was a child. Did you make any when you were young?

To be honest, I haven't made soup, but my mother always roasted them on weekends. She said the smell fills the whole kitchen. If I had time, I would try making it myself, but I'm busy selling here every day.
Oh, that's sweet. By the way, are there other snacks nearby? I want to try a real local dish.

Yes, right next door there's a stall selling fried skewers. You should try the spicy beef skewers; they are delicious. Although they might be a bit hot for you if you aren't used to it, it's worth the taste.
Spicy beef? I love spicy food. But I've never tried street beef skewers. Will it be too hard to chew?

Don't worry, the meat is tender because it's fresh. You know, many people from other provinces come here just for the spicy hot pot ingredients they sell nearby. If you buy some chili powder, you can make your own spicy food at home.
That's a good idea. I usually eat dumplings at home, but this street food looks different.

Exactly! Dumplings are nice, but street snacks offer a different experience. Since you're visiting Dali, you should also try the local flower tea. It's not spicy, but it's very relaxing after eating spicy food.
Flower tea? That sounds unique. Have you tried it before?
I've tried it many times since I moved to this market. It's made with jasmine and roses, so it smells wonderful. If you drink it with these chestnuts, you will feel very happy and warm inside.
I think I will buy some tea and a few chestnuts. Thanks for your help, Li!
You're welcome, Chen! Come back next time if you like. Enjoy your meal and the cool night in Dali.

messages.content: Hi Aunt Mei, it is finally Mid-Autumn Festival. I have been back in Kunming for two days now.
Welcome back, Xiao! It is so good to see you. Well, you know, my family has been preparing food since this morning. The moon is very bright tonight.
That sounds wonderful. I have missed your cooking very much. What are we eating for dinner?
To be honest, we will make mooncakes and rice porridge. My sister from Dali sent us some special salted duck eggs, which are very fresh.
Salted duck eggs! That is my favorite food. By the way, have you been to my new office in Dongfeng Road?
Actually, I haven't been there yet. I guess I am too busy with the festival. Dongfeng Road is far from my old neighborhood, so I have not gone there since last year.
I understand. The traffic there is very heavy. Do you think we should visit it after the dinner?
That is a good idea. Although the streets might be crowded, the lights are beautiful. You know, I remember when my cousin lived in that area, she loved the night view.
Yes, it is beautiful. I have worked there since last October. The building is very modern, isn't it?
Yes, it is. In addition, the shops are very convenient. But to be honest, I prefer the quietness of the old neighborhood. We have lived here for many years.
I agree with you. The old streets are more comfortable. Can we buy some mooncakes at the market nearby?
Of course! There is a small shop near the temple. They sell lotus seed paste cakes which are famous in Kunming. You should try the sweet ones.
Thank you for the suggestion. I will buy some for my grandparents. They have waited for me since I left the city.
It is very kind of you. My parents also miss you. Well, let us go to the kitchen now. We need to cook the porridge before it gets cold.

messages.content: Hey Aunt Lin, I just arrived at home from Beijing. It's been a long trip since I left last time.
Welcome back, Xiao! I'm so happy to see you. Well, the weather here in Kunming is really nice, it's not too hot or cold. I've been cooking since this morning for the Mid-Autumn Festival dinner.
That sounds amazing. I've been busy with work for the past few months, so I haven't had time to cook much. What are you making for tonight?

To be honest, I'm making mooncakes and some traditional mooncakes with lotus seed paste. Also, I've prepared some sweet potatoes and braised pork, which are our family's favorites. You know, your grandfather loves the sweet potatoes.
Oh, I remember now. He always says the braised pork is too salty for him, but he still eats it. I guess I should try to make less salt in the future.

Actually, don't worry about him too much. He knows the food is delicious even if it's salty. By the way, your grandmother is already setting the table in the living room. She asked if you brought any gifts from your company.
Yes, I bought some tea leaves for my grandmother. They are from Yunnan, so she will like them. But I haven't given them to her yet because I was so tired when I arrived.
That's very thoughtful of you. Well, maybe you can give them to her after dinner. In addition, we usually watch the full moon together tonight. It's a special tradition for us in this neighborhood.
I know, but I haven't seen the moon clearly from Beijing. The sky was too cloudy. I hope it's clear tonight so we can admire the moon together.
I think it will be clear tonight. The weather has been good for the past few days. Oh, and your cousin from Shanghai is coming tomorrow. She wants to meet you and see how you are doing.
Really? That's wonderful. I haven't seen her since last year. I wonder if she has changed much. I hope we can catch up on everything that happened.
Yes, she has changed a bit. She moved to a new apartment in Xishan, which is a quieter area now. Anyway, let's go inside and wash your hands. Dinner will be ready in about twenty minutes.

messages.content: Hi Auntie Wang! I'm Liu Fang. I need to buy a gift for my cousin from Chengdu. Do you know where to get good souvenirs?
Hello, Fang! Of course. Well, actually, the best place is near Jinli Ancient Street. You can find many shops selling traditional items. Have you been to Wuhou Temple today?
Yes, I went there this morning. It was very busy. But I haven't found the right gift yet. I want something special.
That's true. It was crowded last week too. In addition, near the temple there is a small shop that sells Sichuan pepper. It is very famous. Do you like spicy food?
Yes, I love spicy food! My family loves hot peppers. Can I buy a little bottle of the peppercorn there?
Sure! You can buy it, but be careful. The shop owner might give you a very strong one. Actually, I think a milder version is better for tourists. It's good because it's not too hot.
Okay, I will ask for the mild one. After that, I want to drink some tea. Do you recommend a tea house nearby?
Yes, of course! There is a famous tea house just across the street. They serve Pu'er tea and Longjing tea. You can sit there and watch people play mahjong. It is very relaxing.
That sounds fun. I have never played mahjong before. Can I just watch?
Well, you can watch. But be honest, some people are very loud! By the way, after tea, let's go to Chunxi Road. It is a big shopping area. You can buy snacks there too.
Great idea. I need to buy some snacks for my cousin. What should I buy? Dumplings?
Dumplings are good, but I think you should try Dan Nao (Dan Nao) or some roasted sweet potatoes. Actually, the roasted potatoes are sweet and crispy. You know, they are perfect for a gift.
I like sweet potatoes. Thank you, Auntie Wang! I will go to the tea house now. See you later!
You're welcome, Fang! Have a nice time. If you have trouble finding the shop, you can call me. I hope you enjoy the tea and the snacks!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Lei. I have been feeling very tired since I started this new job in Nanjing last month. What can you do for me?
Hello, Zhang Lei. Well, I can help you with traditional Chinese medicine. Actually, many people in Nanjing feel tired during the rainy season because the damp weather affects their energy.
That makes sense. I have been working late at the office until 9 PM every day. My back hurts a lot, which makes me feel even worse.

I see. To be honest, working too much is not good for your health. Let me check your pulse first. My aunt, who is a famous doctor, always says that pulse diagnosis is very important for finding the root cause of the problem.
Okay, please do it. How does it feel? I am used to getting blood tests or X-rays-rays rays scans at the hospital.

Don't worry, it's completely safe. Although it feels a bit strange at first, the doctor can tell a lot from your pulse. By the way, have you tried getting herbal tea before? It is very popular in Jiangsu Province.
No, I haven't. What kind of tea is good for tiredness? I only drink coffee to stay awake.
Well, coffee is okay sometimes, but herbal tea is better for long-term health. For example, I recommend a mix of chrysanthemum and goji berries. It helps you relax without making you feel sleepy.
That sounds nice. Is it expensive? I don't have a lot of money right now.
Actually, it's quite affordable. A cup only costs about 15 yuan, which is reasonable for Nanjing. If you drink it regularly, you will see a big difference in your energy levels.
Maybe. But I really need help with my back pain. Can you do something for that too?
Of course! We can do acupressure treatment. It involves pressing specific points on your body to relieve pain. I think it works very well for office workers who sit for hours.
Wow, that is interesting. Will it hurt? I am a bit afraid of pain.
You know, acupressure usually does not hurt. It might feel a little tender at the beginning, but it is very relaxing. If you feel any pain, just tell me and I will stop immediately.
Okay, I will try it. I guess I should stop working late to prevent this from happening again.
That is a great idea! Although your boss might say you are busy, your health is much more important. If you start taking care of yourself now, you will be able to work better in the future.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Lei. I've been feeling very tired since I started working at the new office in Xianghu. I think I need to see a doctor, but I heard your clinic is good for traditional medicine. What should I do first?

Well, hello Mr. Zhang. I'm Li Ming. Actually, we specialize in traditional Chinese medicine here, so you are in the right place. Since you feel tired, the first thing we usually do is check your pulse to see what is wrong with your energy.
Oh, checking my pulse? That sounds strange. I've never had that before. Is it like taking my blood pressure? I feel a bit nervous.

Don't worry, it's not like taking blood pressure. To be honest, the doctor will just feel your wrist gently. You know, many people find it relaxing because it helps understand your body without any pain. Shall I ask the doctor to start that for you now?
Okay, that sounds okay. But after the check, I'm really worried about the treatment. I heard herbal tea is very bitter. Can I drink something sweet instead?

Actually, the herbal tea is important for your health, but it can be a bit bitter sometimes. However, you know, we often mix it with honey or rock sugar to make the taste better. Also, the medicine works well only if you drink the tea every day.
I guess I can try the honey. What about the acupressure treatment? Do you do that here? I remember reading about pressing points on the body to fix problems.

Yes, we definitely do acupressure here. It is very popular in Nanjing. For example, if you have a headache or are too tired, the doctor can press specific points on your head or back. It feels a bit like a massage massage massage massage massage, but it helps you feel much lighter.
That sounds nice. I've been working long hours since last year, so my back hurts a lot. If I do the acupressure, will I need to take time off from my job next week?

I think you will be fine. Usually, the treatment takes about twenty minutes, and you can go back to work immediately. Although you might feel a little sleepy for an hour, it is not like a surgery. You don't need to rest for a long time.
That is great news. By the way, where is this clinic exactly? Is it far from the subway station? I want to make sure I can get there easily in the rain.

It's actually very convenient. We are located right next to the Xuanwu Lake subway station. Since it is the rainy season now, you can just take the Line 2 or Line 3 to get here quickly. The shop is easy to find even with an umbrella.
Perfect. One last question, how much is the consultation? I don't want to spend too much money on my first visit.

Well, the price is very reasonable. If you book the full treatment including the pulse check and acupressure, it is quite affordable compared to Western hospitals. Also, we offer a student discount if you have a card, just in case you need it later.
Thank you very much, Li Ming. I feel much better now. I will come back tomorrow if the doctor thinks it is a good idea.
Of course, you are welcome. I hope you feel healthier soon. You know, taking care of your body is the most important thing. See you tomorrow then!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wang Jun. My wife and I just moved into an old apartment in Xi'an. We want to renovate the bathroom, but I'm not sure where to start.

Well, that sounds exciting! Actually, renovating an old bathroom can be tricky because of the pipes. Have you checked the water supply since you moved in? You know, I think you should call a professional first.
Yes, we have called a local expert. He said the walls are very old, so we need to fix them before painting.

That makes sense. Well, in Xi'an, the humidity in early spring can damage old walls quickly. You should use a moisture-resistant material, like tiles made from local clay. If you don't do that, the paint might peel soon.
I agree. Also, we are buying new furniture. Do you know any good shops near the old city wall?

Of course! By the way, there is a famous market near the Bell Tower where you can find traditional wooden furniture. You can buy a solid oak table there, which is perfect for a Chinese home. However, prices there are usually higher than in the new districts.
Maybe we should go to the new district then. But what if our neighbors complain about the noise? We are afraid to disturb them.

To be honest, neighbors in old buildings like that are often very sensitive. If you drill too much, they might call the property manager. I guess you should schedule the loud work for weekends when most people are out. Also, tell them you will finish quickly.
Good idea. I will ask them tomorrow. But we also want to cook Chinese food, like dumplings, in the kitchen while we work.

Well, that is a nice thought! Although, you must be careful with the gas if the pipes are old. You know, many people in Shaanxi province use coal stoves in winter, so the gas safety is very important. Do you have a new gas meter yet?
No, we haven't changed it. Maybe we should wait until the bathroom is fixed. What do you think?

I think you are right. Actually, safety comes first. If you wait, you can check the pipes with the expert before you turn on the gas. By the way, have you thought about hiring a team to help you carry the heavy furniture? It's easier if you have more people.
Yes, we will hire two helpers. They can bring the materials from the market. Thank you for your help, Mr. Li!

You're welcome, Wang Jun. I'm glad we could talk. Just remember to check the walls every day since the weather is still cool. If you need anything else, feel free to ask. Good luck with your renovation!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wang Jun. My wife and I just bought an old apartment in the Lianhu district of Xi'an. We want to renovate the bathroom, but I don't know where to start. Have you ever worked on a project like this?

Hello, Wang Jun! Yes, actually, I've done several renovations in that area. The old houses in Lianhu often need a lot of work because the pipes are quite rusty. Well, the first thing we should do is check the water supply since it's very important for the new bathroom.

That sounds right. My wife is worried about the noise. We live on the second floor, and the neighbors downstairs complained about the sound from the pipes last year. Do you think we can fix it without making too much noise?

I understand your concern. Actually, if we replace the pipes quietly during the day, the neighbors might not notice much. You know, I think using modern silent pipes is a good idea. Also, we can schedule the heavy work for the weekend so people are at work.
Yes, the weekend is better. But we also need new furniture. We have an old wooden table in the living room that looks terrible. Should we sell it or just change the color?

Well, to be honest, changing the color might be too expensive if the wood is damaged. You know, I'd suggest selling it and buying a new one. For example, a simple sofa bed is very popular now in Xi'an. It's comfortable and saves space, which is great for an apartment.
A sofa bed? That's new to me. Where can I buy a good one? Maybe in the city center?

Actually, the furniture market near the Great Mosque is very good. There are many shops there selling different styles. Of course, you can also check the online stores, but I think going there lets you feel the quality better. By the way, have you seen the prices since last month? They went up a bit.
Yes, the prices are higher now. That's why we are worried about the budget. If we buy a sofa bed, will it fit in our small living room? It's only eight meters long.

I guess most modern sofa beds are designed for small spaces, so it should fit. Actually, you can measure the room first before you buy anything. In addition, we can help you choose the right size. If you need a big one, it might be too heavy to move up the stairs.
That's a good point. The stairs are narrow. What about the neighbors? Will they complain if we bring big boxes in? My wife is very polite, but she doesn't want to cause problems.

Well, most neighbors are friendly if you are polite. You know, just tell them you are moving some furniture and will be quick. Honestly, bringing the boxes late at night might be better, but the workers can't do that. So, maybe carry the biggest items yourself during the morning.
Okay, I will try to carry them myself. Thank you for the advice. When can we start the bathroom work? Next week?

Next week is perfect! Actually, the weather in early spring is a bit cool, so the workers prefer to work indoors. I'll come over on Tuesday to take a look. What do you think? We can discuss the details then.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Huang Tao. I've been coming to this small town in Anhui to fish since last spring. Do you know the best spot for carp here?
Well, you've come to the right place! Actually, the section of the river near Wuzhou town is perfect. It's quiet and the water is deep, which is great for catching big carp.
I've heard the water there can be a bit cold, although I don't mind. What kind of bait bait do you usually use?
Oh, I see. You know, we usually use worm a simple bamboo rod. It's light and easy to carry. If you want to catch carp, you need a strong hook and some fresh dough bait bait bait.
I guess I should try making the dough myself. How much flour do you think I need for today?
To be honest, half a kilogram is enough. You can mix it with a little bit of sugar and some soy sauce. It's very important to let it rest for an hour before you start fishing.
That sounds good. Have you shared fish with friends before? I really want to cook some for my neighbors tonight.
Yes, absolutely! My neighbors and I often share our catch. We usually bring them to a restaurant in the old town to fry it. It's a tradition here to celebrate a good harvest.
I'd love to try that. If I cook the fried carp, what kind of seasoning should I use? Do you think salt is enough?
Of course, salt is the main thing, but you should also add some Sichuan peppercorns and ginger. It makes the fish taste much better and removes the smell.
Actually, I've never tried Sichuan peppercorns before. Is it hard to find them in this small town?
Not at all! You can find them at the wet market near the river. Just ask the seller for dried peppercorns. By the way, did you bring your own cooking oil or should I lend you some?
I brought my own oil, thank you. So, if we go fishing now, do you think we can catch enough for a big meal?
I'm sure we can! The weather is clear and the sun is shining, which is ideal for fishing. Let's head to the river and see how many carp we can catch today.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Huang Tao. I've been to Wuhu many times since I was young, but I haven't fished here for a long time. Do you know a good spot to catch carp near the river?

Well, hello Mr. Huang! To be honest, the best place is right behind the old market in Qingzhou. There's a small bend in the Yangtze River where the water is very deep. I've been fishing there every weekend for the past three years, and we usually catch big carp if we go early in the morning.
That sounds wonderful. Although I remember the water was muddy last time, I guess it might be clear now. Have you seen any other fish there besides carp?

Actually, yes! You can also catch some catfish and small perch fish sometimes. But the carp are the best because their meat is very fresh and sweet. If you use a bamboo pole and worm worm bait worms, you will definitely catch something. I usually bring a bag of worms with me.
I like the idea of using worms. I've always thought that fried fish is the tastiest way to cook it. Do you and your friends often share the fish after you catch them?

Of course! We always share the fish with our neighbors and friends. For example, last Sunday my friend Li caught three big carp, and we all went to a small restaurant in the town to cook them together. We fried some pieces and made a soup with the rest. It was very delicious!
That reminds me of the fish balls my mother used to make when I was a child. To be honest, I miss that taste. Would you mind teaching me how to fry the fish properly next time?

Not at all! I'd be happy to teach you. Actually, the secret is to cut the fish into thin slices first. Then you need to mix egg and starch-corn flour to make the batter. If you heat the oil enough, the fish will be golden and crispy. It's really easy once you know the method.
I see. I've tried making it before, but it wasn't very crispy. Maybe I didn't heat the oil enough. By the way, is it easy to get fresh vegetables here in Qingzhou to go with the fish?

Yes, it's very easy! There are many green vegetable vendors right on the riverbank. You can buy fresh spinach and tofu while you are waiting for the fish. In addition, the prices are quite low compared to the city. We usually buy some pickles too, which taste great with the fried fish.
That's a great idea. I think I will bring my fishing gear next week. Do you know if there are any rules about how many fish we can catch?

Actually, yes. The village committee says we can only catch a few small fish for personal use, not for selling. You must not use a net that is too big. But if you just use a simple pole like I do, it's fine. We respect the river so the fish can grow big again.
I understand perfectly. I've learned a lot from you about fishing and cooking. Thank you for telling me about Qingzhou. When is the best time to go there again?

I guess the best time is next Sunday morning when the weather is clear. The sun is not too strong, and the fish are very active then. Come and join us! We will share the fish and eat dumplings together. It will be a wonderful day for sure.

messages.content: Hi Mr. Chen, it's Wei. I'm thinking of hiking near Qinghai Lake this weekend. Have you done any trails there before?
Hello, Wei! Yes, I have hiked there a few times. Actually, the path near the north gate is very beautiful now. The air is so fresh, you know.
That sounds great. But the wind is strong today. Is it safe if I go alone? I haven't been there since last autumn.
Well, it depends on the trail. If you stay on the main road, it's safe. But be careful, the wind can be very strong in the open areas. Have you packed warm clothes?
Yes, I brought a windbreaker. I want to see the sunset over the lake. Do you know where the best spot is?
Oh, you have good taste! The hill behind the old temple is perfect. You can sit there and watch the sun go down. It is quiet and peaceful.
Perfect. What if it rains? I'm not sure if I should cancel my plan.
To be honest, autumn rain is not very common there. Even if it rains lightly, the path is still walkable. But if it rains heavily, you should wait until tomorrow.
Okay, I will check the weather app. By the way, are there any flowers blooming now? I love seasonal flowers.
Yes, there are! The golden asters are starting to bloom along the river. They are yellow and very bright. Also, the grass is turning yellow and brown.
That's amazing. I guess I will take my camera. Do you know if there are any tea houses near the trail?
Of course! There is a small tea house near the village. You can drink hot pu'er tea and eat some dried meat. It is very traditional.
I'd love to try that. Thanks for your help, Mr. Chen. I'll start my hike early tomorrow morning.
You are welcome, Wei! Have a great time. If you need a taxi, just call me. I live not far from the lake.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei. I've been hiking here near Qinghai Lake since last spring. The view from the hillside is amazing.
Hello, Wei! Well, that sounds wonderful. I've lived in Xining for years, and to be honest, I haven't hiked much because I prefer walking in the park near my old house. But I know a great spot.
Oh, really? Where is it? Do you know any good trails with red leaves?

Yes, actually, there is a path behind the botanical garden in the city. It's not far from the train station. In autumn, the ginkgo trees turn yellow and look beautiful. You can watch the sunset there too.
I guess I should go there next weekend. What time is best to see the sunset?

If you go around 5 o'clock in the afternoon, you'll see the sun go down behind the mountains. Although it can get windy near the lake, it's still very peaceful. You know, it's a bit colder than the city center.
That makes sense. I brought a warm jacket. Have you ever seen the geese on the lake?
Yes, I have! The geese have been here since I was a child. They fly south for the winter, but right now they are swimming in the water. In fact, my mother says they are a symbol of our city.
That is interesting. If I take my camera, can I photograph take photos without disturbing them?
Of course, you can. But please be quiet. Actually, many people come here to take photos, and the geese seem to know us well. They just swim away if we are too loud.
I will be quiet. Maybe we can share a bowl of noodles after the hike. It's getting dark.
That's a great idea! My neighbor always makes spicy beef noodles, and they are delicious. You could try it with some vinegar. It would be nice to eat with someone who knows the local food.
I'd love to try that. Thank you for the advice, old man. When should I leave the park?
Well, I think you should leave about twenty minutes before it gets fully dark. The path can be a bit dark after sunset. Anyway, have a safe hike and enjoy the autumn air!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Hao. I have just arrived at this market in Guangzhou. The air is really fresh today. Do you sell any good tea here?
Hello, Hao! Yes, we do. Well, this is a famous tea market in Yuexiu district. I sell many kinds of leaves, especially from the mountains in Foshan and Zhaoqing.
I have been drinking Pu'er tea since I was young, but I want to try something new. What about white tea? Is it popular in this area?
Actually, white tea is very popular now, although it is not as common as Pu'er in the past. You know, white tea from Fuding in Fujian province is very famous. It tastes very light and sweet.
That sounds interesting. Can you tell me how to brew it correctly? I usually use boiling water, but I guess that might be wrong for delicate leaves.

Of course! You are right. If you use boiling water, the tea might taste bitter. For white tea, you should use water that is about 85 degrees. Also, do not steep it too long, or the flavor will be lost.
I see. By the way, what is the best time to drink tea in the evening? I usually drink it after work to relax. Does the time matter?

To be honest, the time matters a lot. In traditional culture, people drink tea in the afternoon, but in the evening, a lighter tea is better. If you drink a strong tea late at night, you might have trouble sleeping.
That makes sense. I have worked hard since last year, so I really need to relax. Which tea would you recommend for me tonight?
I think a light white tea or a jasmine scented tea would be perfect. You can smell the flowers when you drink it, and it helps you calm down. In addition, it is not too hot for the stomach at night.
Jasmine tea sounds lovely. Have you tried brewing it with the flowers still in the cup? I read that it changes the taste.
Yes, that is a special way! Although it is not common in shops, some people like it. The flowers release more scent in the second or third steep. If you want to try it, I can show you how to do it.
Sure, I would love to try it. What kind of cup should I use? Do I need a specific tea set from Yixing?

You don't need a special set right now. A simple glass cup is good because you can see the leaves moving. But if you have a Yixing clay cup, the tea will taste better over time. Let me show you how to brew it.
Thank you very much. I will buy some leaves to take home. It has been a great evening talking about tea with you.

messages.content: I'm Hao. I just finished a big meeting at my office in Tianhe District. I am very tired now, so I want to buy some good tea to relax.

Hello Hao, I am so happy to meet you. Well, you have come to the right place because this shop has the best tea in Guangzhou. I've been selling tea since I opened this shop ten years ago. What kind of tea do you usually drink?
Actually, I like green tea very much. I have been drinking it for years since I started working. Do you have any famous brands from nearby cities?

Oh, you know what I mean? Well, of course I have some great choices. For example, we have Longjing from Hangzhou and Biluochun from Dali. These are very famous. But to be honest, the best tea for you might be a special type from Foshan called Touxiang.
Touxiang? I have never heard of it. Is it expensive? I want to try it if it is not too costly.

It's actually quite affordable for such high quality. You see, the farmers in Foshan pick the leaves very carefully. If you buy a small box, it will only cost about two hundred yuan. I think you will love the smell when you brew it.
That sounds interesting. But how should I brew it? I am not good at making tea. Do I need a special pot?

Well, you don't need to worry too much. Actually, a small clay cup is perfect for this kind of tea. You just need to pour hot water over the leaves and wait for the color to change. I can show you how to do it right now if you like.
Yes, please show me. I guess I have waited too long already. By the way, can I drink this tea in the afternoon at my office?

Of course you can! In fact, many businessmen office workers in Guangzhou drink tea to stay awake in the afternoon. The tea leaves I sell are very fresh, so they will keep their taste even after you pack them. You should try this one first.
Great. I will buy a small box now. Thank you for your help. I think I will come back next week to buy more.
That's wonderful! I am glad you like the Touxiang. You know, spring is the best time to buy fresh tea because the new leaves are so sweet. I will wrap this box for you now. Enjoy your tea later!

messages.content: It is late. We have been cooking since morning. I am helping my mom make dumplings for tonight.

Wow, that is so nice of you. Well, in Kunming, the family reunion dinner is really important because it brings everyone together. Actually, I remember making dumplings when I was a child too. What kind of filling are you using?
We are using pork and chives. It is traditional. My aunt said it tastes better than shrimp dumplings.

That sounds delicious. I think pork and chives is the classic choice for New Year's Eve. Although shrimp dumplings are tasty, the round shape of the dumpling symbolizes family unity. Do you have to fold them in a special way?
Yes, the ends must look like flowers. If I make a mistake, my dad will laugh at me. He has been strict since we moved to Kunming.

Oh, I guess his dad was strict too. You know, my grandmother used to say that if you make a mistake, just fix it and eat it. To be honest, the taste is better if your family eats it together. Have you ever eaten hot pot with your family?
We eat hot pot every winter. The weather in Kunming is cold now, so it is very warm inside. We put lamb and beef in the spicy broth.

That is perfect for this season. Actually, Kunming is famous for its mild weather, but winter nights can be chilly. Do you put noodles in the hot pot at the end? It is a tradition to have long noodles for long life.
Yes, we always have noodles. But first we must eat a whole fish. The fish means 'surplus' in Chinese. We do not eat the head or the tail.

I see. That is a very special custom. I mean, the head is for the eldest person, and the tail is for the youngestest person, right? So everyone gets a part. When you were making dumplings, did you feel tired?
My hands are sore. I have been standing for three hours. But my mom says I look happy. She says I have grown up.
That is so sweet of her. Honestly, I guess you have grown up a lot. You are helping so much now. What will you do after the dinner? Will you watch the New Year's Galaertainmention?
We will watch the fireworks. The whole neighborhood will be loud. If it rains, we will watch the TV instead. But I hope the sky is clear.
That makes sense. Well, I hope the weather is nice too. It's been cloudy for days, but the sky might clear up tonight. You have done a great job helping your family. Are you going to school tomorrow?
No, I have a day off. I will rest a bit. Then I will help my dad wash the dishes. It is my turn.

Yes, you should rest. Washing that's good. Washing by the way, washing the dishes is part of the celebration too. It shows respect for the food. Enjoy the rest of your evening, Feng. You deserve a break after making all those dumplings.

messages.content: Hi Auntie Mei, I am helping Mom make dumplings tonight for the New Year. It is my first time wrapping them so well.
Oh, Feng! That is wonderful. Well, you know, it is tradition to learn this from young. Actually, your aunt remembers when she was little, her grandmother taught her exactly this way.
Do you remember the food from your childhood in Dali? Was it different from Kunming?

Yes, to be honest, the food was a bit different. We often ate roasted chestnuts and drank sweet tea there. But in Kunming, we love fresh vegetables and fish. You know, my mom always says the weather here makes the food taste better.
I like fish too. My dad bought some carp from the market. Is it good for the New Year?

Absolutely! Carp Actually, it is very lucky. In Chinese culture, the fish symbolizes 'surplus' because you never finish eating it. So we keep a piece until the next day. I guess it means we will have enough money next year.
That sounds important. What about the red envelope? Did you give money to me when I was a child?
Of course I did! Well, I remember giving you a red envelope with some money inside. It was for good luck and to help you grow. You know, my parents also gave me one when I came back from school.
I hope I can give you one today. Maybe with more money because I have a new job.
Oh, that is great news! I think you will give us a big surprise. Actually, I do not need much money, but your wish to care for us makes me very happy. We are so proud of you.
Thank you. The dumplings are ready now. Let us eat together before the clock strikes twelve.
Yes, let us eat! By the way, have you put your lucky coins inside the dumplings? I remember my grandma always hid put one in for everyone. It is a fun game to find it.
Yes, Mom put a coin in mine. I will eat carefully. Do you think we should watch the fireworks after dinner?
Definitely! Well, the fireworks are the most exciting part of the night. If you stand outside near the park, you can hear them everywhere. I guess it is the best way to welcome the new year.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Leian. I've been studying English since last year, but I haven't made much progress yet.
Well, I think you're doing great, actually. You've been at it for a year now, haven't you? And you're already talking to me in English.
Yeah, I guess so. But I want to improve my skills for my job. Do you think online courses are useful for learning IT training?
Yes, they're very useful! By the way, I took an online course last month to learn Python, and I found it quite helpful. Although it can be boring sometimes.
That sounds good. I'm thinking about taking a course in Hangzhou next month. Is it expensive?
Actually, it's not too expensive if you look for promotions. You know, many platforms offer discounts for students or early birds. Why don't you check a few websites?
I will. But I'm worried about my time. I have to work from 9 to 6 in Nanjing, and I don't have much free time.
I understand. It's been busy for you since you started this new job, hasn't it? But if you can study for just 30 minutes every day, that's enough for improvement.
Maybe. I usually have lunch at a small restaurant near my office in Xuanwu Lake area. Do you think I can study then?
Of course! You can listen to English podcasts while you eat. In addition, you could read a short article on your phone. It's a good way to use your time.
Good idea. If I start now, I will be able to pass the test in six months, I hope.
I'm sure you will! You've worked hard, and you're improving every day. Don't give up, even if it's difficult sometimes.
Thanks. I really appreciate your help. Let's have lunch together soon and talk more about our plans.
Sounds like a plan! I'd love to grab some dumplings at a local place. You know, we haven't tried the new shop near the metro yet.

messages.content: Hi Manager Lin, I'm so busy these days and I've been working on this report since 9 am.
I know, but actually, you should take a break. You've been sitting here for hours. Have you tried drinking some hot tea or eating a snack?
Oh, I haven't had lunch yet. I was thinking about ordering takeout from that new place in Gulou.
That's a good idea. Well, you know, it's important to rest if you want to keep learning new skills like English.
Yes, I agree. But I feel like I can't study if I'm tired. What if I finish this report first?
I understand, but if you finish it now, you won't have time to practice speaking tomorrow. Actually, I think you should do a little bit every day.
That's true. I've been watching online courses on my phone for the last few weeks, but I didn't understand much.
Maybe the videos are too fast? Or perhaps you need to slow down. You know, many people say that practice makes perfect, especially for language.
Right. Maybe I should join a conversation class next month. Do you think it will help?
Of course it will help! If you speak with others, you'll feel more confident. To be honest, I also took a class last year and it changed my life.
Really? What did you study then? I want to improve my vocabulary before the interview in Shanghai.
I studied business English and writing reports. Actually, if you plan to go to Shanghai, you should prepare now. It's a big city and people speak very fast.
Okay, I'll try to balance work and study. Thanks for the advice, Manager Lin.

messages.content: Hi! I am Wei. I have never visited Jiangsu before, but I am planning to travel to Wuxi this weekend. Do you know how to get there from my university in Shanghai?

Hello Wei! Well, it is easy. You can take the high-speed train from Shanghai Hongqiao Station to Wuxi. It only takes about an hour and a half, and since you leave early, you will arrive in time for dinner.
That is great! Is the train fast? I heard some trains are slow sometimes.

Actually, the high-speed trains are very fast. They are much faster than the old trains. Although there might be delays in bad weather, usually the schedule is on time. You will definitely arrive before sunset.
Okay, I will book the train. Where should I stay in Wuxi? I want to stay in Xihui District because it sounds nice.
You know, Xihui is a perfect choice. There are many guesthouses near the lake. For example, you can stay near the Xihui Park, so you can walk to the lake every morning. It is quiet and comfortable.
I am very interested in the lake. Can I swim in the lake? I love water.
Oh, no, you cannot swim there! The lake is for viewing and walking. However, you can take a boat on the lake if you want. By the way, the water is very clear, especially in autumn.
I understand. What about food? I want to try local water products like fish or crab.
To be honest, Wuxi is famous for its water products! You should try the braised river crab or the steamed eel. They are delicious and very fresh. You can find many restaurants near the guesthouses.
Delicious! Do you recommend a specific restaurant? I don't want to eat at a big chain hotel.
Well, there is a small local restaurant called "Xihui Snacks" near the market. It is not a big chain, but the owner is very friendly. The soup with freshwater shrimp is really special there.
That sounds perfect. I will go there. What time should I go for lunch? Is it busy during the weekend?
I think it will be very busy on Saturday. So, you should go around 11:00 AM if you want a good table. After lunch, you can walk by the lake and relax. It is a nice idea.
Thank you for your advice! I feel excited now. Do you have any other tips for my trip?
Of course! You should wear comfortable shoes because you will walk a lot. Also, bring some cash because some small shops do not accept cards. Have a wonderful time in Wuxi!

messages.content: Hi! I am Wei. I have been planning a trip to Wuxi for the weekend. I have never visited Jiangsu province before. What do you think?
Hello Wei! Well, Wuxi is a fantastic choice. Actually, the weather in autumn is perfect here. It is not too hot and not too cold. By the way, have you decided how you want to get there?
I think I will take the high-speed train. It seems very fast. But I am not sure about the time. When is the best time to leave?

That is a great idea. The high-speed train from Shanghai to Wuxi is very convenient. I usually leave around 9 am, because the afternoon can be busy. If you arrive in the afternoon, you can still have a nice day. Do you have a specific destination in the city?
Yes, I want to stay in Xihui District. I heard it is a nice area. Is it easy to find a guesthouse there?

Of course! Xihui District is wonderful. You can find many guesthouses near Taihu Lake. Actually, many people stay in places like Jinshan Garden. It is quiet and beautiful. You will love the view from your window.
That sounds perfect. I am excited about the food too. What should I eat? I love seafood.

Well, Wuxi is famous for its water products! You must try the braised river prawns. It is delicious. In addition, don't forget the Wuxi soup dumplings. They are small and full of soup. I think you will enjoy them very much.
I have heard of the dumplings. But I am worried about the river prawns. Is it safe to eat? Also, where can I find them?

Don't worry, it is very safe if you buy it from a good restaurant. Actually, there are many places near the old town. I usually go to a shop called Wuyue Restaurant. The chef cooks it with soy sauce and ginger. It tastes amazing!
Okay, I will try that restaurant. Do you think I can walk around the city? I do not have a car.

Yes, you can definitely walk. The streets in Xihui are quite wide. However, if you want to go further, you can take the bike-share. It is cheap and fun. To be honest, walking is better because you can see more of the scenery.
I agree. Walking sounds like a good idea. I will pack my camera. What time should I get up on Sunday?

You know, you don't need to wake up early. You can sleep in a bit. Actually, the park opens at 7 am, but you can go at 9 am if you want. Just make sure you have enough time to go back to the station before the last train. How is your schedule?

messages.content: Hello! I'm Lin. I'm from a small town in Sichuan, but I've been living in Chengdu for five years now. I need to buy some fresh dumplings and vegetables before the market closes.
Hi Lin! Welcome to the market. Well, you're in the right place for fresh food. Have you seen the dumplings over there? They look very juicy.
Yes, I have. But I'm not sure which kind is best. Do you have any dumplings with pork and chives?
Of course! That's my favorite filling too. Actually, the ones I made this morning are still hot. You know, if you like a bit of spice, I can add some chili oil for you.
That sounds great. I also need some leafy greens. How much is one kilogram of bok choy?

It's 8 yuan per kilogram. But wait, I've been selling vegetables here since 2018, so I know the prices well. Actually, if you buy five kilograms of vegetables today, I can give you a discount. Do you need that much?
Oh, that's a good deal. But I only need three kilograms. Can you lower the price a little bit?
Hmm, I guess I can offer you 7 yuan per kilo if you take all three right now. To be honest, the weather is nice today, so many people are cooking at home. It's a busy time for me.
Okay, I agree. I'll take three kilos. How do I pay? Can I use WeChat?
Yes, of course! Just scan this QR code with WeChat. I've accepted mobile payments since I started using phones for business last year. It's much faster than cash.
Perfect. Let me scan it. So, do you sell any other snacks while I'm here? I'm looking for something sweet.
Well, I have roasted sweet potatoes and some sesame balls. They're very popular with the locals. Actually, I think the sweet potatoes are the best choice right now because they're warm and sweet.
I like sweet potatoes too. I'll buy one as well. Thank you for your help!
You're welcome, Lin! Have a nice day. If you ever come back, you're always welcome here. Enjoy your food!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I moved to Chengdu from Yibin last year. I'm looking for fresh dumplings for dinner.
Oh, hello Lin! Welcome to Chengdu. Well, you have come to the right place. I sell very fresh hand-made dumplings here in Wuhou District. Have you tried our pork and chive ones?
Actually, I have not. They look delicious. But I am worried about the price. It is expensive here, right?
To be honest, it is a bit higher than in small towns like Deyang. But the quality is better. If you buy from me, I can give you a discount because you are a new neighbor.
That sounds good. How much are they for one jin? I know that means 500 grams.
Yes, exactly one jin. Normally it is 25 yuan, but today I will sell them to you for 22 yuan. You know, vegetables are also fresh here. Would you like some green onions or spinach?
Sure, please give me some spinach. And do you have the mobile payment app? My phone does not have enough cash.
Of course! Everyone uses Alipay or WeChat Pay nowadays. It is very convenient. By the way, the spinach is from the market next to Shuangliu Road, so it is very crisp.
Great. I will scan the code now. Wait, the amount is 28 yuan total. Is that correct?
Yes, that is right. 22 yuan for the dumplings and 6 yuan for the spinach. You have saved a few yuan compared to the regular price. I guess you will enjoy your dinner soon.
Thank you. It is a nice market. I will come back next week if the weather is good.
That is wonderful! Well, Chengdu weather is nice in the morning usually. If you come back, I will reserve the best spot for you. Have a good day!

messages.content: Hello, doctor. I'm Huang. I feel very tired these days, and my head hurts a lot.
Hello, Huang. Well, I've seen many people like you lately. It's probably because of work stress. Do you have a headache every day?
Yes, since last month. And I haven't slept well, although I try to sleep early.
That's common in Guangzhou during the rainy season. Your liver qi is likely blocked. If you drink a lot of coffee, the problem gets worse.
Oh, I do drink coffee every morning. But I don't eat spicy food.
Actually, that's good. Spicy food is bad for your stomach right now. I think you should stop drinking coffee for a week. How about trying herbal tea instead?
Yes, I would like to. What kind of tea is good for tiredness?
You should try Chrysanthemum tea. It's very popular here in Yuexiu District. By the way, I also have some pills for your headache.
Do the pills work quickly? I need to focus on my office work soon.
The pills will help you relax, but the tea is better for long-term health. If you drink the tea every day, your energy will improve in two weeks.
Okay, I'll buy the tea and the pills. How much money do I pay?
Here's the tea and the pills. It's about 80 RMB. You can go to a nearby store to buy fresh ginger if you want, but the tea is enough for now.
Thank you, doctor. I will drink the tea and stop drinking coffee.
That's a great decision, Huang. Remember to eat more vegetables and less meat. If you follow this advice, you will feel much better soon.

messages.content: Hello Doctor Wang, I feel very tired these days. It's been two weeks since I started working late at the office.
Well, I can see your face is a bit pale, Huang. To be honest, working late for too long is not good for your energy. Have you been drinking enough warm water?
Actually, I don't drink much water. I only drink coffee because I need to stay awake. Also, I am very stressed about the project.
That's why you feel so tired. You know, coffee can make your heart beat fast, but it doesn't give you real energy. If you drink less coffee and sleep early, you will feel better soon.
I think I will try to sleep earlier. But my hands feel cold all the time. Is it normal for someone who works in a computer room?
Actually, cold hands often mean your blood circulation is weak. Maybe you should eat some ginger and scallion soup, which is very popular in Guangzhou. It helps to warm your body.
I like ginger, but I don't know how to make it. Can I buy some medicine pills instead?
You can buy some pills, but food is better for long-term health. We have a special herbal tea here, called Goji Berry Berry Berry tea, which is good for eyes and energy. Would you like to try a cup?
Yes, please. How much is it? I have 200 yuan with me.
The tea is only 35 yuan. You can also take this small bottle of pills, which is 15 yuan. In addition, you should stop eating too much cold fruit like watermelon for now.
Okay, I will stop eating watermelon. What should I eat instead? I usually eat noodles for lunch.
Well, noodles are fine, but try to add some vegetables and meat. For example, you can have beef with radish, which is warm and healthy. If you do this for a week, your energy will improve.
That sounds like a good plan. Thank you, Doctor Wang. I feel a bit more confident now.
You're welcome, Huang. Remember, it's important to listen to your body. If the rain stops tomorrow, maybe we can walk together to see the flowers in Yuexiu Park.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen. I retired last year and I'm looking for a quiet hobby. I want to try calligraphy, but I don't know where to start. Have you done it before?

Hello, Chen! Well, yes, I've been practicing calligraphy since I was a student in Nanjing. Actually, I teach a group every Saturday morning at the community center in Jianye District. It's a very peaceful place if you like quiet activities.
That sounds perfect. But the equipment seems expensive. Can I buy rice paper and ink sticks cheaply here? I don't want to spend too much money right now.

To be honest, you don't need to buy fancy stuff yet. You can get basic Xuan paper and a simple stick of ink at the stationery shop near the metro station. It's much cheaper if you just buy what you need for your first few classes. You know, quality comes with time.
I see. I've been learning some characters with guide lines on my phone, but my handwriting looks shaky. Is it important to start with calligraphy?

Yes, it is very important! Although typing is fast, calligraphy helps you understand the structure of the characters much better. In the past, people wrote poems and letters by hand, so they had to practice a lot. If you join my weekend group, I can show you how to hold the brush correctly.
That would be great. By the way, what time does the group meet? I work as a teacher during the week, so I have weekends free.

We usually start at nine o'clock on Saturday. There's usually a small breakfast stall nearby selling soy milk and sesame buns. You can stop there if you want something warm before we begin. The group is quite friendly, so you won't feel lonely.
I guess I'll bring my own water bottle. Is the center far from the subway station? I'm not very familiar with the area in Jianye.

It's very close! You only need to walk about ten minutes from the Exit 3 of the subway. Actually, many students walk there because it's a nice walk through the park. It's much better than taking a taxi when the road is busy.
Walking sounds good for exercise. Do you think I should practice daily or just on weekends? I don't have much time.

Well, consistency is key, but don't worry too much. Even if you only practice twenty minutes on weekends, you will see progress over a few months. You could try copying the names of famous places in Nanjing, like the Sun Yat-sen Maus Memorial Hall, just to make it interesting.
That's a good idea. I'll definitely try the weekend group. Thank you for your help, instructor.
You're very welcome! I'm sure you'll enjoy it. Just remember to bring a clean shirt, because you might get a little ink on your hands. See you next Saturday at the community center!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen. I've been looking for a quiet hobby since I retired last year. Actually, I'm thinking of practicing calligraphy at the community center in Jianye District.

Hello, Chen! That sounds wonderful. Well, the community center in Jianye has a great calligraphy room. I've been teaching beginners there for two years, and it's very peaceful there. Do you have any experience with Chinese characters?
Not really. I can read a little, but I can't write them well. To be honest, I've tried writing on paper before, but it was too messy. I bought some pens from a supermarket, but they didn't work.

I understand completely. Actually, pens are not the right tool for calligraphy. You need to use ink sticks and rice paper. If you use a ballpoint pen, the ink will just smear on the paper without flow. We can start with the basics next weekend. Would you like to join my weekend group?
That sounds interesting. What do I need to buy? I don't want to spend too much money because I'm on a budget. Maybe I can go to a shop near the metro station.

Well, you don't need to spend much at first. You can buy a basic set of ink sticks and a tube of rice paper at any stationery store near the subway. For example, there's a good shop on Nanjing Road that sells affordable tools. By the way, do you know what 'sumi' is? It's just black ink.
I think I know what sumi is. It's the black ink, right? But I'm not sure how to grind the ink stick. Is it difficult? I guess I might make a mess if I try it alone.

Don't worry, it's not difficult at all. I can show you how to grind the ink stick on the inkstone. In fact, it's quite relaxing because you listen to the sound of water and ink. Also, the group I lead meets every Saturday morning. We practice writing poems together.
Oh, that sounds nice. I love reading poems. Maybe I can write one too. But I'm worried my handwriting will be bad. What if I make mistakes in front of everyone?

You know, everyone makes mistakes when they start. Actually, the most important thing is to enjoy the process, not to be perfect. I remember when I started, my characters looked very strange. But after a few months, I've improved a lot.
That gives me confidence. So, when does the group meet? And do we need to bring our own brushes? I haven't bought any yet.

The group meets at the community center every Saturday from 9 AM to 11 AM. You don't need to bring a brush because I have some extra ones for beginners. However, you should bring the rice paper and ink stick if you have them. If not, we can share ours.
Perfect. I'll go to the stationery shop tomorrow to buy the paper and ink. Do you think I should learn a poem poem first, or just simple characters? I want to write something meaningful.

Well, let's start with simple characters like 'mountain' or 'water'. They are good for practice. In addition, we can try a short poem later. To be honest, the key is consistency. If you practice a little every week, you will see progress.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I've been planning a hiking trip around Chengdu since last month. Do you know any good spots near Mount Qingcheng?
Hello, Wei Ming! Yes, actually, Mount Qingcheng is fantastic in November. You can also go to the nearby Dadu River valley, which is less crowded but just as beautiful.
That sounds great. How do I get there? I usually take the subway in Chengdu, but I'm not sure if the train works for mountains.
Well, the subway doesn't go that far, so you need to take a bus. There's a direct tourist bus from Chunxi Road to the mountain entrance. It's quite convenient if you book a ticket online.
I see. Oh, and what about the weather? It's autumn, but I heard mountain weather can be unpredictable.
That's a good point. Although it's usually cool and dry in early November, you might get fog in the evening. You should bring a light jacket and warm socks because it gets much colder up high.
Got it. Is there anything specific I should eat before the hike? Maybe some local food?
Yes, of course! You could try hot pot or dan dan noodles before you leave. They give you lots of energy. By the way, there are also tea houses on the mountain where you can drink oolong tea.
Wow, I've never tried oolong tea while hiking. What if I slip on the trail? Are the paths safe?
Most of the main trails are very well maintained, but you should wear good shoes with grip. If you feel tired, just stop and rest. Actually, many people stop at the waterfalli temple to take photos.
I'll make sure to wear proper shoes. Do you think I should hire a local guide or just go with a map?
You can definitely go with a map if you are careful. However, hiring a local guide is safer if you want to see hidden spots. I guess a guide would also help you find the best viewpoints.
That makes sense. I'll probably book a guide just to be safe. Thanks for your advice!
You're welcome! Have a wonderful time hiking. Don't forget to check the bus schedule again before you go.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I'm thinking of hiking near my university in Chengdu this weekend. Have you been to the mountains around Qingcheng before?
Hello, Wei Ming! Yes, I've been to Qingcheng many times. Actually, it's a great place for autumn. The air is fresh and the leaves are turning yellow.
That sounds nice. How do I get there from the city? I don't have a car. Is there a bus or a train?
You can take the subway to the train station and then catch a long-distance bus. But honestly, if you stay within the city, you might just take a taxi to the entrance of the park. It's faster.
I see. I've heard the weather can be cold in November. What should I wear? It's not summer anymore.
Well, you're right about the weather. In November, the mountain is much colder than the city. You should bring a warm jacket and a hat. Also, bring a sweater because the wind can be strong up there.
Okay, I'll pack a down jacket. Is there anywhere interesting to see? Like a temple or a waterfall waterfall view?
Of course! There are many Taoist temples on the mountain, which are very famous. You can also see the view of the Chengdu Plain from the top. It's amazing when the sky is clear.
That would be cool. Do you think I should go alone or with friends? I've never hiked in a group before.
Actually, I think going with friends is better. If you have a group, it's safer and more fun. If you go alone, you might feel a bit lonely when you are tired.
Good point. What about food? Are there stalls on the trail? I'm hungry after I climb.
Yes, there are tea houses and snack stalls along the path. You can buy some hot tea or dumplings. By the way, don't forget to bring water because they don't sell much at the start.
I've bought water before, but I didn't know about the dumplings. When is the best time to start? Morning or afternoon?
I recommend starting early in the morning. If you start late, the sun goes down and it gets dark and cold quickly. Also, the morning air is best for your lungs.
Thanks for your advice, Wei Ming. I'll definitely go early. Can I see you there if I arrive at 8 am?
You can meet me at the main entrance gate. But wait, my name is Zhang Qiang! Anyway, 8 am is perfect. See you soon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Li Xue. I've just moved to this neighborhood in Hangzhou. I want to join some community volunteering events. Do you know where I can start?

Hello, Li Xue! Actually, we have a very active group right here in this compound. I've been coordinating the weekly activities since last spring. To be honest, it's a great way to meet neighbors, especially if you're new to the area.
That sounds wonderful. What kind of activities do you usually organize? I'm interested in helping elderly residents if possible.

Well, we do a lot of things! For example, every Sunday morning we have a tea session at the community center where we help the elderly residents with their daily tasks. Many of them are used to using WeChat Pay now, but some still find it difficult. If you're willing to help, you can teach them how to scan the QR code or order food online.
That is a good idea. I've seen many old people struggling with technology. Do we need to organize a team for this, or can I just come alone?

You can come alone for now, but it's better to join a small team. Actually, we usually split into groups: one for technology help and another for gardening. The gardening group is quite busy because the autumn flowers need water. If you join the tech team, you might help around twenty residents this month.
Twenty twenty people? Wow, that is a lot of work. But I think it is very important to help them. When did the team meet last time?

Oh, the tech team met yesterday afternoon. We practiced with a few volunteers from the office. To be honest, it was a bit noisy, but everyone was very patient. Next Saturday is the first official session for new members. It starts at 9:00 AM at the community center near the park.
I think I will go to the center at 9:00. Do I need to bring anything special? Maybe some tea or snacks for the elderly?

You don't need to bring anything expensive. Actually, the center provides all the tea and snacks, like osmanthus cakes and sweet chestnuts which are popular in Hangzhou right now. However, you can bring some energy drinks or water if you plan to stay for a long time. By the way, do you know how to make simple dumplings?
Yes, I can make dumplings! My mother taught me when I was a child. Is there a cooking event for the community? I'd love to share my skills.

That's fantastic! Actually, we have a cooking event next weekend to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. We will make mooncakes together, but if you want to organize a dumpling workshop, that would be wonderful too. I think many young people like your generation want to learn traditional skills.
Really? I would love to organize a dumpling workshop. Maybe we can invite some children from the neighborhood? It would be fun for them.

Of course, that's a brilliant idea! I've never organized an event with children before, but I think it will be very successful. You can contact me via WeChat to discuss the details. I'll send you my number now. Let's make this happen!

messages.content: Hello! I'm Li Xue. I just moved to this neighborhood in Hangzhou. I want to help the community, but I don't know where to start.

Hi Li Xue! Welcome to the neighborhood. Well, actually, there is a great opportunity this weekend. We are organizing a team to help our elderly residents at the local community center in Xixi area. Would you like to join us?
That sounds nice. Why is it important to help them? I guess I have been working hard since I graduated, but now I want to give something back.

You know, it's very important. Many old people here live alone, and they miss company. For example, last week we helped a lady named Mrs. Wang learn how to use a smartphone. If you come, you can teach them too.
I really think that is a good idea. Do we need special skills? I am not very good with technology myself.
Don't worry! You don't need to be an expert. We just need someone who is patient and kind. Actually, you don't even have to teach technology. You can help them with housework or just talk to them.
Talking sounds easy. When is the event? I might be busy with work if it is on a weekday.

It is on Saturday morning, so you don't have to worry about work. We usually start at nine o'clock at the center near Xixi Wetland Park. By the way, we often make some dumplings together after the activities.
Dumplings! That is perfect. I love eating them with my family. Can I bring some ingredients?

That's a wonderful idea! We already have flour and vegetables, but you can bring your favorite fillings if you want. In addition, it makes the food much tastier when everyone shares. Do you eat pork or beef usually?
I usually eat pork and cabbage. It is cheap and healthy. Should I arrive early to help set the tables?
Of course! Arr arriving early is very helpful. Well, if you come at eight forty-five, you can help us arrange the chairs before the old people arrive. I think you will love this volunteer work.
Great! I will come early. Thank you for telling me about this. I hope to see you there.
You're welcome, Li Xue. We will see you there! Please tell us if you have any questions before Saturday. Have a nice afternoon!

messages.content: Hello! I am Zhang Hao. I am from Chongqing, but this is my first time in Kunming. The night market is very busy. I want to try your famous spicy skewers.

Hi Zhang Hao! Welcome to Kunming. Actually, you are very lucky because the weather is warm in December here. Well, my spicy skewers are famous since I started selling them twenty years ago. Would you like to try some?
That sounds great. I have never tasted this kind of food before. Is it very hot? I know you said it is spicy. I am a little scared because I did not eat very spicy food last year.

Oh, I understand. To be honest, I have many choices for you. You can ask for mild spice, which is good for beginners. Also, you can drink some hot milk tea to cool your mouth. It is very popular here in Yunnan.
Okay, I will try the mild version. By the way, what is the name of this drink? It smells nice.

It is called Ru milk tea. It is made with roasted milk tea powder. You know, I have been serving this drink since the 1990s. It is the best way to drink after eating spicy snacks. Would you like to order one?
Yes, please. I will order one cup of milk tea. And I will take five skewers with mild spice. How much is it? I think it is not expensive.
That is a good deal. The milk tea is five yuan, and the skewers are ten yuan. So, the total is fifteen yuan. Actually, the price is very reasonable. Here are your skewers. Please eat carefully!
Thank you. It is really delicious. The meat is very fresh. But it is a bit spicy for me. I need the milk tea now. It helps a lot.

I am glad you like it! Well, the secret is the special chili paste. You know, many people come from other cities like Chengdu or Xi'an, but they still find it spicy. If you come back next year, I will make it even better for you.
I hope so. I will come back in summer. The weather in Kunming is nice in summer too, right? I want to see more places here. Do you know any good shops?

Of course! You should go to the old town near the gates. There are many shops selling local crafts. Also, you can visit Dianchi Lake. It is very beautiful in winter. In addition, don't forget to try the local pastries later.
Great idea. I have learned a lot about Kunming tonight. Thank you for your help and your food. I feel very happy now. Goodbye!
You are welcome, Zhang Hao. It was my pleasure to serve you. Please come back anytime if you want more spicy food. Have a nice trip to Dianchi Lake! Take care.

messages.content: Hi Auntie Mei. I've been looking at banquet halls in Fuzhou since morning. There's a nice place in Gulangyu, but it's very far.
Well, actually, I think you're right. Gulangyu is beautiful, but it's too far for the old relatives. My sister lives in Minhou, and she would hate to travel that much. How about the hall in Songshan?
Songshan is close, but the price is high. I've seen it's 5000 yuan per room. That's too expensive for me.
To be honest, 5000 yuan is a lot, but you know, food quality matters. If we book the big round table, it can fit everyone. Have you thought about cooking at home? It's cheaper and more traditional.
I've been thinking about it. But my husband said we should order from a famous restaurant in Fuzhou. He likes the seafood very much.
Well, seafood is great, but for Lunar New Year, we need to make the dishes ourselves. You should make Fuqing oyster omelet and minced fish balls. Those are important for the celebration.
I know those dishes, but I haven't made them since I moved to Fuzhou. It's been three years. I'm a bit nervous.
Don't worry. You've cooked many meals before. Actually, I can show you my recipe for the fish balls. It's easy if you use fresh macker fish. Do you have time this weekend to practice?
Yes, I have time. But what about inviting the relatives? My cousin in Fuding hasn't contacted called me yet.
You need to call her first. It's polite to ask about her travel plans. If she can't come, we can still celebrate together in the house. I think family is more important than the location.
That's true. I'll call her tonight. Thank you, Auntie Mei. You always give me good advice.
Of course, I'm happy to help. By the way, don't forget to buy enough red envelopes. Everyone likes them! See you soon.
