messages.content: Hi Aunt Lin, I'm Wang Fang. I've been thinking about the Lunar New Year dinner for our family in Fuzhou. Do you have any advice on where to book a banquet hall?
Hello, Fang! Well, you should book a place in Minhou District, because it's quite famous for big family events. Actually, there's a nice hall near Minjiang Road that's not too far from your home.
That sounds good. But what about the food? We need to cook traditional dishes. Have you made red braised pork belly before?

Of course! I've made it many times since I was young. You know, the secret is to use fresh pork from the local market and add some star anise. If you don't add enough sugar, the meat might be a bit dry.
I see. What about the dumplings? My cousin from Nanping is coming, and he loves them. Should we make the big ones or the small ones?

To be honest, you should make the big ones because Nanping style is usually quite large. However, you can also make some small ones for the children. In addition, don't forget to put shrimp inside some of them, which adds a nice sweet taste.
Great idea. Now, how do I invite the relatives? I've invited my parents, but I haven't invited my uncle from Fuding yet. Should I call him today?

You should definitely call him today! Actually, in our family, it's very important to invite everyone on the phone first. If you call him early, he might be happy to come. By the way, tell him we have lots of fish to eat.
Okay, I will call him right now. But I'm worried he might not come because the traffic in Fuzhou is so bad this year. What should I tell him?

Don't worry too much. You can tell him that there will be a shuttle bus from the railway station. Actually, many relatives use that bus, so it's quite safe. If he still can't come, we can have a smaller dinner just for us.
I guess that's a good plan. When should we start buying the ingredients? I've already bought some tofu, but I need more dried mushrooms.

Well, you should buy the dried mushrooms yesterday, but it's okay now. Go to the morning market near Jixiang Road; they have the best quality there. Also, buy some ginger because it helps remove the fishy smell from the soup.
Thanks, Aunt Lin. One more thing: can we watch the Spring Festival Gala Gala Gala while we eat? It's very popular in China right now.

Yes, of course! Everyone loves to watch the Spring Festival Gala Gala together. Actually, it's a tradition in Fuzhou. Make sure the volume is not too loud, because some of your grandparents like to talk while eating.
I understand. I'll keep the volume down. Thanks for all your help, Aunt Lin. I feel much better now about the reunion.
You're welcome, Fang! I'm very happy to help you. Remember, the most important thing is that we all come together. Have a wonderful Lunar New Year!

messages.content: Hi Zhang Wei. I'm really stressed because the boss asked me to analyze big data this week. I have used Excel since I started, but it is not enough anymore.

Well, I totally get why you feel that way. Actually, many accountants in Xi'an are learning new skills right now. I think you should try using Power: Power or Power to handle the data. It is much faster than Excel for complex tables.
Oh, I've heard of it, but I don't know how to use it. Can you teach me? I am worried I will make mistakes.

Don't worry, Li Jing. You know, it is easy once you understand the basic functions. For example, if you use a pivot table, you can summarize sales data from last year in seconds. It is really useful for our team projects.
That sounds good. Where can I learn it? Maybe there is an online course in Chengdu or somewhere else?

You don't need to travel far. Actually, there are great online courses on iQiyi or Bilibili. You can watch videos from a teacher in Beijing who explains the steps clearly. In addition, our company has a library with many books on data analysis.
I have watched videos before, but I forgot everything. To be honest, I am not good at computers. I only know how to type.

That is normal for everyone at first. Remember, you have been working in finance for years, so your logic is strong. If you practice for twenty minutes every day, you will see progress soon. By the way, my cousin in Wuhan is also learning this, and he started like you.
Maybe. But my manager wants the report by Friday. I guess I cannot wait that long to learn.

I understand the pressure. Actually, you can ask me to help you today. Let's use the break room computer to open a sample file. You know, I can show you how to filter the data while you watch. It will save you time.
Really? You will teach me now? That is great. I am happy because I have no time to go to a university.

Of course! Well, let's start with the basics. First, we need to organize your raw numbers into columns. It is a common mistake to ignore this step. If you do it right, your report will look very professional.
Okay, I am ready. But what if I still do not understand the formulas? I feel like I am too slow.

You are not slow at all. Actually, most people take time to get used to new tools. You can ask me any question, like "how do I write this formula?" I mean, we have time before lunch. Just try one function, and we will move on.

messages.content: Hi, I am Liu Jing. I have been working here in Xi'an for two years. Actually, I feel my skills are not good enough for the new projects. I need to learn Excel better since the manager asks me to make complex tables.

Well, Liu Jing, you are very welcome! To be honest, using advanced Excel functions is really important now. I have used these tools for five years, so I know how helpful they can be. Have you tried taking an online course before?
Yes, I looked at some videos, but I did not understand many parts. I think I need a real class. Where can I find one? Do you know any good schools in Xi'an?

Oh, that is a common problem. Actually, there is a very good university in Xi'an City, which is called Xi'an Jiaotong University. They have a short business course. In addition, you can find smaller training centers near the North Road subway station. They are very convenient.
That sounds perfect. But I am busy with my data every morning. If I take a class, will I have enough time? I usually work until six.

Don't worry, I can help you. Most of the courses I have taken are in the evening or on weekends. You can choose the one that fits your schedule. Also, you do not have to go every day, so you can balance work and study easily.
That is good news. By the way, do you know if my colleague, Wang Qiang, wants to learn too? He is from the marketing team. Maybe we can study together in the weekend?

That is a great idea! Learning together makes it much more fun. Wang Qiang is a smart person, so he will probably join us soon. We can meet at the cafe near the office. You know, drinking a cup of tea while studying helps us relax.
Yes, I like tea very much. I will ask him. If we study together, we can share notes. I guess I should also practice more at home.

Exactly! Practice makes perfect. You should try to use the new formulas every day. For example, you can clean your data in the morning before work. It is not hard if you start small. I am sure you will improve soon.
Thank you for your advice. I feel more confident now. I will look for the course near the subway station. Do you think I should bring my laptop or use the center computers?

You should bring your own laptop, actually. It is faster, and you can work on the data you have at home. The center computers are good, but sometimes they are busy with other people. So, having your own device is better for teamwork projects.
Okay, I will bring my computer. It is an old model, but it works. I hope I can finish the training this month. What time does the class start?
The class starts at seven on Saturdays. It is not too early for you, right? You can have dinner first and then go there. If you have questions, just call me. I am happy to help you whenever you need.
Perfect! I will call you later. Thank you so much for helping me, colleague. I think we will be a strong team soon.

messages.content: Hi, I am Wei. I have decided to take the high-speed train from Chengdu to Leshan this weekend. It is my first time using the China Railway 12306 app.

Oh, that is a great idea, Wei! Well, the app is very easy to use if you book your tickets in advance. I think you should try to get a seat with a view of the hills because the scenery is beautiful in autumn.
Actually, I am worried about the view. The train will go through tunnels near Jialing River, right? Will I see the mountains?

To be honest, there are many tunnels, but you will see the mountains when the train comes out of the tunnel. I remember last time I was on the train, the air was fresh and the leaves were red. You know, it feels like a short trip to the countryside.
That sounds nice. If I book a ticket now, can I choose a window seat near the door?

Yes, you can! By the way, window seats on the right side are better for the sunset. If you go to the bathroom first, you can enjoy the view without blocking blocking. Actually, I have a small snack in my bag, do you want to share?
No, thanks. I will buy food on the train. Is there a trolley with hot food?

Of course, there is a trolley every hour. You can order fried noodles or dumplings if you are hungry. I usually eat the egg noodle soup because it is warm and tasty. In addition, you can buy water and fruit too.
Great, I will try the noodles. Do you think I can bring my own food from Chengdu?

Yes, you can bring your own food, but I guess the train staff might ask you to keep the smell inside. Actually, it is better to eat hot food from the trolley because the train is fast and you do not want to eat cold food.
I understand. When will the train leave from Chengdu Station tomorrow morning?
The high-speed train G261 leaves at 07:15 in the morning. It arrives in Leshan at 09:40. So you will have a long day in Leshan. If you miss the train, you can take the next one at 10:30.
Okay, I will book the 07:15 train. Thank you for your advice, Senior Classmate.
You are welcome, Wei! I hope you have a wonderful trip and see the beautiful Huanglong scenery. You know, Leshan Giant Buddha is waiting for you. Have a safe journey!

messages.content: Hi. I'm thinking of taking the high-speed train from Chengdu to Dujiangyan next weekend. Have you done it before?
Yes, I have! Actually, I've taken that route many times since I went there for my graduation trip. To be honest, it's much faster than taking a bus, especially in autumn when the weather is nice.
Okay. I need to book the ticket now because I want a window seat. Is it hard to get one?

Well, it can be quite competitive if you wait too long. I usually book about three days in advance because popular trains fill up quickly. If you book early, you can definitely choose a window seat to see the scenery.
I see. What is the view like from the window? It must be beautiful.

It's absolutely stunning! You know, as the train goes through the mountains, you can see terraced fields and old villages. Although the train is very fast, you still have time to look out and enjoy the autumn colors.
That sounds amazing. Can I order food on the train or do I need to bring it from Chengdu?

You can order hot water and snacks from the attendant, but the food isn't too special. I think it's better to bring some local snacks from Chengdu, like spicy tofu puffs or Sichuan hotpot base, which you can eat with the free water.
Good idea. I've been eating hotpot at home since last month. Do you think I should buy some to share?

Yes, that would be great! Actually, many students do that. You can bring your own soup base and vegetables. Just remember to check the luggage space, because the overhead racks can be full during busy times.
I will pack a bag with snacks. What time should I arrive at the station in Chengdu?

You should arrive at least thirty minutes before the departure time. Although the station is modern and clean, the security check can take a while if there are many people. It's better to be safe than sorry.
Thanks for the advice. If I miss the train, can I buy a ticket for the next one?
Of course you can. There are usually frequent trains between Chengdu and Dujiangyan, so you won't miss your trip completely. Just don't worry too much if something unexpected happens.
I feel much more confident now. When do you usually go to the countryside for your holiday?
I guess I go there mostly during the Spring Festival or Golden Week, but I also try to visit in autumn because the air is fresh. What about you? Do you prefer city life or the countryside?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I'm looking for a good tea gift for my friend. Can you help me?
Hi Lin! Of course, I can help you. This market is famous for many kinds of tea, you know. What kind of gift are you planning to buy?
I want something special because it's his birthday. But I don't know much about tea.
Well, that's okay. Actually, Pu'er tea is very popular here in Kunming. It's aged for a long time, so the flavor is quite unique. Have you heard of it before?
Yes, I've seen it. Is it expensive? I want to ask for advice on quality, please.
To be honest, the price depends on how old the tea is. Some costs 50 yuan, while others can be 500 yuan. If you buy a cake from a good factory, it's usually high quality. Which brand do you like?
I like the red one. But the price is a bit high. Maybe I can bargain with the vendor?
Sure! You can try to bargain. For example, you can say the price is too much for just one cake. Maybe we can agree on 300 yuan instead of 500. It works most of the time.
That sounds good. I think I will try it. How much is this small box?
This small box is 80 yuan. It's good for trying first. Although it's not as strong as the big cake, the taste is still nice. You can also buy some snacks like youtiao if you like.
Okay, I'll take the small box then. Thank you for your help. It's very kind of you.
No problem! You're welcome. I'm glad I could help you find a good gift. Here is your tea. Enjoy it!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I'm new to Kunming, and I want to buy some local tea as a gift for my friend. Do you have any good advice?

Hello Lin! Yes, you're in the right place. Well, Dongfeng Market is famous for all kinds of local products. Actually, if you want the best quality, you should look at the Pu'er tea from Yunnan. It's very popular because it tastes smooth and has a special aftertaste.
That sounds nice. But I heard some brands are too expensive. Can we compare prices first? I don't have much money.

Of course, I understand. To be honest, prices vary a lot depending on the age of the tea leaves. For example, a small jar of young Pu'er might cost around 200 yuan, but an older one can be 1,000 yuan. If you just want a gift, a mid-range brand from here is perfect and not too pricey.
I see. Maybe 300 yuan is okay? How do I know if the quality is good?

Good question! You know, the leaves should look dark and shiny, not dry or broken. Also, the smell should be fresh and earthy. If you buy too much, the tea can lose its flavor. So, I think a small box of about 500 grams grams is enough for your friend.
Okay, but the price on the tag is 450 yuan. Can I bargain with you? I have a friend who knows the real price is lower.

Well, bargaining is normal here, but not everyone likes it. Actually, since I've been selling in this area for years, I prefer fair prices. However, if you really want to buy two boxes, I can give you a small discount. How about 400 yuan for both?
400 yuan for two? That's a bit high. What if I take one now and another next week?

Oh, that's a good idea! You're right. If you buy one today, I'll keep the best leaf for you. And next week, you can get the second one at the same price. So, let's say 450 yuan for this one, and you promise to come back?
Sure, I promise! But wait, is this tea from Yuxi or Dali? I heard the tea from those places is better.

That's true, the tea from Yuxi is very famous. But honestly, the Pu'er from Kunming is also excellent because it's picked right here. Anyway, I've used the same supplier as in Yuxi, so the quality is the same. Don't worry!
Okay, then I'll trust you. Do you have any other gifts I can buy while I'm here?

Well, there's also fresh spring bamboo shoots and wild mushrooms nearby. They're seasonal, so you only have them in spring. In addition, if you like snacks, try the local dried plums. They're sweet and sour, just like you like fruit.
I love dried plums! Can I get a bag of that too? How much is it?

Sure, that's a great choice. The dried plums are 80 yuan for a big bag. Well, if you buy them with the tea, I'll throw in a free sample pack. You know, it's a small thing, but I hope you enjoy your shopping in Kunming!

messages.content: Hello, I'm Hua from Wuchang. I've been feeling really tired since last week, and my head hurts a lot. Do you have time for an appointment today?

Hi Hua, welcome to our clinic in Hanyang. Actually, I can help you with that. We usually have morning appointments, but it's pretty busy right now. Do you have any specific symptoms besides the headache and tiredness?
Well, my hands are cold and my tongue feels a bit dry. I guess I'm just too stressed from work. Can you check if Dr. Lin is free?

Yes, Dr. Li is here now, but Dr. Lin will be free around 11 AM if you come a bit later. To be honest, your symptoms sound like a common issue in winter. We might use some herbal medicine, like Chrysanthemum tea, which is very good for stress.
That sounds nice. If I go at 11 AM, how long does the visit usually take? And do I need to pay before or after?
It usually takes about twenty minutes, depending on how many questions the doctor asks. By the way, you pay after the visit, right? We accept Renminbi, and you can also use WeChat Pay if you have it.
Okay, I have WeChat Pay. I think 11 AM works for me. Should I bring my ID card from the city hall?

Yes, please bring your ID card, that's necessary for the medical record. Also, if you have any past prescriptions, please take them with you. We are located near the Yangtze River Bridge, so it's easy to find.
Great, thank you. I'll come at 11 AM. Is there anything I should avoid eating before the appointment?
Well, it's better not to eat heavy food like dumplings or greasy noodles right before. Try to have a light meal instead. Also, you know, drinking plenty of warm water is a good idea for your health.
I understand. I usually eat noodles for lunch, so I'll try to eat something else today. Thanks for your help.
You're welcome! If you have any other questions before you come, feel free to call us. We hope you feel better soon. See you at 11 AM.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Hua. I've been feeling very tired since last month because of work stress. Can I make an appointment today?

Hello, Hua. Well, I'm sorry to hear you're feeling so tired. Of course, we can book an appointment for you. Actually, our Traditional Chinese Medicine doctor here in Hanyang is very good at treating stress. Do you have a headache or just feel weak?
I have a bit of a headache, but mostly my back hurts when I sit in my chair all day. Also, I feel dizzy sometimes.

I see. That sounds like a common problem for office workers. By the way, our clinic is located near the Wuhan railway station, so it's easy to get here. If you take the metro from Zhongnanhu, it takes about twenty minutes to reach our door.
Okay, the metro sounds good. When can I see the doctor? I need to go back to work after lunch.
That's fine. You can come at 2:00 PM in the afternoon. The doctor usually sees patients from 2:00 to 4:00, so you have enough time. If you come earlier than 2:00, you might have to wait in the queue.
Perfect. What should I do before the appointment? Do I need to take off my shoes?

Yes, please take off your shoes when you enter the waiting area. It's a traditional custom here. Also, you can bring your health insurance card. If you don't have it, we can still accept cash or WeChat payment, but the card is faster.
I have my insurance card. How much will the consultation cost? I guess it won't be too expensive, right?

To be honest, the consultation fee is about 150 yuan. However, if you have the insurance card, the cost will be much lower because the government pays part of the bill. In addition, the herbal medicine treatment is a bit more expensive, but it's very effective for your symptoms.
That sounds reasonable. I'll definitely use my insurance card. Do you have any tea or water while I wait?

Yes, we have hot chrysanthemum tea which is great for clearing heat and reducing stress. Would you like a cup? It's free for patients. You know, drinking it while waiting can help you relax a bit before seeing the doctor.
That's a great idea. I'll have one, please. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome! Your appointment is confirmed for 2:00 PM today. If you need anything else, just let me know. I hope you feel better soon after the treatment.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Jing. I've been thinking about renovating my room since I moved here last year. Do you know if I need the landlord's permission first?
Well, actually, you definitely need to check the contract terms before doing anything. My landlord said that changing the walls is not allowed unless you ask first. Have you looked at your agreement?
To be honest, I haven't read it carefully. I just know I can't paint the whole room red. What if I just buy some new furniture?
That sounds safer. Most contracts the lease says you can move furniture, but you can't make permanent changes. By the way, do you want to put a small bookshelf in your corner?
Actually, I do! I want a comfortable reading nook. But I also need to find a reliable contractor to fix the old window. Do you know anyone good?
Oh, I can help with that. There's a man named Wei who lives in the alley behind the old temple. He has been fixing windows for ten years and he is very honest. You know, he charges a fair price.
That's great news! I've been looking for someone since I arrived. Although I am worried about the noise. Do you think they will make a lot of noise?

If you talk to Wei first, he might work early in the morning or late at night to avoid disturbing you. To be honest, construction noise is terrible, but we can try to schedule it when you are not home.
I guess I could go to work then. But what if my neighbor downstairs complains? She has been complaining about small things lately.
That is a good point. If you let her know you are planning to work on the window, she might be more understanding. Actually, I once told my landlord and he said he would warn talk to her for me.
Really? That would be very kind. Should I bring him some tea as a thank you?
Yes, that is a perfect idea. Chinese people love tea, so bringing her some jasmine tea would be very polite. I think it will help everyone get along better in the building.
Thanks for your advice! I feel much better now. I will call Wei next week. See you later!
You are welcome. Good luck with the renovation! I hope the window is fixed soon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing. I've been living in this small room on Gulangyu for six months, but I'm thinking of renovating it since it's too hot in summer.

Well, that's a good idea, especially here. The summer heat on the island can be really intense, you know. But actually, have you checked your contract terms? I heard some landlords don't allow big changes to the walls.
Oh, I haven't looked closely yet. I signed it last year. What if I put up some air conditioning? Is that allowed?

It depends on the clause about electrical appliances. Usually, you can't change the structure, but adding a split unit might be okay if you don't drill into the main pipes. You should ask your landlord first, to be honest.
I guess I will. But I also want to paint the walls a cooler color, like light blue, because it looks nice.

That sounds lovely! Light colors reflect heat, so it would be much better than dark red. However, if you paint over the original wallpaper walls, the landlord might ask you to fix it later when you move out.
I don't want to have a fight with him. Do you think I can just paint a little bit, like on the upper part?

Well, a small touch-up is probably fine. I've seen neighbors do that in the old buildings here. But you know, have you thought about hiring a contractor? There are quite a few reliable workers in the nearby town of Huli.
Yes, I need someone reliable. Can I find one quickly? I'm worried about noise complaints from my neighbors.

Oh, that's a valid concern. Construction on an island like this can be very noisy, and people are sensitive to it. You should definitely talk to the building manager first to set a quiet time, maybe after 9 pm.
Good point. Maybe I can wait until the weekend when fewer people are home, or do the noisiest work in the morning.
That's a smart plan. Also, try to use tools that make less noise if possible. By the way, if you hire a local team from Xiamen mainland, they might be cheaper than those on the island.
I've been looking at a few teams, but most of them are too expensive. Is it worth spending more money for a faster job?
I think it depends on your budget. Actually, a cheaper contractor might take longer, which could cause more noise for a longer period. You know, sometimes paying a bit more saves you trouble later.
You're right. I'll ask the manager about the quiet hours first, and then I'll look for a team who can work efficiently without making too much noise.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jie. I want to try pottery this Saturday. Is there a good workshop in Zhuhai?
Hello, Jie! Well, there is a really nice studio in the Old Town Art District. It's close to the old streets and it's very peaceful.
That sounds great. I have been thinking about making a bowl, but I don't know much about clay.
Actually, that is perfect for a beginner. You can start with a simple round bowl. The instructor will show you how to press the clay with your fingers.
Oh, I guess I need strong hands for that. Is it difficult if I have not done it before?
Don't worry, it's not hard if you practice. You know, many people feel nervous at first, but they relax after the second lesson.
How much does the class cost? Maybe I can take a few lessons.
To be honest, the price is quite reasonable. A single weekend class costs about two hundred RMB. In addition, you can buy materials there too.
I see. I will bring my child too. What should we wear for the class?
You should wear old clothes because you will get dirty. Also, you can take your shoes off and wear slippers on the way to the studio.
Okay, I will wear my old T-shirt. Can we finish the bowl in one day?
Well, you can shape the bowl in one day, but it needs to dry for a week. If you wait, it will be hard and ready to use.
That is good news. When should we arrive? I don't want to miss the start time.
You should arrive at ten o'clock. The studio opens at ten, but we can meet at the gate if you are late. I think it will be a lot of fun!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jie. I want to learn pottery this weekend in Zhuhai. Do you have a good workshop in the Old Town Art District?
Hello, Jie! Yes, I teach a class right here in the Old Town Art District. Actually, we start at 10 AM on Saturday. It's a great place because the air is fresh and the light is perfect for painting.
That sounds nice. I've never made a pot before. I am a bit worried I will break everything.
Don't worry! Most people feel that way at first. Well, pottery is like learning to ride a bike. You might fall a few times, but you will get better. We start with simple bowls, so it's not too hard.
I see. I like the round shape. What kind of clay do we use? Is it wet like mud?

It's a bit different from mud, you know. It's like soft dough. You have to keep your hands wet so the clay doesn't dry out. Actually, many students in Zhuhai like making flower pots because they are useful.
Flower pots are a good idea. How much does the class cost? Do I need to buy anything?

The cost is about 120 RMB for the whole day. It's quite affordable for a weekend activity. As for materials, we provide the clay and the tools. You only need to bring your own apron and a pair of gloves.
Okay, I have a blue apron. But I don't have gloves. Do I need to buy them today?
You can buy a pair from the shop next to the studio. It's very cheap, maybe 15 RMB. Actually, wearing gloves helps your hands stay clean, which is important when working with clay.
Good, I will buy them. When do we start the class? Is there a waiting time?
We start at 10 AM, so please come at 9:30 AM. There is usually a short waiting time because the shop opens at 9. By the way, you can drink some hot tea while you wait.
Tea is perfect. I am from Shenzhen, so I know tea is important in China. I will bring my family photos to remember the day.

That's a lovely idea! Oh, and don't forget to take your camera too. You want to capture the moment, right? In addition, the studio has a small kitchen where you can wash your hands before you go home.
Yes, I want to take photos. Is it easy to take home my pot? Or do I have to wait for it to dry?
You can take your pot home right after the class! It's still soft, but it's hard enough to hold. Actually, it will dry out on your table at home. In about three days, it will be ready to paint.
I am so excited now. Thank you for helping me plan my day. I will see you at 9:30 AM.
You're welcome, Jie! I will see you then. To be honest, I think you will make a beautiful bowl. See you on Saturday!

messages.content: Hi, my name is Wei. I've been hiking since last year, and I want to go to Lijiang this weekend. Have you done it before?
Hello, Wei! Yes, I've been there a few times since I moved here. Actually, the trail near the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is beautiful in autumn because the leaves are changing color.
That sounds nice. What about the weather? Is it cold?

Well, it's a bit chilly this time of year. You know, the wind can be strong near the mountain, so you should bring a warm jacket. I mean, last year it rained in the afternoon, but today the forecast says it'll be sunny.
Okay, I think I'll bring a jacket. Which trail do you recommend for a beginner like me?
You're asking the right person! Honestly, the path to the Blue Moon Valley is not too hard. It's a nice walk because the water is very clear, and there are many tourists who take photos there.
I like the sound of that. What supplies should I pack?

By the way, don't forget your water bottle and some dry food. For example, you can buy some fresh baozi or nian gao at the local market if you get hungry. Also, bring your camera because the views are amazing.
Good idea. I haven't bought any food yet. Are there shops on the trail?
Not really. Most shops are in the town center, so you need to pack everything you need before you leave. If you go too far without water, you might feel tired quickly.
I understand. When should we start?
Let's meet at 8 a.m. tomorrow. That's early, but the light is perfect for hiking then. If we start later, the sun might be too strong, or it could get crowded.
Okay, 8 a.m. sounds good. Thanks for your help, neighbor!
You're welcome, Wei! I'm sure you'll enjoy the hike since you've been doing it for a while. Just remember to check the weather again on Friday morning, and we'll have a great time!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei. I've been hiking since last year and I want to go near Jade Dragon Snow Mountain this Saturday. Have you done it before?
Hello, Wei! Yes, I have. Actually, I've hiked there many times since 2020. It's beautiful in autumn because the leaves turn red.
That's great. I heard the weather is very cold there. Should I take a jacket?
Of course, you should! It's quite windy up high. Well, if it rains in the morning, you might need a windbreaker too. By the way, what time are you planning to start?
I'll start at eight o'clock. Is it too early?
Not at all. In fact, starting early is better because the trail can get crowded later. You know, many people from Dali come on weekends.
Oh, I didn't know that. Which trail do you suggest for a beginner like me?
I think the Blue Moon Valley trail is perfect. It's not very hard and there are shops along the way. Although, you must bring enough water since there are no stores up there.
Good point. What should I pack besides water?
Well, don't forget your socks and warm shoes. Also, bring some instant noodles in case you get hungry. For example, the local hot pot noodles are delicious after a long walk.
I have a thermos for hot water, but I don't have a cooking pot. Is that okay?
That's fine. You can buy a small pot at a shop near the entrance. In addition, try to pack a map just in case your phone loses signal. It happens often in the mountains.
Thanks for the advice. I'll check the weather app one more time. Are you joining me?
I'd love to, but I have to work at the guesthouse in Lijiang. However, I'll drive you to the parking lot if you want. To be honest, it's safer to have a car nearby.
That would be very helpful. I'll meet you at the hotel at eight then. Thanks again!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing. I want to go to the winter festival in the Old City this weekend, but I haven't had time to look yet.
Hello, Jing! Well, that sounds like a great idea. Actually, the festival in Chang'an An area is very famous this season. You know, it's been popular since last December.
Oh, really? Where exactly should I go? I live near Shuyang Square, so it should be close.
That's right! The main gate is just east of Shuyang Square. If you take the subway line 2 to Beiyamen Road, you can walk there in about ten minutes. By the way, it's not too far.
Great. Do I need to buy a ticket before I go? I don't want to wait in line.

Honesty, you don't have to buy tickets in advance. You can buy them at the entrance for twenty yuan. However, if you go during the peak hours, you might have to wait a bit. I think it's better to go early, like at five o'clock.
Okay, I will try to go at five. Can I bring my friends from work? They like Hanfu clothes.

Yes, of course you can! In fact, many people wear Hanfu there. My cousin went last year and she took her whole team. It's very nice to see them in traditional clothes. You know, it looks beautiful in the snow.
That sounds fun. What kind of food can we eat there? I love spicy noodles.

Well, there are many food stalls. You can try Roujiamo, which is a Chinese hamburger sandwich, and some hot soup. Although your spicy noodles are not sold there, they have some very hot beef noodles. I guess you will like them!
I've heard of Roujiamo. I will definitely try it. When did the festival start? I want to plan my day.
The festival started on Friday morning. It will continue until Sunday evening. So you have three days to enjoy it. Since you are busy, maybe you can go on Saturday afternoon. It won't be as crowded.
Perfect. I think I'll meet my colleagues there. Do we need to wear warm coats?

Yes, it's very cold in winter here. You must wear thick jackets because the temperature is below zero. By the way, don't forget to bring your umbrellas if it rains. I hope the weather stays nice for your party.
Thanks for the advice! I will bring my scarf and coat. See you there next weekend, Manager.
You're welcome, Jing! I'm sure you will have a great time. Oh, and please tell your friends to arrive early. See you then!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing. I'm really busy with work since last month, so I haven't had time to go to any community events.
Hi Jing! That happens to many of us. Well, actually, we have a neighborhood festival in the Old City tonight. It's been cold since December, but it's very warm inside the pavilions.
Oh, that sounds nice. Where exactly is it? I live in Gaoxin District, so I'm not sure about the Old City location.
It's right near Bell Tower and the Drum Tower. You can take Metro Line 2 and get off at Nanluoguxiang station. If you walk east for five minutes, you'll see the big red flags.
Okay, I see. Do I need to buy a ticket? I've never bought tickets for local events before.
To be honest, you don't need a ticket to walk around. However, if you want to eat at the food stalls, you just need the money. There's no entry fee, which is great for students like you.
That's good. My friend Li Wei wants to come with me. He has been working hard for the past week and he needs a break.
That's a wonderful idea. By the way, Li Wei will love the Yangzhou fried rice there. It's famous because it uses fresh local ingredients. You should also try the Tangyuan, which are sweet dumplings.
I've heard of Tangyuan, but I haven't tried them since I was a child. What time should we meet? I usually finish work at 6 PM.
The festival starts at 6:30 PM. Actually, I think you can arrive early to watch the lantern being lit. If you meet me at the metro station at 6:15, we can walk together and chat.
Perfect. I'll call Li Wei to tell him we are going. He has a meeting tomorrow, so he might be late.
I guess it's okay if he is late. People usually arrive a bit later than planned. Oh, and don't forget to bring your phone, because the Wi-Fi might be slow at the festival.
Right, I remember. Thank you for the advice. It sounds like a fun night, even if the weather is cold outside.
You're welcome! Well, I hope you both have a great time. In addition to the food, there are many folk music performances. I think you will enjoy the atmosphere.

messages.content: Hi, my name is Hao. I've been to Kunming a few times, but I'm a bit confused by the menu. Can you recommend a special noodle dish?
Hello, Hao! Well, welcome back to Kunming. Actually, you must try the Lazi Mian. It's a famous local dish from here. You know, it's made with sour soup and fresh herbs, which makes it very special.
Sour soup? That sounds interesting. Is it spicy? I can't eat too much spicy food because my stomach hurts easily.

Don't worry. Although the soup is sour, it's not very spicy if you ask for it mild. In addition, the chef can adjust the chili oil for you. For example, just a little bit of red oil is enough for most people.
That's good news. I guess I'll order that. By the way, can I have some rice noodles instead of the regular ones? I ate rice noodles yesterday in Chuxiong.
Of course! Rice noodles are perfect here. They go really well with the sour broth. Actually, many people in our neighborhood prefer rice noodles because they are softer than wheat noodles.
Great. Oh, and do you have any vegetable side dishes? I want to have something green.
Sure, we have fresh mustard greens and bean spr spr, which are very healthy. You know, these vegetables grow well in the cool spring weather we have now.
Perfect. I've been looking for a place with good greens. How much is the bill if I order the rice noodles, some vegetables, and a drink?
It's very reasonable. The rice noodles are 15 yuan, the vegetables are 10 yuan, and a bottle of local tea is 5 yuan. So, the total will be 30 yuan.
30 yuan? That's fair. I'll pay with WeChat. Is it okay if I take the food away?
Yes, it's no problem. You can ask for takeout if you want to go to the nearby park or walk to the old town. Actually, the bag is very convenient for carrying soup too.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Hao. I love noodles, but the menu is confusing. What do you recommend?
Hello, Hao! Well, we have the famous Xiaoxian mantou here in Kunming. It's a steamed bun with fillings like beef or mushroom. You know, many people like it because it's soft and warm.
Okay, I've heard of mantou, but I actually prefer something hot. Is there a noodle dish?
Of course! You should try our Zhancui rice noodles. They are stir-fried with vegetables and meat, and they taste delicious. Actually, they are very popular since lunch time starts now.
That sounds good. But I'm not very good at spicy food. How spicy is it?

To be honest, the standard Zhancui is quite spicy. However, if you tell the chef you want mild, they can make it less spicy for you. I think most customers prefer a little heat, but it's not too strong if you ask.
Oh, I see. I'll ask for mild then. By the way, have you tried the spicy tomato noodles?

Yes, I have tried them many times. They are famous in Yunnan, but they are very spicy. You know, many tourists love them because they are fresh and sour. But for you, maybe the pork noodle soup is better?
Pork noodle soup? That sounds simple. Why is it special?

It's special because the broth is made from fresh pork bones for hours. It's very rich and comforting. In addition, we often add fresh herbs which are not found in other places. You should try it if you want something warm.
I think I will order the pork noodle soup. Is it ready now?
Yes, it's ready! Here you go. We also have some pickled mustard greens to go with it. It's very good because the sour taste balances the rich soup. Please enjoy your meal.
Thank you. How much is the bill?
Here is the bill. The noodles are 25 yuan, and the greens are 5 yuan. So, the total is 30 yuan. You can pay by WeChat or cash. It's a reasonable price for such a good lunch.
Perfect. I'll pay now. Thanks for explaining the menu!
You're welcome! Hope you like the food. If you come back next month, we will have spring vegetables then. Have a nice day!

messages.content: Hey, I'm planning a family reunion this summer in Chengdu. We need to decide on a date soon.

That sounds great, Ya! Well, I think July would be perfect since the weather is usually hot but we can stay indoors in the banquet hall. Actually, how about the weekend of July 15th? My parents are free then.
Julynching a big meal is my next worry. I want to order spicy hot pot, but some relatives don't like it that much.

To be honest, that's a common problem. You know, we can ask the restaurant to make a milder version for them. In addition, maybe we can order some cold dishes like mapo tofu without too much chili, or maybe some steamed fish.
That's a good idea. But I need to book the table now. The prices are going up since last year.

Oh, I see. Well, if you book online today, you might get a discount. I guess you should call the restaurant in Wuhou District, they are quite famous. Also, don't forget to ask for a private room so everyone is comfortable.
Okay, I'll call them later. Now, how do we invite relatives who live far away? Many of them use WeChat.

That's true, sending a WeChat group invitation is much faster than calling everyone. By the way, you can also send a red packet with the date and location. If they can't come, they can send their blessing online.
I like that idea. What about decorations? I don't want the hall to look too boring.

Well, I have some ideas! You can hang some red lanterns and couplets around the entrance. Also, why not set up some traditional Chinese paper cutting on the tables? It would look very nice and festive.
Those decorations sound beautiful. Do you have any suggestions for games for the kids?

Of course! We could play dragon and tiger, which is a very traditional game. In addition, you can organize a dumpling-making contest for the younger generation. It's fun and everyone can learn how to make them together.
Making dumplings is a must for me. I haven't made them in a while, so it has been years since I last cooked with my family.
That's so sweet! You know, it's been a while since I did that too. If we book the date for July 15th, we can start preparing the ingredients this weekend. What do you think?
Yes, that works. Let's aim for that date. Thanks for your help, cousin.

messages.content: Hi Cousin! I'm planning the family reunion for next week. Since everyone has been busy with work since last month, I'm not sure if we can find a good date. What do you think?

Well, actually, how about Sunday afternoon? My grandma said she's free that day because the weather is nice in Chengdu. To be honest, most relatives prefer weekends so they don't have to take leave from work.
That sounds perfect! I've been looking for a place to eat. There's a big banquet hall in Gaoxin District that has a private room. Do you think it's suitable for twenty people?
Oh, I think that's great! It's big enough. By the way, my uncle works there and said the hotpot is excellent. If you book it now, you might get a discount because it's the summer season.
I'll call him later. Speaking of food, what dishes should we order? We need something spicy because my dad loves Sichuan food. Have you decided what to eat?

You know, we should definitely order Mapo Tofu and Kung Pao Chicken! My mom always says those are the best. In addition, we need some cold dishes like shredded jellyfish and cucumber chicken salad for the start. What do you think about the main course?
I agree. Actually, we also need to think about the kids. They will be bored if we just eat. Can we organize some games? I'm worried they might get restless after lunch.

That's a good point! We could play some traditional games like 'catch the ball' or 'guess the rope'. I've seen kids playing this at the park in Tianfu New Area. It's fun and they don't need expensive equipment.
Yes, let's do that. But wait, how will we invite everyone? My aunt lives in Yibin and it's far away. Should we send invitations by mail or call her?

Well, actually, a WeChat group is best because everyone is online. You can send the message with photos of the venue. If you call her, she might forget to reply quickly. Also, you can ask her to bring her husband since they live near there.
Good idea. I will set up the group today. What if someone can't come? I don't want to feel bad if my cousins from Xi'an are busy. Is it okay if some people miss it?

Don't worry about it! It's not a problem because family reunions are not every year. If they can't come, they can send red envelopes later. As long as we have the main family here, it will be a happy memory.
You're right. I feel relieved now. We need to buy some gifts too. Do you have any ideas for elders? Maybe something from the local market in Wuhou?

Actually, tea from the local market is perfect! My grandma loves Pu'er tea. In addition, we can buy some fresh fruits like lychees since it's summer. It's thoughtful and not too expensive. What do you think about buying tea for everyone?
Sounds like a plan. I think I'll go to the market tomorrow morning. Thanks for your help, Cousin! I hope everything goes well. See you then.
No problem! I'll help you with the decorations if you need. See you tomorrow! It will be great to see everyone together again.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Fei. I'm a graphic designer here in Wuhan. I've been trying to improve my digital skills for months, but it's been hard. Do you think taking a training course would help?

Well, Fei, I think a course is a great idea. Actually, many people in our office have done it. You know, since you started learning Photoshop three years ago, you've made great progress, but a course can speed things up. For example, if you join a weekend workshop at the local university, you might learn shortcuts faster.
That sounds useful. By the way, my company is in the Qiaokou district. Is there a good place nearby for design classes? I want to practice with my colleagues too. What if I don't have time?

Oh, Qiaokou is a nice area. There's a creative space near Jintan Road where we often go. Actually, if you practice with your team, it's much better because you can share tips immediately. To be honest, even if you only have twenty minutes a day, you can still make a difference. Have you tried using the tablet your boss gave you?
Yes, I've used it, but I've forgotten how to use some features. Maybe if I attend a class, I can remember better. What do you suggest I do tomorrow? I have a meeting with my boss at ten.

I guess you should ask your boss for help first. If you tell her about your plan, she might suggest a good class. By the way, you can also practice on your own projects. For instance, if you redo make a new poster for the festival tomorrow, you can try new tools while you work. It's a good way to show results.
That's a good idea. I'm going to make a poster for the Mid-Autumn Festival. It's coming next week. Do you think I can finish it before Friday? I feel a bit stressed about the deadline.

Don't worry, Fei. Actually, if you start now, you'll have enough time. You know, last year I made a similar poster in three days. In addition, you can work on it during the lunch break. Although you're busy, you can also ask me to review your draft. That will help you finish faster.
Thanks. I'll try to work during lunch. What if I make a mistake? I'm afraid of showing bad work to the team. Maybe I should practice alone first. Is that okay?

Of course it's okay. You know, everyone makes mistakes when they first learn. Actually, if you practice alone, you won't waste the team's time. To be honest, I once made a big error in a design, but my colleague helped me fix it. So, don't be afraid. You can also show me your work before the meeting.
That makes me feel better. I'll show you my draft tomorrow morning. How about we grab lunch at a noodle shop nearby? I love eating hot dry noodles. Do you like them too?

Yes, I'd love to eat hot dry noodles with you. It's delicious, especially in the fall weather here in Wuhan. Actually, there's a famous shop near the metro station. If we go there, we can talk more about your project while we eat. It sounds like a great plan.
Perfect. Let's meet at the metro station at twelve. I'm really looking forward to it. Thanks for your advice, I feel much more confident now.
You're welcome, Fei. I'm happy to help. Remember, you've come a long way since you started. If you keep practicing, you'll definitely show great results soon. See you at the station!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Fei. I have been working here since last year, but I need to improve my digital skills. Do you think I should take the Photoshop training course next week?

Well, that's a great idea, Fei. Actually, the course is held at the office building in Wuchang District, so it's very convenient. Since you want to be more efficient, taking it is definitely a good choice.
Yes, I agree. But I am worried about the cost. Is it expensive? Also, will my manager, Mr. Zhang, pay for it?

To be honest, the price is reasonable because the company often pays for these courses. I guess Mr. Zhang will approve it if you tell him you have already practiced with some files. He likes to see results!
That is good news. I have been practicing with some images since Monday, but I still make many mistakes. How can I show him the progress?
You know, you can save your old files and your new ones to compare them. Also, try to finish a small project by this Friday. If you can show the before-and-after photos, he will be very happy.
That sounds like a plan. However, I am tired because the weather is very cold in Wuhan this fall. Can I practice in the afternoon instead?
Oh, I understand. It's quite chilly now, especially near the Yangtze River. Actually, you can ask your colleague, Xiao Li, to work with you. She is very friendly and will help you if you are busy.
Thank you, Xiao Li is a nice person. But I want to learn faster. What if I do not finish the project by Friday? Will I fail?

Don't worry about that. Even if you are a little late, you can still submit it. The most important thing is that you have started learning. By the way, have you tried the new tablet our office bought?
Yes, I have used it for two days. It is very fast! I think I will use it for the project. Do you think it is better than my computer?

Actually, the tablet is very good for sketching, but your computer is better for final editing. In addition, you can take the tablet to the office in Wuchang to draw ideas quickly. It's a smart way to work.
That is a great tip. I will try to draw on the tablet on Wednesday. Thanks for your advice, senior colleague. I feel more confident now.
You are welcome, Fei. I think you will do a great job. Remember to have a hot bowl of noodles after work to keep warm in this cold weather. Good luck with the course!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing Lin. I'm looking for a new winter jacket for school. I want to buy one online because it's cheaper than in the physical stores.
Hello, Jing! That's a smart idea. Actually, online shopping is very popular here in Chongqing now. But you have to be careful with the sizes. Have you checked the size chart on the website yet?
Yes, I have looked at the chart. However, I am not sure if my measurements match the L size. My chest is 98 cm and my height is 175 cm. Do I need an XL?

Well, 98 cm for the chest is usually a bit big for an L, so an XL might be safer. But honestly, different brands fit differently. For example, some local brands like Bos make their clothes a bit smaller. If you buy from a big store like JD.com, the size might be more accurate.
Okay, I will check JD.com. By the way, the price is too high for me. I found a coupon code online, but I don't know if it works on that store.

That's a common problem. To be honest, you should try to use the code first before you buy anything. Just copy and paste it in the box. If it doesn't work, the website will usually tell you an error message. In addition, sometimes you need to join their membership program to get the best discounts.
I see. I think I will join their membership. What if the jacket doesn't fit after I get it? I want to return it to the shop.

Don't worry too much about that. Most reliable shops in China have a seven-day return policy if the item is not damaged. You just need to pack it carefully and send it back. Actually, the process is quite easy if you use the app.
That sounds good. How do I send the package? Do I go to the post office or can I do it online?

You can do almost everything online. You just need to fill in the return address on the app, and they will print a label for you. Then you can take the package to the nearest courier station, like SF Express or YTO, to drop it off. They will scan the package and send it back.
I have never used SF Express before. Is it expensive? I only have 200 yuan left for the shipping fee.

I guess that's enough for the return shipping. Usually, the first return is free if the product is defective, or they might charge a small fee. By the way, since you are in Chongqing, the courier stations are everywhere, like near the Jiefangbei area or in Yubei District. It's very convenient.
Great, thank you for your help. I will try to buy the jacket from JD.com tomorrow.
You're welcome, Jing! Good luck with your shopping. If you have any trouble with the coupon or the return, just ask me again. I hope you find a warm jacket for the cold winter in Chongqing!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing Lin. I am looking for a new winter jacket for school because it is very cold in Chongqing now. Have you bought clothes online before?
Well, I have bought clothes online many times since last winter. Actually, it is quite popular here in Chongqing. You can find good brands like Anta or Li-Ning easily on their websites.
That is good. But I am worried about the size. My measurements are a bit different from the chart. What should I do?

I think you should check the size chart carefully before you pay. For example, measure your chest and waist at home first. If the jacket is too big, you can send it back easily, although it might take a few days.
Okay, I will measure myself. Do you know if there are any coupon codes for students? I want to save some money for hot pot later.

To be honest, many stores offer student discounts if you show your student ID. By the way, you can also use a coupon code during the shopping festival in December. It is a great way to save money on jackets and shoes.
I have heard about that festival. But what if the jacket does not fit after I try it at home? How do I return the package?

Well, most online shops provide a free return service if the item is not as described. You just need to print the return label and put it in the package. Then, you can take it to the nearest post office or courier station to send it back.
That sounds convenient. I live near Jiefangbei, so I can go to the post office quickly. Is the weather today good for sending a package?

The weather is actually quite rainy today, so it might be a bit wet outside. However, you should wait until tomorrow morning when the rain stops. In the meantime, you can browse more options online on your phone.
Good idea. I will check the website again. Thank you for your help, neighbor. I feel much more confident now about buying online.
You are welcome! I hope you find a warm and stylish jacket that fits you perfectly. If you have any other questions about shopping in Chongqing, feel free to ask me anytime.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiao Fang. Actually, I feel very tired lately and I have had a headache for three days since Monday morning.
Oh dear, I'm sorry to hear that. Well, do you have any other symptoms? You know, sometimes it helps to describe them clearly.
Yes, I've also been feeling dizzy and I have a dry cough. It's been worse since I got up early this week.
That sounds uncomfortable. To be honest, you should probably see a doctor today. Have you been drinking enough water or sleeping well?
I've been working long hours and I haven't slept well since last Friday. I guess I need to rest, but I'm worried about the work.
Well, your health is more important. If you don't rest now, you might get sick. Can I book you an appointment for this afternoon?
Yes, that would be great. Do you have a doctor who specializes in headaches? I need to see someone who knows about this.
Of course, Dr. Liu is very good at treating headaches. He's been working here since 2015. Would 2:00 PM work for you?
2:00 PM is perfect. Thank you. But what if I need to wait for the result? Will I have to come back later?
Actually, Dr. Liu usually gives the results right away. However, if he needs to do some tests, you might need to come back tomorrow. Don't worry too much.
Okay, I understand. Is there anything I should do before the appointment? Maybe I should take some medicine.
To be honest, I don't think you should take any medicine before the visit because it might affect the diagnosis. Just try to drink warm water.
Got it. By the way, where is the clinic exactly? Is it far from Xihu Park?
It's right next to Xihu Park, so it's very close. You can walk there or take the bus number 7. I hope you feel better soon!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiao Fang. I'm feeling really tired and I have a headache since yesterday morning. Do you have time for an appointment today?
Hello, Xiao Fang. I'm sorry to hear that you've been feeling unwell. Well, we do have a few slots available this afternoon if you'd like to come in.
That's good. Can I make it at 2 PM? I live near Xihu Road in Hangzhou, so it's not too far.
Actually, 2 PM works perfectly. It's a bit busy between 1 and 3 because many people from nearby neighborhoods like Binjiang come for check-ups, but your slot is secure.
Okay, thanks. I also have a cough. It's been getting worse for the past three days. What kind of doctor should I see?
You know, for a headache and a cough, our general practitioner can take care of it. Dr. Lin is really experienced and she often treats patients with similar symptoms.
I see. Will I need to wait long? I'm a bit nervous about the waiting time.
To be honest, there might be a short wait since it's a rainy Monday and many people are coming from the office. But Dr. Lin is usually quite fast with her consultations examinations.
Oh, I hope so. What do I need to bring? Do I need my ID card or any medical records?
Yes, please bring your ID card, and if you have any past test reports, that would be helpful too. Actually, we also sell some herbal tea here to help with fatigue if you feel better after the visit.
That sounds nice. How much does the consultation cost? Is it covered by insurance?
The basic check-up costs about 35 yuan, and your insurance should cover most of it. If you need extra tests like blood work, the price might go up a bit.
Okay, I think I'm ready. Should I come right now or wait until 2 PM?
I guess you should come right now and fill out the forms first, so you can relax while waiting. See you in a while!

messages.content: Hello. I'm Zhao Jian. I want to renovate my old apartment in Xiguan, Xi'an. It has been leaking since last year, and the walls are very damp.
Hi Zhao Jian. Well, that sounds really frustrating. Actually, Xiguan is an old area, so many houses there have water pipes that were installed long ago. Have you checked if the pipe is broken yet?
Yes, I think the pipe is broken. I called a plumberian repair man, but he said it is too old to fix. He wants to replace it with new copperones.

Oh, I see. That makes sense. You know, if the old pipe is rustnly rust, it is better to replace it. Actually, we can use PPR pipes which are very strong. Once the pipe is fixed, the leaking will stop, right?
That is a good idea. But after fixing the pipe, I want to fix the walls. They are yellow and wet. Can we paint them?

I think painting is a good start, but you have to be careful. Actually, if the wall is still wet, the paint might not dry well. You should let the wall dry for a few days first. By the way, have you thought about buying new furniture yet?
No, not yet. I am thinking of buying a wooden sofa from a local shop. But I am worried about the price. It is very expensive now.

Well, prices are high everywhere these days. Actually, if you buy from a smaller shop in the city center, maybe it is cheaper than big chains. You know, you could also wait for the spring sale. If you buy later, you might save money.
That is true. I like a simple wooden sofa. But I also want a dining table for my family. We have four people, so we need a big one.

Of course, a family table is important. I guess you can find a round wooden table which is good for four people. Actually, if you choose the right size, the table will look nice in your living room. Have you seen any designs you like?
I saw a table in a shop near the Great Wild Goose Pagoda. But the shop is far from my home. Is it worth going there?

Yes, it is worth it. Well, the shops near the pagoda often have very good quality wood. Although the trip is long, you can see the city on the way. Also, if you buy there, the quality will be better than in a small shop.
Okay, I will go there this weekend. But first, I need to finish the pipe and the walls. When do you think the work will be done?

I think the pipe work will take about three days. Actually, the wall repair might take another two days. So, in total, it will be about five days. Once it is done, your home will be much better and more comfortable.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Zhao Jian. I've been living in this old apartment in Yanta'an for ten years, but the kitchen has been leaking since last winter.
Hello, Mr. Zhao! Well, I've dealt with leaking pipes before, so I know that problem well. It's probably the old galvanized pipe behind the sink. Have you checked if the water pressure is too high?
Yes, actually. The water comes out very fast. I think I need to replace the pipe, but I'm worried about the cost. Do you think it's expensive?
To be honest, it's not that bad if you buy a PPR (PPR) pipe. It's much better than the old metal one, and it won't rust rust (freeze) easily. I can fix it in a day if I come tomorrow morning.
That sounds good. By the way, after I fix the leak, I want to buy some new furniture. Maybe a new sofa and a dining table. What do you think?

Well, that's a great idea! You know, the old furniture is quite small for a family. If you buy a larger sofa, your children will have more space to play. I recommend looking at the market near Xingqing Road.
Oh, Xingqing Road? I haven't been there yet. Is it far from here? Also, I want to repaint the walls in the living room because they look very dull.
Actually, Xingqing Road is quite close; it's only ten minutes by bike. As for the walls, you should use a light color, like pale green or light yellow. It makes the room feel bigger and brighter.
I like the idea of light colors. But I am worried about the dust. It's already dirty from the renovation. How can I clean it properly?
That's a valid concern, I mean. You should use a damp cloth first to remove the dust, and then wash it with a mild detergent cleaner. Don't use too much water, or the walls might get damaged.
Okay, I understand. So, if I hire you to fix the pipe and paint the walls, how long will it take? And will I need to leave the house?
Well, the pipe repair takes about four hours, and painting takes one day. I can finish the work in two days if we start now. You don't need to leave, but please keep the windows open for fresh air.
Perfect! I think we should start tomorrow. What time is convenient for you? I can give you a deposit first.
Of course, that's fine. Let's meet at eight in the morning tomorrow. You can bring the deposit, and I'll bring the tools and materials. I'll see you then!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Su Yao. I've been practicing calligraphy since last year, but I still find it hard to write the correct strokes.

Hello, Su Yao! Well, don't worry, I've been doing this for over twenty years, and I remember how difficult the strokes used to be. Actually, the secret is to focus on the order of the lines, because if you get that wrong, the whole character looks strange.
That makes sense. I often try to write too fast. What kind of paper do you recommend for beginners?

You know, for beginners, you should use rice paper with gridsotted grids, which is very popular in Kunming. It helps you see where your ink goes, although it might feel a bit slippery at first. If you use smooth paper, you might slip and ruin the shape.
I see. And what about the ink? Is black ink always the same?

No, that's not true. Although it looks black to us, there are different shades. For traditional practice, you need real sumac ink made from pine soot, which gives a nice texture. However, if you are just starting, a good quality stick ink is fine, but you have to be careful not to let it dry out.
Okay, I'll try to find some good ink. Do you think I should display my work at home?

To be honest, I think it is a great idea. Displaying your work in your living room, especially near the tea table, makes the room feel very peaceful. But you have to choose a frame that matches your style, like a simple wooden one, because shiny glass might reflect the sunlight.
I have a small room in my apartment in Chongqing. Maybe I can put one piece on the wall above my sofa.

That sounds perfect! In Chongqing, the humidity can be high, so you should make sure the wall is dry before you hang it. Well, you could also put a small brush and some ink near it, just in case you want to write another one later.
Good idea. Have you ever taught someone who started recently?

Yes, I have. I taught a woman from Guiyang who was about your age. She practiced every day since March, and now her characters look much better. Actually, consistency is more important than talent, because practice really makes perfect.
That encourages me. I guess I will practice a little more today before I go home.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Su Yao. I have retired from my job in Yunnan and I love traditional arts. I've been practicing calligraphy for years, but I feel like my strokes are still shaky.

Hello, Su Yao! Well, that's very common even after years of practice. Actually, the secret is to slow down. When you write the vertical stroke, try to start from the very top and press gently. You know, many people make it too fast.
You are right. I usually rush because I want to finish quickly. But I see that the ink spreads too much. Do you think the paper is the problem?

That's a good point. To be honest, the paper matters a lot. We use special Xuan paper from Anhui, which absorbs the ink slowly. If you use normal paper, the ink will leak and your characters will look messy. Have you tried the rice-paper paper?
I have not tried ricei paper yet. It sounds expensive. Where can I buy it in Kunming?

You can find it at the cultural center near the Green Lake Park or in the old street market. It is not that expensive if you buy a small pad. By the way, do you use the black ink stick or the liquid ink?
I use the black ink stick. I grind it myself every morning. It takes time, but I think it is better for my health. What about you?

I have been using the stick since I started twenty years ago. It is wonderful because you control the water yourself. Although it takes time, the smell is very nice. I remember I used to buy the ink in Beijing when I was young. Now I prefer the local brand from Hangzhou.
I agree. The smell is very relaxing. Do you have any advice on how to display my work at home? My living room is small.

Actually, a small space is perfect for calligraphy. You can frame a vertical scroll and hang it above your sofa. For example, write a poem poem that means 'peace' or 'happiness'. It will look very elegant. Have you ever considered hanging two horizontal pieces side by side?
That is a great idea! I will try to write a horizontal piece next week. Maybe I will write a poem about spring because it is summer here now.

Well, writing about spring is a nice choice even in summer. You can write about the rain or the flowers. I guess it will be very beautiful. Let's practice together next time. Do you have a favorite poem that you like to write?
My favorite is a short poem about longevity. I want to live a long life. Do you think this is a good topic for my first horizontal piece?

Of course it is! That is a very meaningful topic. Actually, many elderly people love to write about long life and good health. You can add some flowers around the characters to make it look nicer. I think you will do great.

messages.content: Hello, I am Xiao. It is a beautiful morning in Changsha. I have been walking in the old town for hours. The air is fresh. What is happening today?

Hello, Xiao! Yes, it is a wonderful day. Actually, today is the Dragon Boat Festival, so the whole neighborhood is very lively. We are having a big cultural event at the park near Yuetan. You know, people are racing dragon boats and eating zongzi. It is very fun!
I love zongzi. I have eaten them since I was young. But I have not seen the boat race. Can you tell me more about the community center activities today?

Of course! Well, the community center is organizing a traditional folk song performance. Since you are a retiree, you might like it. There is also a calligraphy exhibition with that famous master, Chen Zeng. You can sign up for the afternoon tea session if you want to chat with others.
That sounds interesting. However, I am a bit tired. Do you think the afternoon tea is near the park?

Yes, it is right next to the park. In addition, there is a small stall selling local snacks like osmanthus rice cake. To be honest, I think you should take a break. If you have energy, you can try the soup. It tastes great!
I guess I will try the rice cake. But I cannot find the entrance. Is it easy to get there by bus?

Don't worry, it is very easy. You can take the No. 12 bus from your home. The bus stops right at the old town gate. Actually, I have been taking this bus for years. It takes about twenty minutes. You will see a red banner when you arrive.
Thank you for the information. I am worried about the crowds. Will it be too noisy?

Well, it can be a bit noisy, especially during the dragon boat race. However, the afternoon tea area is quite quiet. If you go there, you can relax and read a book. By the way, many elderly people like to go there to socialize.
I like to socialize. I have not joined any groups since I retired last year. What kind of groups are there?

There are many groups! For example, there is a tai chi club and a Chinese painting class. Also, we have a mahjong team on weekends. I think you would enjoy the mahjong game. It is a great way to make new friends. Would you like to try it?
I am interested in painting. Do I need special brushes? I have used watercolor before, but not Chinese ink.

You do not need to worry about that. The center provides all the brushes and paper. Actually, many people are beginners like you. You will learn the basic strokes quickly. If you join the class, you can practice every Tuesday morning. It is very helpful.
That is good news. I will go to the park later. Thank you for helping me plan my day.

You are welcome! I am sure you will have a wonderful time. Remember, the bus leaves in ten minutes, so hurry up. Oh, and don't forget to bring your umbrella just in case it rains. Have fun at the festival!

messages.content: Hi. I'm Xiao. It's a nice morning in Changsha. I've been living here for twenty years.

Hello, Xiao! Well, it is indeed a lovely morning, and the weather is perfect for the festival today. I'm Li Ming, a community worker here in the old town. Are you coming to the park to watch the dragon dance?
Yes, I like the dragon dance very much. Actually, I came here since the sun was up. The air is fresh.
That's wonderful! You know, many people have been waiting for the performance for an hour. The dragon looks really colorful with red and gold. Have you seen the lion dance near the noodle shop?
No, I haven't seen the lion dance. I guess it's very lively. Is it loud?
Yes, it's very loud and energetic, but everyone loves it. Actually, we are setting up the community center stage right now. Would you like to join us in making paper cuttings later?
I've never made paper cuttings. That sounds difficult. Maybe I can just watch.
Don't worry, it's easier than you think! You know, I made simple shapes last year, and everyone liked them. If you want, we can start with a flower shape. It only takes five minutes.
Okay, I'll try. It's interesting. By the way, what food is there for the festival?

There are many delicious options! For example, we have tangyuan with sweet soup, and people are eating spicy crayfish too. Also, the vendor next to the pond is selling steamed buns with pork filling. Would you like to try some?
I love spicy food. The crayfish sounds great. But I am not very good at walking in crowds.
You're right, the old town can be quite crowded this time of year. However, the community center has a quiet corner where you can sit and enjoy the food. I think it would be more comfortable for you.
That sounds good. Thank you. I will go to the center then. It's good to meet new people here.
That's great! In addition, we are having a small talk session in the center, so you can meet many neighbors. I'll meet you there in ten minutes. Have a nice time!

messages.content: Hi, I am Lin. I want to eat something cheap tonight. Do you know any good night markets in Guilin?
Oh, hi Lin! Yes, there is a famous one called the East Street Night Market. Actually, it is very lively right now. You can find all kinds of local food there.
That sounds great. What dishes are popular there? I like noodles, but I want something special.
Well, you must try the Guilin Rice Noodles with shrimp. It is delicious and not very expensive. In addition, you can order grilled skewers which are very tasty.
Okay, I have heard of the rice noodles. But are the prices high? I only have about 50 yuan with me.
Don't worry, the prices are quite reasonable. A bowl of noodles is about 15 yuan. You can easily buy three bowls with 50 yuan. Also, the fruit like watermelon is very cheap in summer.
That is good news. I am going to buy some watermelon too. Which stall do you recommend for the noodles?
There is a small shop near the entrance where the owner has been cooking since last year. The noodles are fresh because she makes them every day. Actually, many students like to go there.
I see. When I go there, should I ask for the spicy version? I can eat a little spice.
Of course you can! The spicy oil is very special in Guilin. Although it is hot, it makes the noodles taste better. You can also ask for less oil if you want.
Thanks for your advice. I think I will go there tomorrow evening. Do you know how to get there from my dormitory?
It is easy to get there. You can walk to the bus station and take bus number 30. It takes about twenty minutes. Or you can ride a shared bicycle if you are in a hurry.
Okay, I will take the bus. I haven't taken bus 30 before. What time does the last bus go?
The last bus leaves at around 10 p.m. So you have enough time to eat and walk around. By the way, remember to bring your umbrella because it might rain in summer.
Great, I have my umbrella. I am excited now. I will see you there if you want to join me.
That sounds like a plan! I guess I will be free tomorrow. If you go alone, tell me which stall you choose. We can compare the food.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I've been looking for a good place to eat in Guilin tonight. It's really hot and I'm very hungry.
Hello Lin! Well, you've come to the right place. The night market near the Elephant Trunk Hill is great. Actually, you know, the food stalls there are open until late.
Oh, I see. Is it expensive? I don't have much money right now.
It's not expensive at all. You can eat very cheaply there. For example, the rice noodles with meat are only about fifteen yuan. In addition, the grilled corn is very affordable.
That sounds good. What is your favorite dish there? Have you tried the local specialties?
Yes, I have. To be honest, the bamboo shoot soup is my favorite. It's fresh and delicious. You should definitely try it because the locals love it. The soup is hot, but it's not spicy.
Wow, bamboo shoots! I've heard of them but I've never eaten them. If I order that, what else should I get?

Well, if you order the soup, you should also try the stir-fried pork with green vegetables. It's a classic dish in Guangxi. By the way, the roasted sweet potato nearby is perfect for a late-night snack.
Okay, I'll try those. Actually, I'm a bit worried about the hygiene. Is the food safe?

Don't worry. Most of the vendors cook the food fresh right in front of you, so it's safe. I've been there many times since last year. Of course, you should choose the busy stalls because they are usually cleaner.
That makes sense. When I was in Changsha, the food was also very good. Do you think Guilin is better?
They are both good, but Guilin is special because of the scenery. While you eat, you can see the beautiful mountains and the Li River. It's a unique experience that you don't get in Changsha.
I guess I will go there tomorrow. Where exactly should I walk to find the market?
Just walk down Yongjiang Road towards the river. You'll see a big red sign for the night market. It's right next to the ferry station. Once you get there, you'll smell the food immediately.
Perfect. Thank you for your help, classmate. I'm excited to try the bamboo soup now.
You're welcome, Lin! Enjoy your meal. I hope you like the taste. If you want, you can join me next time I visit the market.
