messages.content: Hi Li, I'm Chen. I've been working from home in a small town near Dali for a month. It's nice, but I sometimes feel lonely because I miss my office friends. How about you?

Hello Chen! Well, I totally get that. I've been studying part-time in Lijiang since last year, and it's been a bit lonely too. Actually, I joined a study group last week to help. We meet in a tea house near the Old Town every Saturday.
Oh, that's a great idea. Do you study English there or something else? I think I need to improve my listening skills since I only watch videos on my phone.

Honesty, we study Chinese literature mostly, but we also practice English sometimes. By the way, have you tried going to a local university library in Dali? They have free English corner sessions where people speak with native speakers.
That sounds perfect. I haven't been to a university library near here. Maybe I can go next weekend. What kind of food do you eat there? I remember the dumplings in Erhai Village are really good.

Yes, the dumplings are amazing! You know, the university cafeteria serves hotpot on weekends too. It's very popular because the weather is getting cooler now. If you want, we can go there together next Saturday after our study session.
I'd love to! But I'm worried about my work. My boss says I need to finish a big project this week. I guess I should focus on my job first, even though I really want to study.

Actually, I understand completely. Time management is hard when you're doing both. In my case, I used to work late until midnight, but now I try to finish my tasks by two PM so I can relax. It's not easy, but it helps.
That's a good plan. I haven't tried setting a limit like that. Maybe I can stop working at two PM too. What if I don't finish the project? Will my boss be angry?

To be honest, most bosses prefer a rested employee who finishes later than a tired one rushing. If you talk to her, she might understand. You could say, "I've been working hard, and I need some time to recharge." She will probably agree.
That makes sense. I'll try to talk to her tomorrow. By the way, do you know any good apps for learning vocabulary? I use Duolingoingo sometimes, but I don't know if it's the best one.

Well, Duolingo is okay, but I think Anki is better for serious learners. It has more advanced words and you can make your own decks. Also, there's a great podcast called "Chinese Daily News" that you can listen to while walking around Erhai Lake.
Oh, Anki and the podcast sound useful. I'll download them tonight. Thanks for your advice, Li. It's really helpful. I feel less stressed now.

You're welcome, Chen! I'm so glad it helps. You know, balancing work and study takes practice, but it's worth it. Let's meet at the tea house next Saturday to grab some noodles and chat more. See you soon!

messages.content: Hi Lin, I've been working from the office in Erhai since last month, but it's hard to focus.
Actually, I've felt the same way. Although the view of the Erhai Lake is beautiful, the noise from the tourists makes it difficult to concentrate.
Yes, the people in the cafe talk a lot. Do you have a study group nearby?
Well, I joined a group in the old town of Xizhou yesterday. We meet there to review our lessons, and it's much quieter than the cafe.
That sounds good. Can you share the contact with me? I want to join if I'm busy with my freelance work.
Of course! Their WeChat ID is 'DaliStudyStudy'. Actually, they are very flexible, so you can come even if you only have thirty minutes.
I've tried to balance work and study, but I've been sleeping since last week because I stay up late.
To be honest, I think you need to change your schedule. If you go to bed earlier, you will feel better tomorrow. Maybe you should drink some milk tea before you sleep?
No, I don't like milk tea. I usually drink a cup of bubble tea instead. Do you think it's healthy?
It's not very healthy if you have too much sugar. By the way, try drinking plain ginger tea instead. It helps you sleep better and warms your stomach.
Okay, I'll try it. Also, my boss said I can work remotely from home in Dali, which is great news.
That's wonderful! If you work from home, you don't have to go to the office. You can study in the morning and work in the afternoon.
But I'm worried about the internet. The signal is slow here in the village.
I guess you can move to a place near the town center where the 5G is faster. Anyway, let's talk more about your plans next time.

messages.content: Hi Chen Yu! I'm Wei Lin. I'm thinking about taking the high-speed rail to Chongqing this weekend. Have you done it before?
Hi Wei Lin! Yes, I have. Actually, I've taken the train from Chengdu to Chongqing since last year because it's very convenient. It's super fast, you know.
That's great. Do I need to book the ticket in advance? I heard tickets sell out quickly sometimes.
Well, you should definitely book in advance, especially on weekends. If you wait until Friday evening, there might not be any seats left. I usually book my tickets two days before I go.
Okay, I'll book them soon. How comfortable are the seats? I'm a bit worried about the long ride.
Don't worry! The seats are actually very comfortable. They're like first-class seats on a plane. Although the train is only about 1.5 hours, it's smooth and quiet, so you won't feel tired.
That sounds nice. What about food? Can I buy snacks on the train, or should I bring my own?

You can buy snacks on the train, but the prices are a bit higher than at the station. I guess it's better to bring your own if you want to save money. For example, you can bring some spicy crayfish or spicy beef from a local market.
Good idea. I like spicy food, so I'll bring some. Do people usually eat on the train?
Yes, many people eat on the train because it's a short trip. By the way, if you bring hot pot ingredients, you might even find other people eating hot pot on the train! It's quite a fun experience.
Wow, that's interesting. I think I'll try that if it's allowed. When do you usually leave from Chengdu Railway Station?
I usually leave at 9 AM on Saturday morning. It's the best time because you can arrive in Chongqing by 10:30 AM. Then you have the whole afternoon to explore the old streets there.
Perfect. I want to see the Hongya Cave and eat some local snacks. Thank you for your advice, Chen Yu!
You're welcome! Have a wonderful time in Chongqing. If you need any more help with the tickets or the route, just ask me. I'll be happy to help.

messages.content: Hi Chen Yu, I'm Wei Lin. I'm planning to take the high-speed rail to Chongqing this weekend. Have you ever done that trip before?
Hello Wei Lin! Yes, I have. Actually, I've taken the train between Chengdu and Chongqing many times since last year. It's very popular now. Do you have the tickets yet?
No, I haven't booked them yet. Should I buy them in advance? I want to travel on Friday evening.

Well, you should definitely book in advance because the trains get very full on Fridays. In fact, many students from Chengdu go to Chongqing for food, so it's hard to find seats without a reservation. Have you checked the 12306 app?
Yes, I've seen the app. But I'm worried about the seat comfort. Are the seats soft enough to sleep on during the trip?

That's a good question. To be honest, the second-class seats are quite comfortable, but they're not as good as the first-class ones. They have reclining seats with leg rests, which is nice. If you book first-class, you can even sleep much better. What time do you plan to arrive?
I want to arrive by 7 PM so I can eat hotpot for dinner. Do you think I can buy snacks on the train?

Oh, yes! There are many vendors who sell snacks on the train. You can buy instant noodles, fruit, or even some local snacks from Chongqing like mianfen. However, you know, I think you might want to bring your own drinks because the water can be a bit warm sometimes.
That sounds useful. I'll bring some cold drinks. By the way, is it cheaper to take the train or to fly to Chongqing?

Generally, the train is more affordable than flying, especially if you book the second-class tickets. For example, a round trip ticket is about 600 yuan, while a flight ticket often costs over 800 yuan. In addition, the station in Chengdu is closer to my university than the airport.
Wow, that saves a lot of money. What about the weather in Chongqing this autumn? Will it be too hot?

Actually, Chongqing is known as the "Foggy City", and it can be quite humid in autumn. Although it's not as hot as the summer, the temperature stays around 25 degrees. You should pack a light jacket just in case. Have you ever visited Jialing Park there?
No, I haven't. I only know about the hotpot. When I get there, I will definitely try the hotpot. Thanks for your advice, Chen Yu!

You're welcome! I guess you'll love the food there. If you need any more tips on where to eat or how to get around, just ask. I've been to many places like Longhua Street, which is great for night food. Safe travels!

messages.content: Hello! I'm Jing Hua from Hangzhou. I have been looking for some good tea leaves to send to my friends back in the north. Do you sell traditional green tea here?

Hi Jing Hua! Actually, yes, we sell the best Longjing tea here on West Lake Old Street. I have been running this shop for twenty years, so you know I know a good thing when I see it. Well, the leaves we get today are very fresh.
That sounds wonderful. I guess I want to buy about half a kilogram. What is the price per gram? Is it expensive compared to other markets?

To be honest, it is a bit pricey, but the quality is different. The price is 800 yuan per kilogram right now. You know, we are using the spring harvest which is rare. If you buy a full kilogram, I can give you a small discount.
Okay, 800 yuan is a lot. I have only 600 yuan. Can we negotiate the price? Maybe 600 yuan for half a kilo is possible?

Well, 600 yuan is too low for this grade. However, since you are buying today, I can lower it to 700 yuan for half a kilo. That is a good deal for you, right? It is still better than the big supermarkets.
Actually, 700 yuan works for me. Do you have any other gifts for my friend in Beijing? Maybe some snacks or dried fruits?

Oh, yes! We have some local dried lotus seeds and sweet osmanthus cakes. They are very popular. Although they are not as expensive as the tea, they are delicious. You know, many people buy them as gifts for relatives.
That is a great idea. I will take one small box of the cakes too. How should I package everything so my friend can use it easily?

I have a nice bamboo box that is perfect for gifts. It is traditional and looks very nice. If you put the tea and the cakes inside, your friend will be very happy. Also, I can write a card with the name of the shop for you.
Perfect! Thank you for your help. I feel like I have found exactly what I need. See you soon!
You are very welcome, Jing Hua. It has been a pleasure talking to you. I hope you enjoy the tea and the cakes. Come back and visit us again if you have any questions!

messages.content: Hi Lao Zhang. I'm Jing Hua. I'm from Hangzhou, but I live in Beijing now. I want to buy some special tea for my friends.

Hello, Jing Hua! It's nice to meet you. Well, you are very lucky because we are at West Lake Old Street today. I have been selling tea here for twenty years, so I know the best kinds. Do you want Longjing tea?
Yes, I love Longjing. Actually, my family loves it too. But I don't know much about the quality. Can you help me choose?

Of course! Actually, the best Longjing is from the village near Xixi Wetland. The leaves are flat and green. If you buy tea from the West Lake area, it is very famous. You know, good tea smells like chestnuts sometimes.
That sounds interesting. I've never smelled tea like that before. How much do you charge? The prices in Beijing are usually very high.

Well, the price depends on the quality. For example, this small box is for tasting. It costs 120 yuan. However, if you want a big gift box for your friends, the price is higher. You can negotiate with me because I am a local vendor.
120 yuan is a bit expensive for me. Actually, I only need 500 grams for now. Can we make a deal? Maybe 100 yuan?

Hmm, 100 yuan is too low. That is not possible for good tea. But I can give you a special price. Let's say 110 yuan for the small box. If you buy two boxes, I will give you a free teapot. What do you think?
Oh, that is very nice! I'll take two boxes then. By the way, do you have other gifts? My friends like snacks too.

Yes, I have many things. You can try our traditional snacks like osmanthus cakes. They are sweet and smell like flowers. Also, we sell dried lotus seeds. They are good for health. Do you like sweet or salty snacks?
I prefer sweet ones. Actually, I'm not very hungry, but I want to pack a nice gift. How should I put everything in the bag?

Well, you should put the tea in a paper box first. It is very important to keep the tea fresh. Then, you can wrap the snacks in a red cloth. It looks very traditional and happy for Chinese New Year. I will help you pack it now.

messages.content: Hello Doctor Liu. My name is Ming Wei. I've been feeling very tired since last week.
Hi Ming, I'm Dr. Liu. I'm sorry to hear that. Actually, I get tired a lot in winter, especially when I work late in Nanjing.
Yes, it is cold here. I've been sleeping less because I'm busy at the office. Do I need to take medicine?
Well, don't worry about medicine yet. If you sleep more, you'll feel better. It's important to rest your body, you know.
That's true. But I have to go to Xuanwu Lake for a meeting tomorrow morning. Maybe I can drink tea instead?
Oh, a meeting is hard. Actually, green tea is great for energy. However, try to drink warm water first thing in the morning.
I guess I will try that. Where do I go next to get a prescription for vitamins medicine?
You need to wait in the queue at the pharmacy desk. It's a long line, but I can call your name quickly if you ask me.
Thank you. How much will it cost? Do I use Alipay or WeChat Pay?
Yes, you can use Alipay or WeChat Pay easily. The medicine is cheap, so it shouldn't be expensive for you.
Okay, I will use WeChat Pay. Can I pick up my prescription now?
Not yet. You need to wait for the nurse to check your blood pressure first. Then we'll give you the paper.

messages.content: Hi Dr. Liu. I've been feeling really tired since last week. I work in an office in Gulou District and I haven't slept well for a few nights.
Hello Ming. Well, I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. Actually, staying up late and working hard can make you feel tired. When did this start exactly?
It started about ten days ago. I've been staying up until 11 PM every night because of projects. Do you think I should take a rest day?
That's a very good idea, Ming. To be honest, your body needs time to recover. If you rest today, you will feel better tomorrow. Have you eaten breakfast yet?
No, I haven't. I was too busy. I usually drink some soy milk and eat a bun on the way to the subway. But today I didn't have time.
Oh, that explains it. You know, skipping breakfast is bad for your health. If you eat a little something now, your energy will come back. Let's do a quick checkup first.
Okay, sure. What tests do I need? I don't want to wait in line for a long time.
Well, don't worry. I just need to check your blood pressure and take a simple blood test. The wait might be five minutes. By the way, do you drink tea a lot?
Yes, I love drinking Pu'er tea. I usually buy it from the shop near Xuanwu Lake. But lately, I've been drinking less water because I'm busy.
That's interesting. You know, tea is good, but you also need plain water. If you drink more water, your body will work better. Actually, try to drink eight cups today.
Okay, I'll try. So, what are your thoughts about my tiredness? Is it just because I work too much?
Yes, I think so. It seems your body is telling you to slow down. Although you are young, you need to take care of yourself. If you keep this up, you might get sick.
I guess you are right. What medicine do I need? Can I take it home and rest?
Of course you can. I will give you some vitamin tablets and a bottle of vitamin medicine. You can take them after dinner. Actually, try to sleep early tonight, before 10 PM.
Thank you, Dr. Liu. I'll try to rest more. I'm worried about missing work tomorrow though.
You know, health is more important than work. If you rest today, you can work better tomorrow. In addition, take the medicine and drink some hot water. You will feel great soon.

messages.content: Hi Qiang, I'm so excited because I finally bought an old apartment in Tang Paradise Community in Xi'an.
Well, that's great news, Xiao Fang! Congratulations. I think buying a house in a historic district is a good idea, but it can be tricky. Have you started the renovation yet?
Yes, I've started. We've been removing the old walls, but there is so much noise. My neighbors are not happy.
I see. That is a common problem when you are working in Tang Paradise. Actually, the construction team should work only during the day, not at night. Do you know their schedule?
They are working from 8 am to 6 pm. But sometimes they make too much noise on weekends. I guess I should talk to them.
That is a good plan. You can ask the manager to check the safety standards first. By the way, have you chosen new furniture for your living room yet?
Not yet. I was looking at some modern sofas, but I think traditional Chinese furniture would be better for this old building.
You're right. You know, many people prefer wooden furniture from the local market because it looks more authentic. Also, it is quieter than modern materials. Do you have a favorite style?
I like simple designs. Actually, I want to buy a tea table because I love drinking tea in my home.
That sounds perfect! You could get a small table made by a local carpenter. It will fit the old room better. Oh, and did you check the electrical wiring in the apartment?
We are checking it now. The old wires are dangerous. If we don't fix them, it could be a fire hazard. We have to be careful.
Safety> That is very important! You must prioritize safety before buying anything else. Since the wires are old, you should hire a professional electrician. Do you know anyone reliable?
I will call my friend from the construction company. He knows many people in Xi'an. Thank you for your advice, Qiang.
You're welcome, Xiao Fang. I think you will make a wonderful home in Tang Paradise. Just remember to keep the noise down and check the safety first. Let me know how it goes!

messages.content: Hi Qiang Li. I'm Xiao Fang. I just bought an old apartment in Tang Paradise Community in Xi'an. I'm very excited but also worried because the house is very old.

Hello Xiao Fang! Well, that's wonderful news. Actually, Tang Paradise is a very nice historic district in Xi'an. I think the old houses there have a lot of charm, but yes, renovating them can be tricky.
Yes, exactly. I want to keep the old walls but I need new furniture. Do you know where I can buy traditional Chinese furniture here? I don't want to buy things from Europe.

Oh, that's a great idea. You know, there are several markets in the city center that sell authentic Chinese wood furniture. For example, you could check the market near the Bell Tower. It's much better than buying modern European styles.
Good. But there is a big problem. Since I moved in last week, the construction workers have been very noisy. They are drilling all day long and I can't sleep.

I'm so sorry to hear that, Xiao Fang. That's really annoying. Usually, the noise stops by evening, but if it's going on all day, you should talk to the construction manager. By the way, have you tried wearing earplugs at night?
I have tried earplugs, but they don't work very well. The noise is very loud. What if I complain to the neighborhood committee? Is it important to do that?

That's a very good question. Honestly, it is important to complain if the noise is too loud. The neighborhood committee in Tang Paradise is usually helpful. If you call them, they can check the work schedule and make sure the workers stop by noon.
Okay, I will call them tomorrow. Also, I heard that old houses in Xi'an need special safety checks. Have you checked the safety standards for my building yet?

Well, that is a very smart thing to think about. Actually, many old buildings here have hidden problems like weak foundations. I think you should hire a professional engineer to check the safety. It's better to be safe than sorry.
I agree. I want to fix the electricity too. Is the wiring in these old houses dangerous? I am a teacher, so safety is very important to me.

To be honest, the wiring in most old apartments is not up to date. It's usually very dangerous if you use modern appliances. You definitely need to replace the electrical system before you buy new furniture. Have you talked to an electrician yet?
No, I haven't found one yet. That is my next task. If I find a good electrician, will you help me choose the new furniture style?

Of course! I'd love to help. Once the safety is fixed, we can look at the furniture. Maybe we can find a shop that sells simple, traditional wooden tables and chairs. It would look very nice in your old apartment.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for your advice, Qiang Li. I hope the construction noise stops soon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jun. I've been living in Wuhou District for two years now. I really want to get involved in community work, but I don't know where to start.

Hello Jun! That's great that you want to help. Well, in our neighborhood here in Wuhou, we often organize cleaning days at the local parks. Actually, we just finished one last week near the Jinli Road area. Would you like to join us next time?
Cleaning'm interested in cleaning parks. It's good for the environment. Have you done it since you started working here?

Yes, I have! I've been coordinating these events for five years. In fact, we started a small group last year because people realized the trees needed more care. To be honest, it's tiring work, but everyone feels happy after finishing.
That sounds nice. What if I can't go to the park? Is there another way to help, like helping elderly people?

Oh, that's a great idea! We also have a team that visits the nursing home near Chunxi Road. They help buy groceries and chat with the seniors. If you're not good with gardening, this might be easier for you. You know, many young people like that.
I've never visited a nursing home before. Is it far from my office? I usually work near the metro station.

It's not very far. You can take the Line 3 subway and get off at Xinnanmen Station, then walk a bit. Although it's a short trip, the weather can be hot in spring sometimes. But actually, the seniors appreciate the company more than the gifts.
That makes sense. Do we need to prepare food for them? I'm not sure about Chinese cooking.

Don't worry! We usually buy simple snacks like mooncakes or dried fruits from the nearby market. By the way, the volunteers cook dumplings sometimes, but you don't need to do that. Just bringing tea is enough. I guess even a bottle of water is welcome.
I like the idea of bringing tea. Maybe I can bring some jasmine tea since it's popular here. What about organizing local events? Is that hard?

Jasmine tea sounds perfect for Chengdu! Regarding events, we often have small gatherings for Spring Festival or Dragon Boat Festival. Actually, it's not that hard because we divide tasks. Some people write banners banners notices, others decorate the hall. If you join, you can learn a lot.
I'd love to learn more. When is the next meeting? Can I bring a friend who lives in a smaller town near here?

The next meeting is this Saturday morning at the community center. Of course, you can bring your friend! In addition, we welcome people from surrounding towns like Jindian. It's always fun to meet new neighbors. Shall I send you the address by email?
Yes, please send it to me. Thank you for the advice. I think I'll bring my friend Li Wei.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jun. I've been living in Wuhou District for about two years since I moved here. I want to get involved in community work, but I don't know where to start. Have you done any volunteering lately?

Hello, Jun! Well, I think you're in the right place. Actually, we have started a new group for cleaning up parks in the Jiaoliu Garden area. It's been very popular since last month. You know, the air is fresh there, but the litter has increased a bit.
That sounds interesting. I've never cleaned a park before, although I used to do some gardening at home. What time does the group meet?

That's great to hear! We meet every Saturday morning at eight. By the way, if you join us, you can help pick up plastic bottles and organize the recycling bins. It's not very hard work, but it's useful for the neighborhood.
I see. Do you also help elderly people? My grandmother lives nearby, and she sometimes needs someone to talk to or carry heavy bags. I would like to help her too.

Of course! We have a team that visits the elderly in the Shuangliu community every afternoon. To be honest, it's the most rewarding part of my job. Many seniors, like Mrs. Wang from building 4, really need company. They often tell us stories about the past.
Stories about the past? That would be nice. I guess I have free time on Sundays. Could I join the Sunday afternoon group for the elderly?

Yes, you can! Actually, we are looking for young people who can help read newspapers or teach them how to use smartphones. For example, many of them want to video call their children. It would be perfect for someone like you.
That's a good idea. I can read Chinese well now. What about local events? Are there any events we can organize together this spring?

We are planning a traditional tea tasting event next weekend. Of course, we will invite local tea masters from the nearby market. In addition, we will have some simple games for the kids. It's a great way to bring the whole community together.
I love tea! I've tried many types, but I haven't tried the local Sichuan tea yet. Can I help set up the tables and serve the tea?

You would be a great help with that. Actually, we need someone reliable to manage the hot water kettle and the tea cups. It's important to keep everything safe and tidy. If you join, we will also give you a small red envelope as a thank you.
A red envelope! That would be wonderful. So, I can join all three groups: cleaning parks, helping the elderly, and the tea event. Is there anything else I need to bring?

Just bring a pair of comfortable shoes and a positive attitude! Well, we will provide all the cleaning tools and tea supplies. You've made a great decision to help your neighbors. We will see you next Saturday at the park.

messages.content: Hello! I am Hao, and I am a traveler visiting Lanzhou. It is very cold outside, so I want to try a traditional breakfast. Do you have something special?

Well, welcome to Lanzhou! Actually, if you are here in winter, you must try our hand-pulled noodles. But before that, let me recommend some steamed buns with preserved vegetables. They are very famous here.
Oh, really? I have never had those buns before. What kind of vegetables are inside? I like spicy food.
You know, we use pickled turnips and mustard greens. They are quite spicy, so it is perfect for you. By the way, do you like drinking soy milk with your meal? It is served hot and very filling.
Yes, I love soy milk! Although I usually drink coffee in my home country, I think I will try this. How much does a bowl of noodles cost?
Honesty, it is very affordable. A bowl is only about twenty RMB. In addition, you can add an extra egg if you want. I have seen many people eat here since the shop opened last year.
That sounds like a good deal. I am hungry now. Can I get one bowl of noodles and two buns? Maybe a cup of soy milk as well.
Of course! That is a great choice. While I cook the noodles, please take a seat by the window. The steam from the kitchen is nice when it is freezing outside.
Thank you. Actually, I have been traveling for three weeks. This is the first time I have eaten noodles like this. They smell delicious.
I am glad you like them! If you eat more, you might understand the local flavor better. You can also try the beef soup later if you are not full yet.
I guess I will try the soup if I finish my meal. Is this shop open all day, or just in the morning?
We are open until about ten in the morning, because the rush is over then. Anyway, your food is ready. Please enjoy your meal and tell me what you think afterwards.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Hao. I'm visiting Lanzhou and I want to try an authentic breakfast. Do you have any recommendations?

Hello Hao! Well, you've come to the right place. To be honest, our most famous dish here is Lanzhou beef noodles. They're famous because the beef is very fresh and the broth is clear and hot. I've been selling this since I opened this stall five years ago.
That sounds delicious. But I also heard about steamed buns. Have you tried them before?

Actually, yes. We serve a special kind of bun called "mantou". It's soft and fluffy, unlike the bread you might eat in the West. Many people like to eat it with soy milk in the morning. It's a great way to start the day.
I think I'll try the bun then. Is the soy milk sweet or salty?

Well, it's usually just plain and a little bit sweet. You can also add some spicy preserved vegetables if you want. They're very crunchy, and they add a nice flavor to the dish. I've been using this special soy bean since my grandmother taught me.
That's interesting. How much does it cost? I don't want to spend too much money.

You know, it's actually very affordable. The noodles are only ten yuan, and the bun with soy milk is about six yuan. So, it's cheaper than most hotels. You can eat well without worrying about the price. I think it's worth every penny.
I guess I'll get one order of noodles and a bun. Are they ready now?

Sure, I'll make them right away. While I'm cooking, did you know that the weather is very cold today? It's been snowing since last night, so the steam from the food feels really warm. It's perfect for winter breakfast.
Wow, that sounds cozy. By the way, where is this shop located? Can I find it again later?

Of course. We are on West Gate Street, right next to the old market. Many tourists visit us because the street is full of history. You can also see the red lanterns outside. I hope you enjoy your meal!
Thank you very much. I really appreciate your help. See you later.
You're welcome! Have a good day. Remember, if you want more spicy vegetables, just ask. They're really good.

messages.content: Hey! I finally arrived at the Northern Railway Station area in Xi'an. The weather is cold but the big red lanterns make the street look very warm.

Welcome home, Xiao! Well, it's freezing outside, but inside our kitchen it's already warm. I've been chopping vegetables since morning to prepare for the family reunion dinner. You know, Mom has been asking about you since you left Beijing.
I am so glad. Actually, I missed cooking dumplings with everyone. How many people are coming to the house tonight?

To be honest, it's going to be a big group. My dad, your grandparents, and four of your cousins will be here. We are still waiting for Uncle Zhang from the town near Fuguo. He said he would come by the evening train.
That is a lot of people! I have been away for two years, so I am a little nervous. Do you think the food will be enough for everyone?

Don't worry at all. My grandma is a great cook, so she has prepared plenty of dishes. Besides dumplings, we will have roast goose, which is a traditional dish in Xi'an. In addition, she has made some sweet and sour cabbage too.
Sounds delicious. I remember we used to make dumplings together when I was a child. It was fun. Should we start the dough now, or wait for everyone to arrive?

We should start the dough now if you want. Actually, the dough needs to rest for an hour, so we can use that time to talk. You know, your grandma loves to hear stories about your life in the big city.
I have many stories to tell. Actually, I bought some gifts for my aunt. She lives in a small village, so I hope she likes them. Do you think I should bring them now?

That is very thoughtful of you. By the way, you can bring them later after we finish dinner. Everyone will be eating first. Also, make sure to bring a box of tissues for your grandma, because she coughs easily in winter.
Okay, I will remember. What if it rains tomorrow? I am worried about the travel plans for the other relatives.

It might rain, but the weather forecast says it will clear up by afternoon. If it rains tomorrow, Uncle Zhang can wait for the train the next day. I think everyone will be happy to see you, even if the weather is not perfect.
I hope so. It has been a while since we shared stories about the past. I guess I need to buy more flour. Is there a good market near the station?
There is a small market just across the street that sells fresh flour. You can get there in five minutes. Well, let's go buy what we need so we can start the dumpling filling while the dough rests.

messages.content: Hi, I'm back in Xi'an for the Spring Festival. I've been away since last October, but I'm so happy to be home again.
Oh, welcome back! It's been a while. Actually, the weather here is a bit cold today, but the Northern Railway Station area is very lively because everyone is preparing for the big reunion dinner.
That sounds great. I used to live in Chengdu, so I'm not used to the cold. What are we cooking? I want to help make some dumplings.

Well, of course, dumplings are essential! My mom has been making the dough since morning. If you help fill them, we can make enough for everyone. Have you made dumplings before when you were in Chengdu?
Yes, I've made them a few times. However, I remember that the filling usually has more chili oil in my hometown. Here, the filling seems simpler.

That's true. Actually, our family prefers the traditional pork and cabbage filling because it tastes more like home. By the way, my aunt from Baoji is coming over to bring some dried mushrooms. She says they are very fresh.
Oh, I've heard of Baoji. Is it far from Xi'an? I think it takes about two hours by train.
Exactly! It's not far. I guess the train from Baoji to Xi'an is quite fast these days. While we wait for her, why don't we wash the vegetables? My cousin Li Wei is helping me now.
Good idea. I'd like to share a story about my childhood. When I was a child, we used to eat these dumplings every Sunday, not just on holidays.

That's a lovely memory. To be honest, I've forgotten some of those stories because I moved away so young. It's important to share them now so the younger generation knows our history. Did your grandparents tell you stories too?
Yes, they did. Actually, my grandpa told me about the Great Wall and how he climbed it when he was young. He said it was very hard work.
Wow, that sounds amazing. If you have time after the dinner, we could even go to the city wall together. It would be great to see it during the festival. What do you think?
I'd love to. But first, let's finish the dumplings. I also need to buy some gifts for my relatives. Do you have any suggestions?
Yes, tea sets are very popular these days. You know, my uncle likes collecting old porcelain. Maybe you could buy a nice tea set for him. Also, health supplements are good for the elders.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Yun. I just started my internship here at the tech company in Hangzhou. It's my first day.
Hi Yun! Welcome to the team. I'm Chen, a senior developer. To be honest, I remember my first day well; it was a bit nervous but exciting.
I feel the same. Actually, I've been studying computer science since university, but this is a new experience. Where should I sit?
You know, you can sit at the desk near the window in the Xixia District office. It's quite bright and quiet. Many people work there all day, but it's comfortable.
That sounds nice. I think I need a laptop though. Do I have to bring my own, or does the company provide one?
Well, the company provides a new laptop for interns the interns interns interns. In addition, they give you an account for the local cloud service so you can save your work safely.
Oh, that's great. What about the rules? Have you read the employee handbook manual yet? I want to know about the dress code.
Yes, I read it last week. Actually, you don't need a suit. You can wear casual clothes like T-shirts or jeans. By the way, everyone eats lunch together in the cafeteria at noon.
That's very relaxed. I guess I'll try that. Do you recommend any local food for lunch? I haven't tried Hangzhou cuisine before.
You should definitely try the West Lake vinegar fish. It's famous here in Hangzhou. Although it might be a bit spicy for some, it's delicious and very popular among us.
Spicy? I like spicy food! But I haven't eaten it since I was a child. Will the boss be strict if I make a mistake today?
Don't worry. If you make a mistake, we will help you fix it together. In fact, I made a big error last year, and my manager just explained it to me calmly.
That's reassuring. Since I'm new, can I ask questions whenever I want? I feel a bit lost sometimes.
Of course! You can ask me anything, anytime. I mean, it's better to ask now than wait and get confused later. Just raise your hand or send a message.
Thank you, Chen. I've been feeling anxious, but talking to you helps. I'll go get my desk set up now.
That's great! Well, take your time. By the way, if you want to relax after lunch, you can walk around the nearby Old Street to see the shops.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Yun. I've just started my internship here at Alibaba in Hangzhou. It's my first day, and I'm a bit nervous.

Hello Yun! Well, don't worry too much. It's totally normal to feel nervous on the first day. Actually, I remember when I started working here in Xixia District a few years ago, I was shaking hands too.
That's good to hear. What time does the meeting start? I think I might be late because I took the subway from Binjiang.

It's not a problem. The team meeting usually starts at nine, but we've been waiting for everyone. To be honest, the subway line from Binjiang is very convenient these days. Just let me know when you're here.
Okay, I'm here now. Is there a place to eat breakfast nearby? I haven't had anything since seven in the morning.
Well, there's a nice breakfast shop right outside the building that sells fresh baozi and soy milk. You know, it's much better than the fast food chains. Would you like to go there with me?
Yes, please. I'd love some baozi. How much is one yuan?
Oh, it's not that expensive. A steamed bun is about three yuan, and a cup of soy milk is two yuan. In fact, it's cheaper than the coffee shops on the corner. Come on, let's go.
Thanks. This baozi is delicious. Now, where should I sit? The office looks big.
You can sit at the desk next to me. Actually, we're in the development team, so it's quite busy. But don't worry, I'll help you set up your workspace.
I see. Do I need to wear a uniform? I'm not sure if I should bring my own laptop.

Well, you don't need a uniform. You can wear casual clothes if you want. As for the laptop, the company provides all the computers you need. If you bring your own, you might not be able to connect it to the network easily.
Oh, I forgot to ask. Is there a canteen in the building? I heard the food here is famous.

Yes, there is a canteen on the second floor. The food is really good, especially the braised pork rice. I've eaten there almost every day since I started. By the way, we have a free lunch for interns internserns.
That sounds great. I'll try the pork rice tomorrow. Thank you for helping me, senior colleague.
You're welcome, Yun. You know, you'll fit in very quickly. If you have any questions about the rules or the projects, just ask me. I'm happy to help.

messages.content: Hi Ah Qiang. I'm Lin Yue. I need to buy some fresh fruit for my family dinner this weekend. Do you have any lychees?
Hello Lin Yue! Well, yes, we have fresh lychees right here. They are very sweet and juicy. I have just picked them this morning, so they are really good. How many do you want?
Maybe five kilos. Actually, I also need some dragon fruit. Is it in season now?

Yes, dragon fruit is perfect for early summer now. It has bright pink skin and is very cool. Actually, my cousin who sells fruit says it is the best time to eat it. Do you prefer the red inside or the white one?
I think the red one is better. But to be honest, the price is a bit high for me. Can you give me a discount?

Oh, I understand. Well, if you buy both the lychees and the dragon fruit, I can give you a better price. For example, I usually sell the red dragon fruit for 15 yuan a kilo, but I can do 12 yuan if you take three kilos. What do you think?
That sounds okay. I'll take three kilos. And do you have any traditional snacks? My kids love them.

Yes! We have many traditional snacks here. For example, we have crispy roasted peanuts and sweet sesame balls. Actually, the sesame balls are very popular with children because they are soft and sweet. Would you like to try a sample first?
Yes, please. Oh, by the way, how much are the peanuts? I want to buy a bag for the adults.
The peanuts are 18 yuan for a big bag. They are roasted with Chinese spices, so the smell is amazing. Actually, many people from Kunming come here just to buy my peanuts. Is that okay for you?
Yes, it's perfect. I have 50 yuan, so I can buy the peanuts and the dragon fruit. Do you have any other recommendations for the family?

Well, I guess you should also get some fresh ginger or garlic for the soup. It is important for a healthy dinner. In addition, I have some fresh mushrooms which are very cheap today. You can use them for the stir-fry. Do you like mushrooms?
Yes, I love mushrooms. Let me buy the ginger and some mushrooms too. Thanks for your help, Ah Qiang. You are very friendly.
You are very welcome, Lin Yue! It's my pleasure to help a neighbor. Well, I will wrap everything for you now. I hope your family dinner is delicious. See you next time!

messages.content: Hello Ah Qiang. I'm Lin Yue. I need to buy some fresh dragon fruit for my family dinner this weekend. Do you have any good ones?

Hello Lin Yue! Yes, I have some very fresh dragon fruit. They are sweet and cold, which is perfect for summer. Actually, I just got them from a farm near Dali this morning. Would you like to try one first?
That sounds nice. I think I want them cold because it is very hot today in Kunming. How much are they?
Well, they are usually 15 yuan for a small box. But since you are buying for a family, maybe I can give you a better price. If you take two boxes, I can sell them for 28 yuan. What do you think?
Oh, 28 yuan is a bit high for me. I guess I only have 25 yuan. Can we make a deal? Maybe 25 yuan for two boxes?

Hmm, 25 yuan is very low for such good fruit. However, I know you are a busy professional, so I understand. Let's meet in the middle. How about 27 yuan? That is a good deal for two boxes. Of course, I promise they are the best.
Okay, 27 yuan sounds fair. Thank you. By the way, I also need some snacks for the children. Do you have any traditional snacks from Yunnan?

You are welcome! Yes, I have some wonderful traditional snacks. For example, we have roasted chestnuts and some sweet rice cakes. My daughter loves the rice cakes. They are soft and have a special taste. You must try them.
That is great. I like the idea of sweet rice cakes. But are they too sticky? My kids might drop them. Also, is there a place nearby to get some cold drinks?

Well, the rice cakes are not too sticky if you eat them quickly. You can also buy them in small pieces. As for drinks, there is a small shop just next to my stall. They sell cool lemon tea and coconut water. It is very popular since the weather is so warm today.
Perfect. I will buy the rice cakes and some lemon tea for the kids. Actually, I am worried about the price of the tea. Is it expensive?

Don't worry, it is very affordable. A cup of lemon tea is only 3 yuan. In addition, I can make a special family pack for you. It includes two boxes of dragon fruit, two packs of rice cakes, and three cups of lemon tea. How much do you want to pay for the whole pack?
Wow, that sounds like a good plan. I think 45 yuan for everything is okay. Is that a good price?

Yes, that is a very good price! Actually, if you pay 45 yuan now, I will give you a small red bag to carry everything. It is very convenient for you when you go to the supermarket or home. Shall we wrap it up now?
Yes, let's do it. Thank you so much, Ah Qiang. Your market is really busy today, but you are very helpful. I will come back next week if the prices are still good.

messages.content: Hi Li Na! I'm Zhang Xia. We just moved into our new flat in Xiangtan Road, Changsha. We want to renovate it, but it is very small.

Hello, Xia! Oh, welcome to the neighborhood. Well, small flats flats flats is very common in old buildings here. Actually, if you buy simple furniture, it will fit easily. Do you have any big pieces yet?
I have a sofa, but it is too wide. We are thinking of buying a new one since our living room is only four meters.
That makes sense. You know, a compact sofa bed would be perfect for your space. It can save room when you are not using it. Have you seen anything like that in the market?
Maybe. But I am worried about the noise. There is construction work next door, and it has been loud since morning.
Oh no, that sounds terrible. To be honest, the workers near my building were very noisy last year. Maybe you can ask them to work only in the afternoon? It is much quieter then.
I will try to talk to the manager. But right now, I feel like hiding because the sound is so loud.
I understand. You can put thick curtains on your windows if you want. They block some noise. Also, if you play soft music, it helps to cover the sound a bit.
Good idea! Now, about the walls. We want to hang some art. But where should we put them? The corners look ugly.
Well, try to hang pictures higher than usual. It makes the ceiling look higher, which is nice for small rooms. You could also use a long narrow painting instead of a big square one.
That is a good suggestion. Actually, we like Chinese calligraphy. Do you think it will fit well in a modern flat?
Yes, of course! Calligraphy looks very elegant. In fact, many people in Changsha have it. You can frame a vertical scroll and hang it on one wall. It adds a lot of character.
Great! We will buy some new furniture and maybe buy a small calligraphy scroll. Thank you for the help, Li Na.
You are welcome, Xia! I'm happy to help. By the way, if you need anything, you can just call me. Enjoy your new home!

messages.content: Hi Li Na! I am Zhang Xia. My husband and I just moved into this flat in a new residential area in Changsha. It is small, but we like it because it is near our work. We have been trying to decorate it since last month, but we feel it is still very bare.

Hello, Xia! It is great to meet you. Well, I moved into a similar flat in the same neighborhood two years ago, so I understand your situation. Actually, I think you should buy some light-colored wooden furniture first because it will make the small space look bigger. Do you have any plans for your living room?
Yes, we are thinking of putting a small sofa and a round table there. But I am worried that the construction next door will be very noisy. I heard that they will start drilling walls this week.

Oh, that sounds terrible! You know, the noise from the construction next to me has been really bad since the beginning of spring. Although it is annoying, I guess you can try to buy some thick curtains for your windows. They help block the sound a bit. What kind of style do you want for your furniture?

We want a simple style, maybe something like IKEA Chinese tea table. But we are not sure if we can find one that fits the room. Also, we have not decided where to hang the art on the walls yet. The room is very empty right now.

That is a good choice. By the way, my friends bought a small bamboo tea table from a local market in Hunan, and it looks very nice. As for the art, I usually hang my paintings lower because the ceilings in old buildings feel a bit high. Have you thought about what kind of pictures you want to buy?

We are looking at some calligraphy scrolls. I think they will look good on the wall. But I am thinking that if we hang them too high, people cannot see them well. What do you think? Should we wait until the construction stops?

I think you should hang them now! Actually, it is better to have the room look complete even if there is some noise. If you wait, the space might feel too empty for a long time. Also, you can just use a cloth to cover the wall later if you need to move things. What color are your walls?

The walls are white. It is a clean color, but sometimes I feel sad when I look at them. We want to add some color with the furniture and the art. Do you have any advice on where to buy cheap furniture in Changsha?

Of course! You should go to the furniture market in the old part of the city. It is a bit far, but you can find many small shops there who sell good things. In addition, they often have sales during the spring festival season. Have you checked the prices recently? They might be lower now.
Yes, I have been checking the prices since last week. I found a nice round table in a shop near my house. But the shop is very crowded. Do you think I should buy it there or wait for another shop?

Well, I guess you should buy it if you like it! Sometimes waiting too long means the shop will close or the price will go up. You know, I bought my first sofa there last year, and I am still using it. It is a bit small, but it is comfortable. How much did you pay?
It was a bit expensive, but it was good value. I think we will buy it tomorrow. I am hoping the construction noise will stop soon so we can enjoy our new home. Thank you for your help, Li Na!

You are welcome! It is my pleasure to help. I hope the noise stops soon for you too. Maybe you can invite me over for some hot pot when everything is ready. That is usually my favorite thing to do in Changsha. Let us know if you need any more ideas!

messages.content: Hello Teacher Zhao. I'm Liu Fang. It's a beautiful autumn day here in Shanghai. I've been wanting to practice calligraphy for a while, but I don't know where to start.

Hello Liu Fang! It's so nice to meet you. Well, you're in the right place. Actually, this park near Xujiahui is perfect for practicing brush strokes. The air is fresh, and it's very quiet right now. Do you like the smell of osmanthus flowers? They are everywhere this season.
Oh yes! The flowers are very sweet. I've tried to draw characters before, but my hand shakes too much. I think I need to learn the basic lines first. Can you teach me?

Of course I can! Actually, many people make that mistake. You know, calligraphy is not just about writing fast; it's about controlling your breath. Let's try the horizontal line. If you hold the brush like this, it will be steady. Have you joined any groups before?
No, I haven't. I usually go to the library to read books. But I feel a bit lonely doing it alone. Is there a club for old people nearby? I want to make some friends.

That's a great idea! To be honest, there is a weekly club on Wednesdays in the park behind the People's Park. Many retired teachers join it. They talk about the history of Chinese characters while they write. It's very fun. Would you like to go with me next week?
Wow, that sounds wonderful. I haven't been to People's Park since I was young. What is the history of calligraphy like? Why do people still practice it today?

Actually, the history goes back thousands thousands thousands thousands_2000 years. For example, Wang Xizhi wrote beautiful poems and letters thousands that are famous today. People practice it because it helps them stay calm. Although computers are everywhere, we still need the art to connect with our culture. You know, it's like a meditation.
I see. It's different from writing on a phone screen. I guess I should buy some special paper and ink. Where can I buy them in Shanghai? Are they expensive?

Don't worry about the cost! You can go to the stationery shop on Huaihai Road, or better yet, ask the club members to lend you some. The paper is special, but it's not very hard to buy. By the way, do you drink tea while you write? A cup of jasmine tea is perfect for this.
Yes, I love jasmine tea. I always drink it with my mother. So, what should I wear to the club? I don't want to look too formal.

You can wear comfortable clothes, like a light sweater. It's quite cool in the morning, but the sun gets warm later. Actually, most people there wear simple T-shirts or shirts. Just bring your own tea if you have it. I think you will fit in perfectly.
Thank you so much, Teacher Zhao. I feel much better now. I'll bring my tea and maybe my old notebook. See you next Wednesday then?
That's the spirit! You're very welcome. I'll see you there. It's going to be a wonderful day for practice. Enjoy the autumn breeze while you wait. Goodbye for now!

messages.content: Hi Teacher Zhao. I've been practicing calligraphy for two years since I retired. It helps me stay calm in this busy autumn.
That's wonderful, Liu Fang. Actually, I think this golden season is perfect for it. Well, the light is softer now, which makes the brush strokes look very smooth.
Yes, I agree. But sometimes my hand shakes when I try to write the complex characters. Do you have advice for beginners?
I totally understand. You know, it's normal to feel shaky at first. Try holding the brush with a relaxed grip. If you practice the basic strokes slowly, you'll improve quickly.
Good idea. I've joined a weekly club here in Shanghai since last spring. We meet every Sunday morning near the old pavilion.

Oh, that's great! There's a lovely group of elderly people who join that club. They are very friendly and help each other with difficult characters. By the way, do they have any new members this week?
Yes, there's a new lady from Suzhou. She says she wants to learn the history of Chinese characters because she feels lonely.

That's very sweet. Actually, calligraphy is not just about art; it's a way to connect with history. When you write an old character, you feel like you're talking to ancestors. I guess that's why many people love it.
Exactly. The characters from the Song Dynasty are beautiful. However, I find it hard to remember which brush to use for different parts.
Well, don't worry. You can ask the experienced teachers in our club. They usually bring extra brushes and show you how to use them. I've seen them teach many things since we started meeting.
Maybe I should ask them. But I don't want to disturb others while they are concentrating writing. What should I do?
That's a good question. Actually, most people are happy to help a beginner. You can just say, 'Could you please show me?' They will be glad to teach you. I think the atmosphere here is very warm.
Thanks for your help. I'll try it next Sunday. Do you like drinking tea while writing?
Yes, I love it! We usually drink green tea or Oolong tea. It's very refreshing and helps clear the mind. Do you prefer a strong tea or something lighter?

messages.content: Hi, I am Wei. I have been hiking in the mountains since last year. It is very fun!

That's great, Wei! Well, I'm a local guide here in Jinxian Township near Chengdu. I know the trails really well. Actually, autumn is the best time to hike here because the weather is cool and the leaves are colorful.
Oh, I love the colorful leaves. But the weather is changeable sometimes. It was raining yesterday while I was walking.
You know, that happens often in Sichuan. The clouds move very fast. I think you should bring a light raincoat just in case. If you don't have one, you might get wet easily.
I have a waterproof jacket. However, my shoes are not good for mud. Can I rent some boots here?
Of course, we have a small shop near the trail entrance. They sell good hiking boots for about 200 yuan. Actually, it's cheaper than buying a new pair. You should check the price before you pay.
Good idea. Where is the trail starting point? I want to go to Longquanyi Village.

Oh, I mean Longqu River. That's a nice place! The starting point is right behind the old tea house. You can take the bus from Chengdu, but it takes about two hours. If you drive, it's faster, but parking can be hard.
I prefer the bus because I do not have a car. What should I eat after the hike? I am hungry.

Well, after a long walk, you need some energy. We can eat hot pot at a restaurant in the town. Actually, the local spicy hot pot is famous here. It has many vegetables and tofu, which are very healthy.
Spicy food sounds delicious! I have eaten hot pot before, but this place looks different.

To be honest, it's different because the broth is made from fresh bone stock. It tastes richer than the usual kind. By the way, do you like drinking tea with your meal? We often serve jasmine tea here.
Yes, I love tea. But I need to buy a gift for my friend. Do you know where to buy souvenirs?
There is a market near the bus station. You can buy handmade bamboo baskets or local dried bamboo shoots. In addition, some people sell old pictures of the village. They make great gifts.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for your help, guide. I will go there tomorrow morning.
You are welcome! Just remember to wear comfortable shoes and bring enough water. If it starts to rain, don't worry, the mountains are still beautiful. I guess you will have a wonderful trip!

messages.content: Hi! I'm Wei. I have been hiking in the mountains since I was twenty. Today, I am standing at the foot of Mount Qingcheng in Jinxian Township. The weather is a bit cool because it is autumn.

Hello, Wei! Well, that's great that you have been hiking for so long. Actually, Mount Qingcheng is very famous here in Chengdu. To be honest, the weather can be unpredictable this season. It has been raining lightly here for the past hour, but now the sun is coming out again.
That sounds interesting. Do you think I should wear a heavy jacket? My old jacket is blue and it is a bit thin. I am worried about the wind on the trail.

You know, you should definitely bring a warmer layer. Although it feels warm down here in the valley, it gets much colder when you climb up. In addition, if you go higher than the pine forest, the temperature drops quickly. So, your blue jacket might not be enough if you plan to reach the top.
Oh, I see. If I buy a new jacket, it will be expensive. Do you know any good shops nearby? Maybe near the village entrance?

Well, there's a small market right near the ticket gate. You can find outdoor gear there, although the prices are a bit higher than in the city. Honestly, I think it's better to buy something comfortable and light. Heavy clothes will make you sweat a lot, and you don't want that on a hike.
That makes sense. By the way, what is the best food to eat before I start walking? I usually drink tea, but maybe I need something else.

Actually, tea is a very good idea! You know, the local oolong tea is famous in Sichuan. It helps you stay awake and gives you energy. For food, I would recommend some fresh dumplings or a bowl of beef noodles. They are delicious and will give you enough strength for the long walk.
Beef noodles sound delicious! I have tried beef noodles in Beijing before, but this one might be different. How is the trail from the village to the temple?

Yes, the noodles here are definitely different. They use spicy chili oil, which makes them very hot and tasty. As for the trail, it's quite steep at first, but then it becomes smoother. If you walk slowly, you can enjoy the view of the bamboo forest. It is very peaceful.
I like peace and quiet. If I go next month in winter, will the trail be closed? I don't want to be stuck at the bottom.

To be honest, the main trail is usually open in winter, but some small paths might be closed due to snow. However, the route to the lower temples is fine. You just need to wear good boots with thick soles because the stones can be slippery when it's wet. Have you ever hiked in the snow before?
No, I haven't. I only hiked in spring and summer. If I go in winter, I will need special shoes. Thank you for your advice, Guide.

That's okay! Well, buying good shoes is a smart decision. If you go in the near future, feel free to ask me for help. The air is fresh right now, so why don't you take a deep breath and start walking? It's a beautiful morning for hiking.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I live in Qingshan District in Wuhan. I want to join some community events this winter. Do you know any good festivals?

Hello Lin! Well, actually there is a big warm winter festival coming up. It happens at the Yangtze River Greenway near your neighborhood. People make paper lanterns and eat hot soup dumplings, which are perfect for this cold weather.
Oh, that sounds nice. I've been living here for three years, but I haven't been to the Greenway since the summer. Is it far from my apartment in Nanhu?

Not at all! It's very close. You can take the No. 4 subway line from Nanhu Station and get off at Zhongnan Huayuan. By the way, if you go early, you can see families who have been preparing red envelopes since last month.
That's great. I think I'll take the subway. But I am worried about the crowd. Do you think it will be too busy on the weekend?

To be honest, it can be quite crowded between the subway station and the riverbank. However, the festival committee has added more buses this year. If you arrive before seven o'clock, you can walk easily and avoid the rush.
Okay, I will try to go early. Are there other activities besides the lanterns? Maybe something for children?

Yes, there are! There is a calligraphy show by a teacher from East China Normal University. Also, kids can learn to make traditional snacks like tangyuan. It's a fun way to celebrate the new year, although the cooking area gets very busy.
I love cooking. Do I need to bring anything? I don't have a lot of time after work.

You don't need to bring anything. The organizers provide all the ingredients. Actually, I think volunteering is a great idea too. You can help set up tables or teach kids English, which is very useful for the international families in Qingshan.
That sounds interesting. How can I join the volunteer team? Is there a sign-up list?

Yes, there is. You can sign up at the community center near the subway station. They have been collecting names since last week. In addition, if you speak English well, they really want someone to guide tourists who come to see the fireworks.
Perfect! I can do that. I've been speaking English since I started my job last year. When exactly does the event start?

The main festival starts on the evening of the twenty-third of December. You should arrive at six o'clock to get ready. Well, if you have any questions about the route, just ask me. I know the area very well!

messages.content: Hi, my name is Lin. I live in Qingshan District, Wuhan. I want to join a community event next month because I feel lonely. Have you organized any festivals here recently?

Hi Lin! Well, actually yes, we just finished the Lantern Festival last week in Qingshan. It was really busy, especially near Hongshan Lake. I think many people joined the volunteer group to help decorate the street lights. Do you like traditional festivals?
I love them! I have never been to a lantern festival, but I heard the lights are beautiful. Where exactly did you organize it? Is it near my home in Qingshan?

Yes, it was near Hongshan Lake, which is about twenty minutes from your neighborhood by bus. In addition to the lights, we also had a local market with hot food. Actually, people sold Tangyuan and roasted chestnuts because it was cold. Would you like to try making Tangyuan next time?
That sounds delicious. I have not made Tangyuan before, so I would love to learn. If I join your group, what time does the event start? I usually work until six o'clock.

Oh, no problem! The event starts at seven p.m., so you can go straight from work. By the way, if you arrive late, the lantern making class starts at eight, but the market is open all night. Many young people like it because they can chat with their friends after work. Have you tried visiting the market in the evening?
I have been to the market, but it is very crowded on weekends. I guess I am worried about the traffic in Qingshan. Is there a way to get there easily?

You know, the metro is much better for this area. Line 4 goes straight to the lake station, and it is usually less crowded than the bus. In fact, I take the metro almost every time we organize events. Also, there is a parking lot nearby if you drive. To be honest, the metro is faster and cheaper.
That is good to know. I will take the metro then. What kind of activities will we do during the festival? I want to meet new neighbors.

Well, we have many activities. You can make paper lanterns, play traditional games like fan tossing (whirring fans), or just taste different snacks. Most importantly, there is a big circle where everyone shares stories. I think it is a great way to meet people. Actually, many volunteers are looking for helpers too.
I am very interested in sharing stories. Do I need to wear special clothes? I am wearing a warm coat because the winter in Wuhan is very cold.

Don't worry about your clothes. You just need to bring a scarf and gloves because it gets quite cold at night. Oh, and you can buy hot tea from the vendors to keep warm. By the way, I am organizing the next one for the Winter Solstice soon. Would you like to help distribute flyers?
Yes, I would love to help. Distrib distributing flyers seems easy. When will the Winter Solstice event happen? I have been busy since last month, so I need to plan my schedule.

It will be next Saturday, December 21st. If you can come, we will meet at the community center at nine in the morning. You know, it is not too far from your apartment. I hope you can join us because our group needs more volunteers to make it successful. Let me know if you can make it!
That is perfect. I will come next Saturday. Thank you for telling me about the festival and the metro line. I am excited to meet new people in Qingshan.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiao. I love trying new street food in Chongqing. What snacks do you sell here in Jiangbei District?
Well, hello Xiao! I'm selling classic spicy cold noodles, which is very famous in Chongqing. Actually, the sauce makes it really delicious because it has chili oil and vinegar.
That sounds amazing. I've never tried cold noodles in spring. Are they served hot or cold?
They are served cold, but you know, the flavor is so strong that it feels warm in your stomach. I make them with fresh noodles every morning at 6 am.
Wow, that's impressive. Do you use local ingredients from nearby towns?
Yes, of course! I buy fresh tofu from Yubei and vegetables from the market near my stall. For example, the greens I use today were picked this morning.
I guess I should try them since they are so fresh. How much is a plate?
It's only 15 yuan, which is quite cheap. By the way, if you buy two plates, I can give you a free bottle of soy milk, which is my special offer.
Oh, that is a good deal. Can you also sell sweet snacks for dessert?
Actually, I sell sweet rice balls too. They are filled with red bean paste and rolled in sesame seeds. Many people like them because they are not too spicy.
Red bean paste sounds tasty. Have you been selling here for a long time?
I've been selling here for ten years, since I opened my first stall in Nanbin Park. It's been busy every day, even during the rainy season last winter.
That is amazing. If I buy the noodles and the rice balls, will you put them in a bag for me?
Sure thing! I'll wrap everything in plastic so it stays fresh. Also, you can walk to the ferry station to cross the river if you want to see more food stalls.
Great idea! I think I will order both the spicy noodles and the sweet rice balls. Thank you!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiao. I love trying new street food. I've been to Wanda Plaza in Chongqing, but I want to find something more local today.

Well, you're in luck! Actually, right over here on the side street near the old railway station, there are many small stalls. You know, the spicy tofu brain is a must-try for anyone who loves hot food.
Spicy tofu brain? What is that? I've never eaten it before. Is it like soft tofu?

Yes, exactly! It's fresh tofu cut into small cubes pieces and cooked in a super hot soup with chili oil. To be honest, the smell is strong, but it tastes amazing. Many people come from Wanzhou district just to eat it.
That sounds interesting, but it sounds very hot! I'm not sure if I can handle the spice. Do you think it's too spicy for a beginner?

Oh, I think you can ask for less chili if you want. Although it's famous for being spicy, the vendor here can make a mild version. By the way, they also have sweet fried potatoes nearby, which is a great snack if you don't like very spicy food.
Sweet fried potatoes? That sounds delicious! I've had them before in Harbin, but I haven't tried them in Chongqing. Are they different here?

Yes, there is a difference! In Chongqing, they are usually smaller and have a slightly sweeter sauce with peanuts. If you eat them now, you might find them crispy and crunchy because the weather is a bit humid in spring.
I guess I should try both then. Actually, I have a little money left in my wallet. How much does one portion cost? I don't want to overspend.
Don't worry, it's very cheap. A bowl of tofu brain costs about 15 yuan, and the fried potatoes are only 10 yuan. You know, this is a very reasonable price for such fresh food in Jiangbei District.
That's great! I've been saving money since last month, so this fits my budget. Can I bring the food back to my office or do I need to eat it right away?

Well, you should eat it right away because the soup gets cold very quickly. Although you can take the fried potatoes home, the hot soup is best served fresh. I suggest finding a table under the big tree nearby.
Okay, I will try the tofu brain first. By the way, what is the best time to eat this kind of food? Is it better in the morning or evening?

It's a late-night snack for many people, but you can eat it at lunch too! Actually, since it is spring now, many locals eat it during the afternoon break to feel warm. Why don't you try a small bowl first?
Good idea. Thank you for your advice, I feel much more confident now. I'll order the spicy tofu brain and the sweet potatoes.
You're welcome! I hope you enjoy the meal. You know, if you come back next time, you can try the mapo tofu, which is another famous dish from Chongqing.

messages.content: Hey Auntie, I'm planning our New Year's dinner in Dalian this year. I want to invite my cousins from Qinhuangdao.
That sounds great, Hua! Well, you know, families are happier when they get together for Spring Festival. Actually, it's been over ten years since we had everyone in Zhongshan District like this.
I know. But my cousin Li Ming works in Shanghai now. He hasn't come back since 2020 because the trains were too crowded.

Oh, I understand. The high-speed trains are much better these days, you know? If he books his ticket in advance, he can arrive before the New Year. To be honest, I think he will miss the dumplings if he doesn't come.
You're right. I also need to buy a big fish. We always cook a steamed fish in Dalian. Do you remember how we did it last time?
Of course! We bought a sea bass bass fish from the market in Qianshui Road. Actually, you have to season it with ginger and scallions before steaming it. It smells so good when it's done.
I remember. And my grandma made the red bean buns. She has been making them since I was a child. What should we prepare for dessert?

Well, how about we make sweet rice pudding with osmanthus flowers? It's a traditional dish in many parts of China. In addition, you can buy some fresh osmanthus cakes from the old street near our building.
That's a good idea. But I'm worried the kids will eat too much candy. Should I tell them to stop?

Don't worry too much, Hua. Children love the New Year treats, you know. Actually, if you give them some fresh fruit like apples and pears, they will feel full and happy. By the way, don't forget to wrap the money in red envelopes for them.
Thanks, Auntie. I think I'll call my sister tomorrow to ask about the hotel rooms. They are very busy in February winter.
Yes, hotel prices go up quickly during the holidays. If you book early, you can find a better room near the beach. I guess we should also prepare some fireworks to celebrate at night.
Yes, fireworks are fun. But my neighbor says we can't use them in the city center. What should we do instead?
Well, you can watch the fireworks display from the park or the seaside prom. Actually, the light show on the bridge is very beautiful and safe. You don't need to worry about the noise.
Perfect. I'm glad we are planning this together. It makes me feel like home.

messages.content: Hi Auntie. I'm planning a big family gathering for Chinese New Year in Zhongshan District, Dalian. We're going to have dinner at my old neighborhood. What traditions should we follow?

Well, that sounds wonderful! Actually, in Dalian, we usually start by cleaning the house to sweep away bad luck since last year. You know, we must hang red couplets on the doors. Do you have those ready?
Yes, my mom bought them in the morning. But I'm worried about the food. My cousin in Wenzhou says dumplings are important, but I heard the south of China eats rice. Which one should we prepare?

To be honest, both are great, but for the New Year dinner, we often make jiaozi (dumplings) in the north like Dalian, even though the weather is a bit different now. In addition, the shape of the dumpling looks like ancient gold ingots, so it means wealth. Have you tried making them with pork and cabbage?
We haven't made them yet, but I've seen videos of it. My grandmother used to say that if you eat dumplings, you'll be rich. Is that true?

I guess it's more about the wish than the money, you know! Although the money isn't always there, we put a coin inside one dumpling. Whoever someone lucky finds it, they will have good luck in the new year. By the way, have you invited your uncle from Beijing?
Yes, I called him yesterday. He said he's coming on the high-speed train. But he wants to bring some gifts from the capital. What should we give him?

That's very thoughtful! Actually, people usually give red envelopes with money for children, but for adults, maybe some tea or dried fruits like dates and longan are nice. In addition, you could bring some local snacks from Dalian, like fried shrimp, which he hasn't tried yet.
I think that's a good idea. But I'm nervous because I haven't cooked a big meal since I graduated university. Can I do it?

Don't worry, you will be fine! Your mom and aunt can help you chop the vegetables. If you follow the recipe, it will turn out well. Also, remember that the most important thing is that we are all together. What time does the train arrive?
It arrives at 4 PM. So we need to start cooking around 2 PM. Do you think we should open the windows for fresh air before we eat?

Of course! In fact, opening the windows makes the room smell better before the strong scent of the food starts. By the way, have you decided what drink to serve? We usually have hot tea or some fruit juice.
I bought some oolong tea from Fujian province. It smells very good. Thank you for your advice, Auntie. I feel much better now.
You're welcome, Hua! Well, I'm sure the dinner will be delicious. Just relax and enjoy the time with your family. If anything goes wrong, we can fix it together. See you on New Year's Eve!

messages.content: Hi Lin, I have been working here since last year, but I feel my skills are not improving. Do you have any advice?

Well, Hi Jing. Actually, it is normal to feel this way when you work for a while. I have been here for five years, so I know the feeling. You should try taking online courses, for example, on data analysis or project management.
That sounds good. I have looked at some courses, but they are very expensive. What about workshops in our city?

To be honest, workshops are often cheaper than big online platforms. There is a training center near the West Lake in Hangzhou that hosts free sessions sometimes. You can go there to learn Excel skills or communication.
I have heard about the West Lake area. It is beautiful in summer. But I am worried about the time. My work is very busy these days.

I understand. If you are busy, you can choose evening classes or weekend workshops. Actually, I joined a night class last month, and it was not too hard. You know, a little time is better than no time at all.
That is a good idea. I think I will try one weekend workshop. Do you think it will help me get a promotion soon?

Yes, it might help. Managers conditionals, if you learn new skills, your manager will see your progress. For example, if you master data tools, you can handle more tasks. It shows you are ready for a higher role.
I hope so. My goal is to become a team leader next year. Should I also read books or just take practical courses?

Well, both are important. Reading books helps you understand the theory, which is very useful. In addition, practical courses teach you how to use the software. You should do a mix of the two to reach your goal faster.
Okay, I will look for a book about leadership. Thank you for your help, Lin. I will start this weekend.
You are welcome. It is a great decision. You know, I started reading a book last month, and I already feel more confident. I guess you will do well. See you at the office!
