messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing. I work in Hangzhou now. I've been here for three years. But I'm feeling a bit stuck. My boss says I need to learn more skills. Do you think online courses are good?

Well, Jing, I think online courses are actually a great choice. You know, I took a few courses last year to improve my data analysis skills. It was very flexible because I could study after work. Have you looked at any specific platforms yet?
Yes, I looked at some sites. But I'm worried about the cost. In China, things are getting expensive. Also, I don't know if I'll finish them. What do you think?

To be honest, the cost is a real concern, but many platforms have free trials low-price options. Actually, I found one that offers a scholarship monthly plan which fits our budget. If you finish the course, your company might pay for it. Have you talked to HR about this?
I haven't talked to HR yet. I'm afraid they won't agree. I like my job, but I want to grow. Maybe I should try a workshop instead? Workshops think workshops are more interactive.

That's a good point. Workshops workshops can be more interactive, which helps you learn faster. For example, there was a project management workshop in Xihu District last month. It was quite busy, but people found it very useful. Do you prefer learning alone or with a group?
I prefer learning with a group. When I study alone, I get bored easily. But workshops are crowded sometimes. Is it hard to get a seat? I want to improve my presentation skills too.

Oh, you're right. It's definitely hard to get a seat in popular workshops, especially during the summer season. But you can book in advance. By the way, presentation skills are very important right now. Many companies value people who can speak clearly in meetings. I think you should try to join at least one workshop.
Okay, I will try to book a seat. But I'm worried about the time. I have a lot of work. If I go to a workshop, will I miss my tasks? It's a difficult decision.

I guess it is difficult, but you can manage your time better. Actually, many workshops are held on weekends or evenings. For instance, there is a tech training class at a community center near Xianghu Park that meets only on Saturdays. If you balance it well, you won't miss your daily tasks.
Saturdays weekends sounds better for me. I can rest on weekdays. What about the future? Do you think I should aim for a higher position soon? I want to make a career plan.

That's a smart idea. Setting a career goal is very important. In addition to learning skills, you should think about where you want to be in five years. Honestly, I've been planning my promotion for two years now. If you improve your skills, you'll be ready for a senior role soon.
Thank you for your advice. I feel more confident now. I will look for a workshop on weekends. Maybe I can bring my colleague Li too. What do you think?

That's a wonderful idea! Bringing a colleague like Li is a great way to support each other. You know, learning together makes it easier to understand difficult topics. Let's hope you both enjoy the workshop and grow in your careers together.

messages.content: I've been planning a trip to Chengdu since last year. I want to visit my relatives there.
That's great! Well, I have taken the high-speed rail to Chengdu many times. It is much faster than the old trains, isn't it? Have you booked your ticket yet?
No, I haven't booked. But I heard the trains are very crowded during the Spring Festival. Is it true?
Yes, it's definitely true. Actually, the carriages are packed full of people during holidays. You should book your seat in advance if you can, because the tickets sell out very quickly.
I see. How long does the journey take from Hangzhou to Chengdu?

It usually takes about seven to eight hours. Although the train stops at some small towns like Jinhua along the way, the ride is still very comfortable. You can sleep on the soft seat if you book a higher class.
That sounds nice. When I arrive, I want to try the famous spicy hotpot. Do you know a good place?
Of course! There is a famous restaurant called Chuan Chao Ji in the Jinjiang District. It is very popular, so you might need to go early. To be honest, the soup is very hot, so be careful!
I will be careful. What kind of food should I order?
You should try the beef and tripe, which are the most delicious. In addition, you can order some fresh vegetables and tofu to balance the spice. It's really hard to stop eating, you know!
I guess I will have a lot of milk tea to drink after that. Where can I buy it?
There are many shops selling bubble tea in Chengdu. You can find them near the Chunxi Road shopping area. Actually, many people buy it with takeout food. Would you like to go there with me next time?
Yes, that would be great. Thank you for your advice.
You're welcome! I hope you have a wonderful trip. Remember to check the weather in Chengdu before you go, because winter can be quite cold there.

messages.content: Hi! I've been planning to take the high-speed rail to Chengdu since last year. Do you know the route from Hangzhou?
Actually, yes! I've taken that train a few times. It goes through Hefei and then to Wuhan before reaching Chengdu. It's very fast, about six or seven hours.
That sounds good. I've heard the tickets are hard to book during holidays. Is it still the same?
Well, it is still the same. During CNYNY New Year or National Day, the trains are very crowded between Hefei and Wuhan. You really need to book weeks in advance if you want a seat.
I guess I will book now. What about the food in Chengdu? I really want to try spicy hotpot.
Oh, you're in luck! There are many good hotpot places in the Jinjiang District. I recommend 'Chunxi Road' area. The soup has chili and peppercorn, which makes it very spicy.
Wow, that sounds delicious. I can't eat too much spice, but I want to try it. Are there any less spicy options?
To be honest, most hotpot is quite spicy, but you can ask for 'duanju' which means less oil. Or you can order some mutton and tofu, which are not as spicy as beef. It depends on the place.
That helps. By the way, is the weather in Chengdu cold in winter? I am worried about the temperature.
Actually, it is not very cold, but it is damp and cloudy. The temperature is usually around zero to ten degrees. It feels colder than the number says because of the humidity.
Okay, I will bring a warm jacket. What should I do in the evening? I have free time after dinner.
Well, you can go to 'Kuanzhai Alle Alley' to see the old buildings. It is very pretty at night. There are also street performers who play the erhu, which is a traditional instrument.
That sounds like a great idea. I think I will go there. Do you think the tickets to the train are cheaper if I buy them online?
Yes, you are right. You can buy them on the official app or website. It is much easier and sometimes cheaper than buying at the station. You don't have to queue in the cold!

messages.content: Hi, I've been feeling sick since yesterday. I have stomach problems again. Do you know the clinic in Wuhua District?
Actually, yes! I went to the People's Hospital in Wuhua District last week. It's quite famous, you know. The doctors are very experienced there.
That sounds good. But I heard the waiting time for appointments is very long. Is it true?
To be honest, it used to be terrible. But now, if you use their online booking system on WeChat, the wait is much shorter. You can book a slot for this afternoon easily.
Oh, that is helpful. I don't know how to use that app. Can you show me how to book?
Sure, I can help you. Well, first you open WeChat, then search for 'People's Hospital Kunming'. After that, click 'Appointmentuyyue' for appointments. It's quite simple once you see it.
Thanks! I will try it. By the way, what should I eat after the checkup? I have stomach pain.
You should eat light soup, like rice porridge or vegetable soup. Avoid spicy food or cold drinks. Actually, my friend recommended a clear fish soup, it's very gentle on the stomach.
I like soup. Do you think I should go there tomorrow morning or wait until next week?
I guess you should go tomorrow. The weather in Kunming is nice today, so you won't feel too cold. If you wait, the pain might get worse. Also, the hospital is open early in the morning.
Okay, I will book an appointment for tomorrow. Is there a waiting area nearby where I can rest?
Yes, of course. There are many benches outside the clinic near the Yunnan Garden. You can sit there while you wait. It's peaceful and there is fresh air.
That is perfect. Thank you so much for your advice. I will take a taxi to the clinic.
You are welcome! By the way, take a taxi instead of the metro, it's faster for short distances in Wuhua District. I hope you feel better soon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen Jie. I've been feeling sick since yesterday. I have stomach problems, and my stomach hurts a lot.

Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that, Chen Jie. I think you should see a doctor soon. By the way, did you go to the People's Hospital in Kunming recently? They have a great stomach clinic in the Wuhua District.
Yes, I went there this morning. But the waiting time was very long. I waited for two hours just to see the doctor!
Wow, two hours? That sounds terrible. Actually, I visited that clinic last week too. It was the same. The waiting time is usually long because many people have appointments at the same time.
That's not good. What can I do? I don't want to wait so long again. Do you know about the online booking system?

Oh, yes! You should use the online booking system on their WeChat app. It's much better. If you book in advance, you can get an appointment for next day or even the same day. You won't have to wait so long.
Really? That is helpful. I will try to book online tomorrow. But now, what should I eat? My stomach hurts.

Well, you should eat something very light. I guess you can try a bowl of plain rice porridge. It's easy to digest and very gentle on the stomach. Also, some clear chicken soup without oil is good for recovery.
Chicken chicken soup? Okay, I like soup. But I can't eat spicy food, like chili, right now. What about noodles?
Actually, noodles might be a bit too hard for your stomach today. You know, soft rice porridge is the best choice. In addition, you can drink some warm ginger tea. It helps with stomach pain.
Okay, I will drink ginger tea. Thank you for the advice. How much does the online booking cost? Is it free?
It is free to book the appointment, but you still need to pay the doctor's fee when you see them. The price depends on the specialist. If you book now, you might save time and feel better faster.
That makes sense. I will go to the hospital tomorrow morning. I hope I feel better soon.
I hope so too! Take care of yourself. If you need help with the app, you can ask the nurses at the clinic. They are very nice.

messages.content: Hello! I'm Wei Ming. I've been planning to hike in the mountains near Lijiang for a few weeks now. Have you done this before?

Hi Wei Ming! Yes, I have. Actually, I've hiked in the Canghaishan area since last autumn. It's beautiful, but the weather has changed a lot recently. You know, it can be very cold at night even in October.
Wow, that sounds challenging. I guess I need better shoes then. I only have sneakers from my gym.

Well, that might not be enough. To be honest, proper hiking boots are necessary if you want to avoid slipping on the loose stones. I've seen people get hurt because they wore the wrong shoes on the trail near Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
Okay, I'll buy some boots. What about water? Should I carry a lot?

Yes, you should definitely carry water. There isn't much clean water on the path, so you need to bring at least two bottles. In addition, if you forget your water, you might feel very thirsty and tired quickly.
Got it. Are there wild animals there? I heard some bears live in the forest.

Oh, yes, there are many wild animals. You might see deer or even snow leopards if you are very lucky. However, you must stay on the marked paths because it's dangerous if you wander off into the deep forest alone.
That makes sense. I really want to take photos of the scenery. Is it good for photography?

It's amazing for photos! The light is perfect in the morning. For example, the blue sky and the white clouds against the mountains look incredible. But you know, you need a steady hand if you want to take clear pictures without blur.
I have a good camera. What should I do if it rains suddenly?

If it rains, try to find a small cave or a rock shelter. You've probably seen that the rain can be sudden in the mountains. I think you should also put your camera in a plastic bag so it doesn't get wet.
Good idea. Do you think I should hire a local guide for the first time?
Yes, I guess you should. A local guide knows the best routes and where to find food like hot noodle soup after the hike. Actually, it's safer and more fun with someone who knows the area well.
Thanks for your advice, local guide. I feel much more confident now.
You're welcome, Wei Ming. You'll have a wonderful time. By the way, don't forget to wear a warm jacket in the evening. It's much colder than you think!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I have been planning to hike in the mountains near Lijiang since last summer. The weather has changed a lot though, so I am not sure about the conditions now.

Hello, Wei Ming! Well, autumn in Yunnan is actually very nice. It is cool and clear, but you know, the weather can change quickly in the mountains. Have you checked the forecast for the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain today?
Yes, I saw it online. It says it might rain later in the afternoon. So, what should I do if the rain starts while I am walking?

You should start early in the morning! Actually, if you hike before noon, you will finish before the rain comes. Also, you must wear proper hiking shoes. The ground is slippery when it rains, so regular sneakers are not safe.
I agree. I have a pair of good boots, but I forgot to bring them yesterday. That was a bad idea, wasn't it? By the way, do you think I need to carry a lot of water?

Oh, you had to use the taxi to get your boots today! I guess it was a bit risky. About water, yes, you should carry at least two bottles. Although there are small shops on the trail, you can't buy enough if you want to see wild animals like the golden monkeysibb.
Golden ibb? Wait, do you mean the snow leopardibb? I want to take photos of them. If I see one, I will try to take a picture, but I am afraid they will run away.

You mean the red-panda, right? I think they are very shy. If you are quiet, you might see one. However, you must remember that taking photos is important, but do not disturb them. For example, never use a loud camera flash.
I understand. I will be careful. Actually, I heard that the path to the glacieribb is very steep. Is it too hard for someone who just started hiking?

It depends on your fitness level. If you have been walking for exercise for a year, you can try the easy route. But if you haven't, I suggest you choose a shorter path first. You know, safety is more important than seeing an animal.
That makes sense. I have been running every morning since January, so I should be okay. Thank you for your advice, guide. When do we leave?
We will leave at 7:00 AM from the Old Town. Actually, 7:00 is the best time because the air is fresh and the light is good for photos. Don't forget to wear your warm jacket, it gets cold up there!
Okay, I have my jacket. I am excited now. I hope the rain stops before we go up the mountain.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Yue from Sun Yat-sen University. I want to volunteer at your community center in Haizhu District. Have you needed help recently?
Hello, Lin! That's wonderful. Actually, we've been busy since last month because many elderly people in Jiahua Community need assistance with digital devices.
I see. Teaching them how to use WeChat sounds hard, but I think I can learn. What do you usually do for the older folks?
Well, we organize small classes where someone helps them send messages or take photos. For example, last week we taught them how to order medicine online. It's been very satisfying for everyone.
That makes sense. Although the heat is very strong today, I guess I'll bring an umbrella. Can I help organize the events too?
Of course, you're welcome to help! In fact, if you like planning, we could set up a summer reading corner. We often serve fresh lychees and cold tea there so people feel relaxed.
I'd love to do that. By the way, does the metro stop near the center? I usually take Line 2 from the university.
Yes, Line 2 stops at Haizhu Square station, and it's just a short walk. Actually, we have a volunteer who met you there before; they know the way very well.
Great, I'll go there tomorrow. What if I can't come on weekends? I have a part-time job then.
That's okay, I understand. You could come during the week instead. For instance, we need help twice a week in the afternoon to build relationships with neighbors who live alone.
Twice a week is perfect for me. I feel really happy about this opportunity. Thank you for asking me.
You're very welcome! Honestly, having young people like you makes a huge difference. We'll start the meeting tomorrow morning if you're free.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Yue from Sun Yat-sen University. I want to volunteer at the Haizhu community center this summer. Have you ever worked there?
Well, actually, I've been coordinating activities there since last year. It's a busy place, but very rewarding. You know, helping the elderly with their digital skills has been a big project for us.
That sounds interesting. I have learned some English, but I am not very good. Can I teach English to the old people? Or maybe I should help them use smartphones?

To be honest, both are great ideas. Although teaching English might be hard at first, you can practice a lot. For example, we organize a small English corner on weekends. Many seniors want to talk to people from different places. Also, helping them use WeChat or Alipay is super useful.
Oh, really? I haven't thought about that. It is very important for them to pay bills and call their children. Do you need volunteers next Monday?

Yes, we do need more hands next Monday. In fact, we are planning an event for the International Children's Day, but it's still two months away. Anyway, if you join us now, you can help with the elderly first. That way, you will feel satisfied quickly.
I guess I can start helping the elderly. My grandfather often tells me stories about the past. I want to build relationships with them too. Is it difficult to make friends with old people?

Actually, it's not difficult at all. They are very kind and love to listen to young people. I mean, many of them miss having grandchildren around. You could bring some traditional snacks like mooncakes or osmanthus cake if you visit later this year. They love that stuff.
That makes sense. By the way, how do I get there? The metro is convenient in Guangzhou, right? I can take Line 2 to Haixin Road station.

Right, that is perfect. Haizhu Road station is close to the center. Once you get there, it's just a short walk. Also, the weather is hot in summer, so bring a bottle of water. You know, the AC inside the building is very strong, so dress lightly.
Okay, I will remember to bring water. I have been waiting for this chance to give back to society. When should I sign up for the forms?

Well, you can fill out the forms online right now. Just go to our WeChat official account. If you sign up this week, you can start helping immediately. I think you will enjoy the experience and meet many nice people.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Hao. I've come to Chengdu for the first time since I arrived yesterday. It is really cold outside tonight, but the street here looks very lively. Do you sell any hot food?

Hello! Of course, we have lots of hot snacks here. Well, our most famous dish is spicy beef noodles. It's warm and delicious, which is perfect for winter. Have you tried any local food before you came to Sichuan?
Actually, I have eaten dumplings in Beijing, but that was last month. I haven't tried Sichuan food yet. Is it really that spicy? I can't handle too much heat sometimes.

To be honest, it can be quite hot, but you can ask for 'micro-spicy' or 'no chili oil'. I think you will like the flavor of the broth. By the way, would you like to try a bowl of beef noodles with me? It's only twenty yuan.
Okay, I will try a bowl. I have my Renminbi with me, so I can pay in yuan. How should I order? Should I ask for extra garlic?

Yes, garlic makes the noodles much tastier! Just say, 'One bowl of beef noodles, micro-spicy, and extra garlic.' You know, many tourists love this combination. I have been selling here for ten years, and I know the best way to order.
That sounds great. While I wait, what else is popular here? I see some people eating skewers. Are those good too?

Oh, the skewers are excellent! We have pork and tofu on sticks. Actually, the cold tofu with spicy sauce is my favorite. If you want to share, you can take two skewers each. It's cheap and very fun to eat in the cold weather.
I guess I will have those skewers instead. Do you take credit cards, or must I use cash? I usually use WeChat to pay, but I don't have it on my phone right now.

Don't worry, we accept Renminbi cash, so you can pay with yuan. Also, many people use Alipay or WeChat, but cash is still very common here. Well, your food is ready. The noodles smell amazing, don't they?
Wow, it smells wonderful. I'll take the cash. Thank you for helping me order. The noodles look very thick. Is it hard to chew?
No, the noodles are soft and easy to eat. You know, the secret is the fresh broth and the spicy sauce. Please enjoy it while the heat is on. It's the best way to feel warm in this winter evening!
You are right. It is very warm now. I have never tasted such good beef. Maybe next time I will bring my friends from my hometown in Shanghai. Do you know Shanghai people like spicy food?

I guess some Shanghai people like it, but many prefer lighter flavors. Well, if they come to Jindu 9 Street, they will try the spicy food at least once. It's a great place to experience real Chinese culture. Thank you for trying our food, Zhang Hao!

messages.content: Hi! I'm Zhang Hao. I'm visiting Chengdu for the first time. Is this Jindu 9 Street busy right now?

Hello, Mr. Zhang! It's actually very busy tonight. Although it's winter and cold, many people come here because the food is hot and delicious. I've been selling snacks here for over ten years since I opened my first stall.
That sounds exciting! I really want to try some local snacks. Do you have any special dishes that tourists usually order?

Well, to be honest, our most famous dish is the spicy hot pot. It's a big iron pot with boiling broth, and you can put everything in it, like tofu, beef, and vegetables. Also, the glass noodle soup is very popular with foreigners because it's light but flavorful.
Glass I think I'll try the glass noodle soup first. It sounds like something I can eat quickly. How much does it cost in yuan?

The glass noodle soup is only fifteen yuan. You know, it's quite cheap for the portion size. If you want to add some extra toppings like minced meat or fried garlic, it will be twenty-five yuan. Would you like to order now?
Yes, please. I'll take the glass noodle soup with some fried garlic. Oh, and do you also sell other drinks? I need something warm because it is freezing outside.

Of course! We have hot jasmine tea which goes well with the spicy food. It helps clear the heat. By the way, if you drink tea while eating, you will feel much better. I'll bring your bowl of noodles and a cup of tea right away.
Thank you. While you are preparing the food, could you recommend another dish? I have heard about the mapo tofu here. Is it as spicy as the hot pot?

Actually, mapo tofu is not as hot as the hot pot, but it still has a strong flavor. It's made with soft tofu, minced pork, and a special sauce that is very aromatic. Many people think it's easier to eat than the spicy hot pot. I make it fresh every day, so it tastes great.
That sounds nice. I guess I might try the mapo tofu after my noodles. Can I pay with my phone or do I need cash in yuan?

You can pay with your phone, or you can use cash. Many tourists use Alipay or WeChat to pay now. It's very convenient. Anyway, your food is ready. Please sit down and enjoy the warm atmosphere of Jindu 9 Street.
It smells amazing! The noodles look wonderful. How long have you lived in Chengdu? Have you moved here from another city?

I was born and raised in Chengdu, so I've lived here my whole life. Actually, my family has been running a small food shop in this neighborhood for three generations. I love this city because the people are friendly and the food culture is very important to us.
That is really interesting. I feel very happy eating here. What should I do next? Should I go to Wuhou Temple later?

That's a great idea! Wuhou Temple is near here, and you can walk there if you finish your meal. It's a historic place where you can see ancient buildings and buy souvenirs. Although it might be a bit far, the walk is nice in the evening.

messages.content: It's late afternoon, and I'm sitting in the garden of our old house in Pingtan. I've been thinking about a weekend trip with my family, but I'm not sure where to go. Have you decided on a destination lately?
Well, I have been planning this for weeks! Actually, I think Suqian is a great choice. It has beautiful gardens, and we haven't visited since last year. What do you think about it?
That sounds nice, although I am worried about the traffic. I don't want to spend too much time on the train. Is it easy to book tickets to Suqian?
You know, booking tickets isn't hard. You can buy them online using your ID card. By the way, if we go during the spring holiday, it might be crowded, so we should book a few days in advance.
I guess you are right. I have been working too hard, and I need a break. What about the food? I love Jiangsu cuisine, but I don't know what to eat there.

To be honest, Suqian has amazing local food! We can try Shaoxian rice noodles or Yangzhou fried rice. Actually, there is a famous restaurant near the railway station that serves fresh crab, which is delicious.
Wow, I have never tried those noodles before. Do I need to pack special luggage for a train trip? My suitcase is full of clothes for work.

Well, you don't need a big suitcase if you plan to stay for just two days. I suggest packing a light bag with some t-shirts and pajamas. Also, don't forget to bring your swimming suit because we can swim in the Yangtze River nearby.
That is a good idea. I will pack lighter. How much will the train ticket cost for four of us? I want to save some money for dinner.

I think the ticket is about 150 yuan per person, so the total is around 600 yuan. It's cheaper than flying, and the journey takes only three hours. You can use your mobile phone to pay at the station now.
Okay, I feel better now. I think we should go there next month. What if we decide to go to Nanjing instead? Is that a better option?

That's a valid question. Nanjing is bigger, but it's also more crowded during holidays. If you want a quiet place, Suqian is better because it's smaller. However, if you like history, Nanjing has many famous palaces.
I guess we will choose Suqian then. I hope we can make wonderful memories with our family. Thank you for your help with the plan.
Of course! I am sure you will have a great time. Remember to check the weather forecast before you leave, just in case it rains. I look forward to seeing you there!

messages.content: Hey, Li Hua. It is a nice spring afternoon here in Suzhou. I am thinking about planning a weekend trip with my family. What do you think?
That sounds great, Xiao! Well, the weather is perfect for a getaway right now. Actually, have you considered going to Wuxi? It is not too far from here, and the lakes are very beautiful.
Wuxi? I have heard about it, but I am not sure if we should go. We need to book train tickets soon. Have you ever taken the high-speed train since last year?

Yes, I have! It is much faster than before. Actually, if you book the tickets on the official app, you can save a lot of money. By the way, it takes only about two hours to get there. That is very convenient for a family trip.
Oh, that is good news. What about packing luggage? Do you think we need to bring warm clothes, or is it hot enough now?

To be honest, spring in Wuxi is mild, but it can be a bit cool in the evening. I think you should pack light jackets just in case. Also, don't forget your umbrellas because it rains sometimes. What about your kids? Are they excited?
They are very happy! My daughter, Yaoyao, wants to eat traditional food. Do you know where we can find good local snacks in Wuxi?

Of course! You must try the Xiao Long Bao, which are soup dumplings. There is a famous shop near the Old Street. In addition, they serve sweet rice balls there too. It is delicious, you know. Have you ever eaten them before?
I have not. I guess I should try them this time. Also, what should we do after eating? Maybe take a walk in the garden?

Yes, that is a great idea. There are many classical gardens in Wuxi, and the one by the Taihu Lake is famous. If you go there, you can see the peach blossoms if the season is right. It will be a wonderful memory for the whole family.
I really think it is a good plan. When do you think we should leave? Maybe this Saturday?

That works well for me. Actually, we should leave early in the morning to avoid the crowds. If we wait until the afternoon, the trains might be full. Let me check the schedule on my phone while you pack your bags.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I've been planning to go to Hangzhou since last week because the weather is getting cooler in Chengdu.
Hey, Wei Ming! That's a great idea. Actually, autumn is the best time to visit Hangzhou. The West Lake looks really beautiful when the leaves turn yellow. Have you ever been there before?
No, I haven't. I only know about the Longjing tea from my uncle who lives there. Do I need to buy a ticket for the high-speed rail?
Well, yes, you need a ticket for the G train from Chengdu East to Hangzhou East. It's super fast, only about six hours. By the way, did you check the price since the rates changed last month?
I checked, but it's a bit expensive for me. If I go on Friday night, will I save money?

That's true, weekend tickets are usually cheaper. However, it might be very crowded if you travel on Friday. To be honest, I think going on a Tuesday or Wednesday is better because trains are less busy. What do you think?
I guess I'll try the Tuesday option. What should I eat when I arrive? My friend says the noodles are famous there.

Oh, you're talking about Luosifen or maybe the famous Shengjian mantou in the night market? Actually, the local people love the Dongpo pork ribs too. It's very delicious and goes well with rice. Which one do you like more?
I like the ribs. Are they spicy? I can't eat very hot food. Also, where is the best place to find them?

Don't worry, the Dongpo pork is sweet and tender, not spicy at all. You can find the best ones near Qianjiang Road. It's a long street full of old shops. If you go there, you can also see the boat tours on the lake.
That sounds perfect. How much does a round-trip ticket cost now? I'm trying to save money for my trip.
Right now, a second-class seat is around 400 to 500 yuan if you book early. You can use Alipay or WeChat to pay easily. Anyway, have you decided which hotel to stay in the Su Causeway area?
Not yet. I want a quiet place. Do you have any recommendations for a small town near Hangzhou?
You know, Xixi Wetland is just nearby and it's very quiet and peaceful. You can stay in a traditional B&B there. It's much cheaper than the city center. I think you'll love the silence there.
That sounds nice. I'll book the train for Tuesday and look for a place in Xixi. Thanks for your advice, Li Hua!
You're welcome! Enjoy your trip to Hangzhou. I'm sure the West Lake and the tasty food will make your holiday unforgettable. Let me know how it goes!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I have been planning a trip to Hangzhou since last month. What do you think?
Hello, Wei Ming! That sounds like a great idea. Actually, I have visited Hangzhou many times, so I can give you some good advice. The high-speed rail from Chengdu to Hangzhou is very fast now.
Oh, really? How long does it take if I book a ticket on the G31 line? I want to go there during the National Day holiday.

Well, the journey usually takes about four hours on that line. But be careful, tickets sell out quickly in October because many people want to see West Lake. You might need to book them weeks in advance.
I see. When I get there, I really want to eat local food. Do you know any famous snacks in Hangzhou? I love dumplings, but maybe something else?
Of course! You should try Dongpo pork, which is a famous dish from Su Zhe cuisine. Also, Longjing shrimp is very delicious. By the way, have you ever tried the fresh Longjing tea with it?
No, I haven't tried the tea before. Where is the best place to buy it? Is it near the West Lake or in a market?
To be honest, the best shops are near the Longjing village in Linping county. However, you can also find good quality tea in the marketplace near the old city gate. It is much cheaper there.
That is useful information. If I book a hotel in Xixi Wetland, will it be far from the tea shops? I guess I don't want to spend too much time on the subway.

Xixi Wetland is a bit far from the tea plantations. Actually, you might want to stay closer to the city center if you want to visit both easily. The subway Line 1 connects them, but it can be crowded during the holiday.
Oh, I didn't know that. What if I take a taxi instead? Is it expensive to hire one from the hotel to the tea market?

It depends on the traffic. A taxi is convenient, but the fare might be high during rush hour. In addition, the roads can be very busy in Hangzhou on weekends. Maybe consider the metro if you have a student card?
I have a student card, so that is good news. Thank you for your help. I will start looking for tickets soon so I don't miss the trip.
You are welcome! I hope you have a wonderful time seeing the West Lake and tasting the local snacks. Please let me know if you need more suggestions before you go.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Zhang Qiang. I work in an office in Wuhan and I feel very tired these days. I want to start a yoga class, but I don't have much time.

Hello, Zhang Qiang! Well, it's common for office workers to feel tired, especially in spring when the weather gets a bit warmer. Actually, many people in Jiang'an District take yoga to relax after work. Do you prefer morning classes or evening ones?
I think evening is better because I finish work at six. But I'm worried I can't keep up. My boss told me to lose weight last year, but I haven't changed my diet much.

Oh, I understand. To be honest, setting realistic goals is very important. If you eat less rice and more vegetables, like steamed broccoli or tofu, you will see results. Also, a forty-minute class is enough if you go three times a week. What kind of food do you usually eat for lunch?
I usually eat fried rice and sometimes meat. I know I should eat healthier, but it's hard. I also drink a lot of bubble tea after work. I guess I should stop.

That's true, bubble tea is popular in Wuhan, but it has a lot of sugar. You know, you could try drinking hot green tea or plain water instead. If you replace one sugary drink a day with tea, you will feel lighter. By the way, do you live near the gym?
I live in a small apartment in Hongshan District, which is a bit far from here. I took the metro once, but it was crowded. Maybe I should buy a yoga mat and do exercises at home?

Well, the metro can be very busy on weekends, especially between Hongshan and Jiang'an. However, doing yoga at home is a good idea if you don't have time to travel. Actually, a simple mat and some videos on your phone work well. Would you like to try a free trial class here first?
Yes, a trial class sounds good. I want to try the stretching exercises. I feel stiff in my back because I sit all day. But I am afraid I will make mistakes.

Don't worry! You know, everyone makes mistakes when they start. In fact, our instructor is very patient and helps people correct their posture. If you join the class this weekend, you can meet other people who also want to improve their health. It's a great way to stay motivated.
That makes me feel better. When is the next class? I might need to take a taxi to get there since I don't have a car.

Of course, taxis are convenient in Wuhan, especially during rush hour. We have a class on Saturday at ten o'clock. It's not too early, so you can take a rest before it starts. In addition, we offer a special discount for new members. What do you think?
I think I will try it. Thank you for your advice. I hope I can feel less stressed soon.
You're welcome! I'm sure you will feel better soon. Remember, small changes make a big difference. See you at the gym next Saturday! Have a nice evening.

messages.content: Hi, I am Zhang Qiang. I work in an office here in Jiang'an District, Wuhan. I feel stressed because of my job, so I want to do yoga.
Hello, Qiang! Well, it is great that you want to improve your health. Actually, yoga is perfect for reducing stress. How long have you been thinking about joining a class?
I have been thinking about it for three months, but I did not start yet. I am busy with work since last October.
I understand, work can be very demanding. You know, many people in Wuhan feel the same way in spring. If you join a class this week, you will feel better quickly.
Maybe. But I also eat a lot of rice and hot pot. I think my diet is not good for my stomach.
That is a common problem! Honestly, eating too much spicy hot pot can cause discomfort. You could try eating more vegetables and less oil, like in a healthy stir-fry.
I guess I will try to eat less rice. Do you think I should drink green tea instead of coffee?
Yes, green tea is excellent! It helps you relax, unlike coffee which keeps you awake. By the way, do you live near a supermarket in Jiang'an District?
Yes, I live near a small market on Zhongshan Road. But the prices are high, so I usually buy food from my aunt in Hubei.
That is a good idea! Family food is often cheaper and healthier. Well, if you start yoga twice a week and drink tea, you will see changes soon.
I hope so. Actually, I was running last week, but I felt very tired after work. I did not continue.
I mean, running is great, but yoga is gentler for tired muscles. You could try a slow walk in the park near the Yangtze River instead.
That sounds nice. I will try to go there on Sunday. What do you think?
Sounds like a perfect plan! You know, a Sunday walk will help you rest before the busy work week. Let us start yoga together next Monday?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen Lei. I just bought this apartment in Haizhu District, Guangzhou, and I want to renovate it. Have you ever helped people with this before?

Hello, Chen! Yes, I've worked on many small apartments in Haizhu since last year. Actually, the winter weather here isn't the best for painting, but we can still do some internal work. What is your favorite color for the walls?
I like light colors. My friends say white is too boring. I think a soft blue might be good, but I'm not sure. Do you agree?
I think you're right, because pure white can feel cold in winter. Well, a soft blue would make the room feel cozy and modern. By the way, have you decided which brand of paint to buy yet?
No, I haven't. I want to hire a contractor first. Should I look for someone near my apartment or can I go to a big market?

Of course, you can go to a big market, but I recommend hiring a local expert from the neighborhood. Actually, there are many skilled workers in the nearby towns like Panyu who know the style well. Who do you think you want to hire?
That sounds good. I also need to buy furniture. I don't want big sofas because the apartment is small. What do you suggest?

I agree, because a big sofa will make the space feel crowded. You know, you could buy a compact sofa bed or a stylish ratt which is popular in Guangzhou now. Also, do you have a budget for the furniture?
Yes, I have about 10,000 yuan. I want to spend half on the sofa and the rest on other things. Is that enough?

That's a reasonable budget, but it might be tight if you buy everything new. Honestly, you could buy a second-hand table from a local market to save money. If you do that, you can spend more on a better sofa.
Good idea. I will check the second-hand market next weekend. What about the floor? Should I change the tiles or keep them?

Well, you should keep the tiles if they are in good condition, because replacing them is expensive and messy. Actually, you can just clean them and add a nice rug to make the room warmer. Do you have a rug already?
No, I don't. Maybe I can buy a small rug from a shop. Thank you for your help, I feel much more confident now.

You're welcome, Chen! I'm glad you feel better. To be honest, renovating a new place is exciting. If you need any more advice about the transit lines near Haizhu or local food, just let me know. I'll help you.

messages.content: Hi, I am Chen Lei. I just moved into my new apartment in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. The walls are white now, but I want to change them. What color should I pick?

Well, actually, white is a good start, but you can make the small room look bigger with light colors. For example, a soft grey or a very pale blue would work well here. I think you should avoid dark colors because they make the space feel smaller.
That is a good idea. I like the grey color. But I am worried about the cost. Is it expensive to paint?

To be honest, painting is not that expensive if you do it yourself. However, if you hire a contractor, it will cost more. You know, there are many painters small teams in this neighborhood who charge a fair price. Have you thought about hiring someone?
Yes, I have been thinking about it. I do not want to make a mistake. Can I ask a friend to help me choose the contractor?

That is a smart move. You can ask your friend who is also from this area. Actually, they might know some reliable workers who have good reviews. It is better to check their references before you sign any contract.
Okay, I will ask him. After the painting, I need to buy furniture. Do you have any suggestions for a small apartment?

Well, for a small place, you should choose multi-functionalunctional furniture. For example, a sofa bed or a foldable table is very useful. I have seen some good pieces from a local brand called Jiaju that are quite comfortable. You can check them out.
I have heard of Jiaju. They make nice things. But I am not sure about the price. It is winter now, so the furniture shop might be closed?

Oh, no worries. Most furniture shops are still open in winter, especially on weekdays. Actually, many stores have sales now because it is the slow season. You can save some money if you buy soon. Why don't we go together this weekend?
That sounds great. I will bring my friend then. By the way, where do you recommend buying the sofa? In the city center or in a suburban mall?

I think a suburban mall is better. It is less crowded and you can get more space to test the sofa. For example, the new shopping center in Zengcheng is quite nice and not too far from here. You can drive there easily.
Driving is a bit hard for me right now. Can I take the metro to get there? Is it convenient?

Of course, the metro is very convenient in Guangzhou. You can take Line 13 from Haizhu to get to Zengcheng. It takes about an hour, but it is much cheaper than a taxi. You know, you can even buy a cheap coffee at the station on the way.
That is perfect. I will take the metro. I am really excited about making my home look good. Thank you for your help, teacher.
You are welcome! I am happy to help. Actually, making a home is a very important decision. I guess you will enjoy your new living room a lot once it is finished. Good luck with the renovation!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Fang. I've been hiking in the Stone Forest for a few years since I retired last year. It's been my favorite hobby.

Hello, Mrs. Liu! Well, it's great to meet you. The Stone Forest is beautiful, especially in the summer morning when it's not too hot. I'm actually a volunteer park ranger here, so I love sharing tips with visitors like you.
That's nice of you. I usually go up to the top trail, but I haven't seen many animals there. Do you think wildlife watching is possible?

Actually, yes! There are many small birds and even some rare frogsizards monkeys here. For example, if you go early, you might see a golden phe monkey. They are very shy, so you have to be quiet. Have you ever seen one before?
I think I saw something yellow yesterday, but I wasn't sure. It was hard to tell because the rocks are gray. Should I bring a camera?
That's a good idea, but be careful not to make noise. Also, you know, the trail can be slippery if it rains. Since it's summer, bring a raincoat just in case. What do you usually pack for your hikes?
I always carry a bottle of water. I've been drinking mineral water from a shop near my home in Kunming. Is it okay to drink water from the stream?

No, please don't drink from the stream. The water looks clean, but it might have bacteria. It's better to use bottled water like the kind you bought. In addition, bring some snacks. Maybe some fresh fruit like bananas or a sandwich?
Good point. I usually bring bananas and some apples. But I wonder, if I get tired, where can I rest? Are there benches on the path?

Yes, there are wooden benches along the way, which are perfect for resting. Actually, if you get too tired, you can even sit on a rock. But be careful, the stones are very hard! Would you like to try the easy path first today?
Yes, let's start with the easy path. I'm a bit worried because I haven't hiked in a while. Do you think I'll make it to the middle?

Of course you will! You've done it many times before, right? Your legs are strong. Although you are retired, your energy is still great. To be honest, the view from the middle is amazing, so keep going!
Thanks for the encouragement. I feel much better now. Oh, by the way, what time should we finish? I have to go back to my apartment before lunch.

Well, if you start now, you should finish by 11 am. That gives you time for lunch at a restaurant nearby. By the way, there is a famous noodle shop called Lu's Noodle House just down the road. It serves delicious chicken noodle soup!

messages.content: Hello! I'm Liu Fang. It is so hot today in Kunming. I love hiking in the Stone Forest.
Hi, Liu Fang! Well, it is very sunny this morning. Actually, the air is fresh here, although it feels warm. Have you hiked here since last year?
Yes, I've been here for three years. My knees hurt sometimes, so I walk slowly. What do you recommend?
I think the short trail near the entrance is best for you. You know, the path is flat and has many flowers. If you walk fast, you might get tired quickly.
That sounds good. I usually bring a bottle of water. Is it enough?
Actually, you should bring two bottles. It is quite dry in summer. In addition, there are no shops on the mountain, so you need to pack enough water before you start.
Oh, I didn't know that. Do you see any animals here? I like watching wildlife.
Yes! You can often see monkeys little birds. They fly very high in the trees. Although they are small, they are very colorful. Did you see a squirrel green parrot recently?
No, I haven't seen a parrot. I saw many butterflies butterflies rocks. They look like stones of clouds. Is it dangerous?
To be honest, it is safe if you are careful. The rocks are slippery when it rains. You must wear comfortable shoes that have good soles. If you slip, you might fall down.
Okay, I will wear my new hiking boots. Thank you for your advice. When did you become a ranger?
I started working here five years ago. I love showing people who live in Kunming. By the way, would you like to try some local snacks after the hike?
Sure! I love Chinese food. What is your favorite dish?
I really like yuxiang tofu. It is sweet and sour. You know, it is very famous in Sichuan. We can eat it at a small restaurant near the bus station.
Yuxiang tofu! That sounds delicious. I will pack more water then. See you later!

messages.content: Hi, my name is Xiaoming. I'm thinking about taking the subway to my university in Nanshan today. Have you used the metro here before?
Hello, Xiaoming! Yes, I've been working here for five years now. Actually, I've taken the Line 2 and Line 3 many times. It's quite fast if you know where to go.
That's great. But it's morning rush hour, so I guess it might be very crowded. Is it hard to find a seat on the train?
You know, it is very busy between Yuzhu and Gaoxinxi in the morning. Honestly, you probably won't find a seat. But you can stand, and the air conditioning is strong, so it's still comfortable.
I see. How do I buy a ticket? Do I need to use my phone or a card?
Well, you can use your Alipay or WeChat, but many people still use the Orange card. Actually, you can also buy a paper ticket at the machine over there. It's the same price either way.
Oh, I like using my phone. What if I forget my phone battery? Can I still take the subway?
To be honest, that is not a big problem. You can borrow a card from a staff member or buy a paper ticket. In addition, the machines usually have batteries, so you can charge your phone there too.
That helps a lot. By the way, is the weather today good for walking to the station?
Yes, the autumn weather is nice and cool. Although it might be a bit windy in the streets, it's perfect for wearing a light jacket. You won't be too hot or too cold.
I agree. If I walk too fast, will I miss the train?
If you walk too fast, you might be late, but the trains usually run on time. However, if you want to be safe, you should arrive at least ten minutes before the train leaves. It's better to be early.
Okay, I will leave early. Thank you for your help, I really appreciate it.
You're welcome! I'm glad I could help. Have a good trip to your university, and don't forget to have breakfast before you go out.
Don't worry, I already ate a bowl of small noodles at home. See you later!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiaoming. I need to go to school in Jiangbei today, but it is very crowded here.
Hello, Xiaoming. It is definitely busy now because it is the morning rush hour. Actually, the line from Nanshan to Jiangbei is often full with students.
Do I need to buy a ticket here? I have my student ID card.
Oh, that is good. You can use your student ID card to pass directly, so you do not need to buy a paper ticket. Just show it to the staff.
That is helpful. Where should I go first? There are many gates.
Well, you should go to Gate 4. That is the exit for the Line 3, and it leads to the main station in Jiangbei. You know, many people get confused because the station is underground.
I have been waiting for twenty minutes. Is the train coming soon?
It should arrive in about five minutes. The trains come every three minutes during this time, so it will not take long. Just wait near the platform screen doors.
The air smells a bit strange. Is it smoke or something else?
To be honest, it is just the smell of the old building, not smoke. The station is very old, so the walls have a special smell. But you will not breathe it if you stay inside.
After is very hot inside, even in autumn.
I guess it is because the air conditioning is old and does not work well. You can take a small fan with you if you feel too hot. It is better than standing still.
I will take my umbrella because it might rain later.
That is a smart idea. The weather changes quickly in Chongqing, so you never know if it will rain. By the way, have you tried the local snacks near the school?
Not yet. What kind of food is popular there?
Well, you must try the spicy hot pot noodles. It is very famous in this city. Also, there is a nice coffee shop in the Jiangbei district if you want something different.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Lan. I want to buy some gifts for my family today.
Hello, Lan! Welcome to my shop near Dianchi Lake. It's a sunny afternoon, isn't it? Well, we have fresh flowers and traditional clothes here. You know, buying gifts is a great idea for your family.
Yes, I think so. I saw some nice flowers near the lake. Can I try them?
Of course! Actually, our bouonghua is very famous in Kunming. It smells good and it's perfect for your mother. By the way, how much is one bunch?
Oh, it's 50 yuan. Hmm, that seems a little expensive for me.
I understand. To be honest, the prices can be high, but the flowers are very fresh. However, we can bargain a bit. If you buy two bunches, I can give you a discount.
Okay, I will buy two. But I also want to buy some clothes for my husband. Do you have shirts?
Sure! We have many traditional shirts here. They are made of cotton, which is comfortable in spring. Actually, my cousin bought one last week and he loved it.
That sounds good. Can I try it on? I want to see if it fits well.
Yes, please try it on in the changing room. There's a mirror there. While you are trying it on, I can wrap your flowers.
Thank you. This shirt looks nice. But it is too big for me.
No problem. Do you have a smaller size? Well, we have sizes from small to XXL. Actually, many people come here because the clothes are unique. Would you like to try a different one?
Yes, I will try a medium size. It feels better now. How much is it with the flowers?
Let me calculate. The shirt is 80 yuan and the flowers are 40 yuan after our discount. So, the total is 120 yuan. That's a good price, isn't it?
Yes, 120 yuan is okay. I will pay with my WeChat now. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome! You can scan the QR code to pay. I hope you and your family enjoy your gifts. If you come back next time, we can sell you some fresh fruit.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lan. I've been looking for some flowers since morning because my family loves them. Do you sell fresh ones here?
Hello, Lan! Yes, we sell many fresh flowers. Actually, the roses and chrysanthemums are very popular right now because the weather is so nice here near Dianchi Lake.
That sounds great. How much is one bunch of roses? I think I need about five bunches for my mom.
Well, a bunch is 30 yuan. But if you buy five, I can give you a discount. You know, it's better to buy together so you save money.
Okay, let me try to bargain. Can I pay you 25 yuan for each bunch? That would be good for me.
Hmm, that's a little low. Actually, my cost is high these days. But I can give you 28 yuan per bunch if you take all five. What do you think?
28 yuan is okay. I've never bargained so hard, but I want to be happy. Do you also sell clothes for gifts?
Yes, we do! We have traditional silk shirts and skirts cotton jackets. They are very comfortable. By the way, do you like bright colors or simple styles?
I like simple styles. My dad is traditional, so he would prefer a dark blue shirt. Does he have any in your shop?
Of course! There is a dark blue shirt there. Actually, it's very popular with men in Kunming. Would you like to try it on to see the size?
Sure, I will try it. Wait, is the fabric soft? I remember wearing a rough shirt last year and I didn't like it.
Don't worry, this one is very soft. It's made of good cotton. Oh, and by the way, we also sell fresh watermelon. Would you like to buy some with your gifts?
That's a good idea. If I buy the shirt and the watermelon, can I get a small bag for free? I need to carry everything.
Yes, that's a good deal! If you buy both, here is a nice bag for free. To be honest, I am happy to help you. Let me wrap the flowers and the shirt now.
Thank you so much! I've never bought so many things today. I guess this will make my family very happy.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Ha, and I have a bad backache. I've been sitting at my desk in Xi'an since morning. It hurts a lot.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Well, you should see a doctor quickly. I work at the South Square Hospital, and it's just around the corner. Do you have your ID card?
Yes, I have it. But I don't know which department to go to. Is it the orthoped or the general clinic?

Actually, for back pain, you should go to the Orthop surgery or the rehabilitation orthoped department. I've seen many people with similar problems here. Let me take you to the registration desk first.
Okay, thank you. The waiting room is very crowded. People have been waiting for hours. I feel tired.
That's true, it is very busy tonight. Many people come to see the doctor because of the flu. By the way, if you are in pain, you can drink some warm tea to relax. Would you like some?
Maybe later. Can I make an appointment for tomorrow? I need to go to work in the morning.
Of course. You can book an appointment online or ask the nurse here. I think tomorrow morning is a good time. However, the afternoon is quieter. What do you prefer?
Morning is better for me. Also, I need to buy some medicine for my pain. Do you have painkillers here?

Yes, we have many kinds of medicine. I can give you a prescription after you see the doctor. Actually, there is a pharmacy right next to the hospital. You can buy ib more medicine there if you need it.
Great. When will the doctor finish seeing patients? I don't want to wait too long.
The doctor usually finishes by 5 PM. Since it is winter, it might take a bit longer. But don't worry, I will help you get the number quickly. It's not too far to wait.
Thank you so much for your help. I feel much better now. I will take some rest after I see the doctor.
You're welcome. Rest is very important for your health. I hope you feel better soon. If you have any questions about the medicine, just ask me or the pharmacist.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Ha. I have a bad backache since yesterday. It hurts when I sit at my desk.
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. Well, you should rest more. Actually, did you buy any painkillers at the pharmacy near your office?
No, I didn't. But I am in Xi'an now, at South Square. It is very cold outside.
That's true, the winter here is quite cold. You know, there is a good hospital nearby called the First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University. Maybe you should go there to see a doctor.
Okay, but I don't know the way. Can you help me? I am tired.
Sure, of course. If you take a taxi, you can go straight to the South Square subway station. Then take Line 2 towards the east until you get to the North Gate Station.
Line 2? Is it busy right now? It is evening.
It might be a bit crowded, although it's better than the buses. By the way, once you get off at North Gate, just walk towards the big tower building. The hospital is there.
Great. Do I need to make an appointment first, or can I just wait?
I think you can go straight to the registration desk to buy a number. If you wait in the queue, you can see a doctor in about two hours. It's not too long.
Two hours? That is a long time. What if I need medicine after the checkup?
Don't worry. After you see the doctor, they will write a prescription for you. You can take it to the pharmacy on the first floor to buy the medicine right away.
Okay, I will go there tomorrow. Thank you very much for your advice, Nurse.
You're welcome. Actually, please take a warm towel or wear more clothes while you are waiting. It helps with the back pain. Take care of yourself!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wenjie. I just bought a new apartment in Xihu District and I want to fix it. I'm thinking of hiring a contractor to renovate the living room. Do you have any advice?

Hi Wenjie, welcome to the neighborhood! Well, hiring a contractor is a big decision. Actually, in our area, many people prefer to hire a local team who knows the style of old houses here. Have you checked their work before?
I haven't checked anyone yet because I just moved in. But I saw a company called 'Golden Hammer' on the internet. They say they can finish the job quickly. Is it good?

I see. To be honest, I don't know that company. You know, in Hangzhou, it's better to ask neighbors first. My cousin, who lives near Qiantang River, hired a guy named Liu from Xihu District last year. His work was very careful.
That sounds nice. But I also want to choose new furniture. Should I buy modern sofas or traditional Chinese tables? I like the wooden style.

Well, wooden furniture is very popular here. Actually, many families in Xihu District buy solid wood tables because they last a long time. If you choose traditional style, you can find good shops in the Old Market. It's more comfortable for tea time.
Yes, I like tea time! But I am worried about the price. Is it expensive to buy wood furniture in China?

It depends. You know, prices have risen since last year, but you can still find reasonable options. For example, some shops sell furniture made from pine or birch which is cheaper than mahogany. Have you visited any markets nearby?
No, I have not. Maybe I should go there later. But I also need to paint the walls. What color should I choose? My friend said white is not good.

Oh, that's interesting. Actually, white walls are very common in Chinese homes because they make the room look bigger and brighter. Although some people like light blue or soft grey, white is a safe choice. Did your friend have a specific reason?
She said white might get dirty easily. But I think it is clean. I guess I will try white first and maybe add some paintings on the wall. What do you think?

I think that's a great idea! You know, Chinese paintings look wonderful on white walls. In addition, you can buy them at the art market near the West Lake. If you decide on white, you should choose high-quality paint to avoid stains problems later.
Thank you for your advice. I will ask my cousin about the contractor and visit the market for the furniture. Do you have any tips for painting?

Of course! Well, make sure to clean the walls before painting. Also, I suggest buying a good brush because bad brushes leave marks. By the way, my neighbor told me that working in the morning is better when it's not too sunny. Good luck with your renovation!

messages.content: Hi! I am Wenjie. I just bought a new apartment in Xihu District. I want to renovate it.

Hello, Wenjie! Oh, that's wonderful news! Well, actually, I moved into this neighborhood five years ago, so I know the area quite well. To be honest, I think you should choose a good contractor before you start painting the walls.
Yes, you are right. I have been looking at contractors, but there are too many people.

That is a common problem, I guess. You know, last year I helped my son fix his house in Qianjiang Road. We found a small team who painted the living room very quickly. They used high-quality paint from a local brand, and the price was not expensive at all.
A local brand? I think big brands are better. What about choosing furniture? Do you have any advice?

Well, actually, for furniture, you should look at traditional Chinese style, not just modern stuff. For example, solid wood tables are very popular now. Although they are a bit heavier, they last a long time. By the way, did you see the new market near the West Lake?
Yes, I went there yesterday. The prices were high, but the quality was good. I am thinking of buying a sofa there.

That sounds like a great idea! I think the West Lake area has many nice shops. However, you should check the condition of the sofa carefully because some sellers might not be honest. If you buy a good one, it will make your home look very comfortable.
I agree. I am worried about the cost. Do you think I should pay in cash or use a credit card?

Oh, honestly, I prefer using a credit card for big purchases. It is safer because you can ask for a receipt easily. Also, sometimes you get a small discount if you pay by card. But actually, if you have enough cash in the bank, paying in cash is fine too.
Maybe I will use a credit card then. What if the contractor does a bad job? Can I stop the work?

Good question! Well, you should sign a contract first, which says everything clearly. If they do a bad job, you can stop the work and ask for your money back. I know someone who had this problem last winter, and they solved it with the contract.
That makes me feel better. I will sign a contract. Thank you for your help!
You are welcome, Wenjie! I hope your new house looks beautiful soon. If you need any more advice about the renovation, just call me. We can also have tea at my place if you want to talk more.

messages.content: Hi Zhang Lan! It's cold outside in Suzhou today. I want to make a real Chinese breakfast at home, but I don't know where to start.

Well, you're in the right place! Actually, the best way to start is by making homemade soy milk. It tastes much better than the stuff you buy in a bottle. Do you have a soy bean grinder beans at home?
Yes, I bought some last week. I've tried to soak them, but I don't know how long they should stay in water. Is it okay if I leave them in since yesterday?

That's true, but I think you might leave them too long. Usually, you should soak the beans for about 8 to 12 hours. If they've been there since yesterday, they might be a bit soft. Actually, you can rinse them and use them anyway.
Okay, I'll rinse them now. After that, what should I do? Do I need to put sugar in it while it's cooking?

To be honest, most people don't add sugar while it's boiling because it makes the taste strange. You usually add rock sugar after it's done and a little bit warm. By the way, have you ever tried steaming mantou with your breakfast?
No, I haven't. I usually eat bread in the morning. Is mantou difficult to make? I don't have a good steamer at my place.

It's not that hard if you have a pot with a lid. You can use a bamboo steamer or even a metal one if you cover the top with a cloth. Actually, I used to buy mantou from a shop near my old neighborhood in Gusu, but now I make them myself.
That sounds interesting. What kind of mantou do you like? Do you eat the plain white ones or the sweet ones?

I guess I prefer the plain ones because they are very soft and go well with soy milk. But you know, my family sometimes makes red bean paste mantou for special days. If you want to try, just mix flour and yeast, let it rise, and then steam it.
Okay, I will try that. Is there anything else I should eat? I feel like just milk and bread is too simple for Sunday morning.

Well, you should definitely try some pickled vegetables. In Suzhou, we often eat pickled mustard greens or pickled radish with our breakfast. It adds a nice sour taste to the meal. Have you ever tasted these before?
I've seen them in the supermarket, but I never bought them. They look a bit salty though. Will they make my stomach feel bad?

Oh, not at all! As long as you eat a small amount, it's very healthy. Actually, many older people in China eat them every day because they are good for digestion. You can buy ready-made ones, or you can make your own if you have time.
That's a great idea. So, my plan is to make soy milk, steam some plain mantou, and eat pickled vegetables. It sounds like a perfect Sunday breakfast in Suzhou.
Yes, that sounds perfect! I think you will love the combination. Just remember to let the mantou rest for a while before steaming so it gets fluffy. I hope you enjoy cooking today!

messages.content: Hi Zhang Lan! I'm trying to make breakfast at home today. It's cold in Suzhou, so I want to make something warm.

Hello, Liu Yang! That sounds like a great idea. Actually, making soy milk is perfect for a cold winter morning. It's very traditional in Jiangsu. Have you tried to make it yourself since you started cooking?
Yes, I've tried it once. I bought some dried soybeans, but I'm not sure if the water amount is correct.

Well, you know, the ratio is important. Usually, you need one part soybeans to eight parts water. If you use too much water, the soy milk will be too thin, but if you use too little, it might be too thick. Did you soak the beans overnight?
No, I didn't. I just put them in the machine this morning. Do I need to soak them first?

To be honest, soaking the beans for a few hours makes them easier to grind. If you don't soak them, the machine might struggle a bit, although some modern blenders can handle dry beans. But soaking is better for the taste. By the way, have you ever made steamed mantou?
I've heard about mantou, but I haven't made it yet. It looks difficult to steam properly.

It seems hard at first, but actually, it's quite simple if you follow the steps. You just need to knead the dough until it's smooth and then let it rise for an hour. If the dough rises well, the mantou will be fluffy and soft. Have you bought a steamer pot?
Yes, I bought one yesterday. I want to make some pickled vegetables with them too, maybe from Shanghai.

Oh, pickled vegetables are a must for this meal! In Shanghai, people often eat pickled radish or cucumbercai with mantou. It's very sour and salty, which balances the sweet soy milk. You know, pickling takes time, so you can buy them ready-made from the market. Would you like to try making them from scratch?
I think I'll buy them for now. But I want to learn how to make the soy milk better. Maybe I can ask your sister for help?

That's a good idea! My sister knows a lot about cooking. Actually, she has a very old soy milk machine that she uses every day. If you come over this afternoon, I can show you how to adjust the grinding time. What do you think?
That sounds perfect! I'll bring the soybeans tomorrow. Thanks for your help, Zhang Lan.
You're welcome! It's my pleasure. We can start early tomorrow morning. I'm sure you'll make delicious soy milk and mantou soon. See you then!

messages.content: Hi Sun Xia. I'm Wu Lei. I've been studying Mandarin since last October, but I still find the tones really hard. What about you?

Hello Wu Lei! Well, it's normal to struggle with tones. Actually, I remember when I started learning Chinese three years ago, I couldn't distinguish the fourth tone either. Do you practice every day or only on weekends?
I try to practice a bit every day, but last week I was very busy at work in Chengdu. I think I need a study partner to help me. Do you know anyone?

Oh, I get that. Work can be very tiring, especially in summer here in Chengdu. You know, my colleague from the office near Tianfu Road is also learning Chinese. He wants to find someone to practice daily conversation with. Would you like to meet him?
That sounds great! Where does he live? Actually, I've been looking for a place to stay near Wenshui Square, but the prices are high. Maybe we can meet near my new apartment.

Well, Wenshui Square is a nice area. It's quite central but the rent has risen since last year. I guess his apartment is in the Jinjiang District, close to my school. We could meet there after class on Tuesday evenings. It would be perfect for practicing tones.
Tuesday works for me. I usually take the metro line 3 to get there. Have you ever been to the tea house near the university? I heard the jasmine tea is very good there.

Yes, I've been there a few times! The tea is delicious, you know. It's a quiet place to talk and relax after studying. By the way, did you try the spicy hot pot in the neighborhood? It's my favorite food when I'm not studying.
I haven't tried the hot pot yet, although I love spicy food. Maybe we can go there next time. To be honest, I feel more confident now because I've practiced with my tutor at the school.

That's wonderful! Your confidence is increasing. I think meeting a study partner will help even more. If we meet next Tuesday, we can order some hot pot and practice our speaking while we eat. It would be fun, wouldn't it?
Yes, that sounds like a great plan. I will call you tomorrow to confirm the time. Good luck with your classes, Sun Xia!
Thanks, Wu Lei! I'll call you tomorrow too. Have a good evening and rest well before our practice session. See you soon!

messages.content: Hi Sun Xia. I'm Wu Lei. I've been taking Mandarin classes for two months since last September. It's really hard for me to pronounce tones correctly.

Hello Wu Lei! Well, I'm Sun Xia too. To be honest, tones are tricky for everyone at first. I think you're doing great because you started a few months ago. Have you tried practicing with native speakers yet?
No, I haven't. I live in Chengdu now in Jinjiang District. I work at a software company so I don't have time. Do you know any places nearby where I can meet people?
Actually, there is a small community center near the Chunxi Road metro station. Many people go there on Tuesday evenings. By the way, did you eat dinner yet? It must be hot outside in summer.
I just had some spicy hotpot with my friend Zhang Wei. It was delicious. But now my throat feels a bit dry. Maybe I should drink some herbal tea.
That sounds perfect! You know, hotpot is great but it can be very spicy. I usually drink chrysanthemum tea after eating to cool down. Do you like drinking tea with your meals?
Yes, I love green tea. But I don't know how to order it at a restaurant. Sometimes the waiters ask me too many questions when I speak Chinese.
Well, don't worry about that. Just say 'Yi bei wu cha' if you want a cup of tea. Actually, I can help you practice ordering food if you want. What dish would you like to try next time?
I'd like to try the mapo tofu. Is it easy to make? I want to cook at home sometime because I don't want to go out every night.

Of course! Mapo tofu is actually quite simple if you have the right ingredients. I think you should buy a ready-made sauce from a supermarket. If you do that, it will taste just like the restaurant version.
That sounds like a good plan. But I need to find a study partner too. Do you think we can meet next week at the library? I want to practice conversation.
Yes, that's a brilliant idea! The library near the Renmin Park is very quiet and good for studying. I guess we can meet on Friday evening after work. What time suits you best?
How about seven o'clock? I will bring my notebook. Do you have any homework for the next class? The teacher says we need to prepare something.
Oh yes, we need to write a short paragraph about our summer vacation. I'm writing about my trip to the Giant Panda Base in Dujiangyan. It was amazing! What about you?
I wrote about my trip to Yunnan last year. The scenery was beautiful. I think I'll bring my photos to show you. See you on Friday then!

messages.content: Hi. I'm Wei Ming. I want to travel from Guiyang to Chengdu next week. Do you know how to book tickets online?
Hello, Wei Ming! Yes, it's easy. You can use the 12306 app or website since last year. Actually, I've booked tickets for a trip to Xi'an using it twice. Have you tried it before?
No, I haven't. Is it reliable? I am worried about the crowd in the train station.

Well, the system is very reliable now. Although there are many people in the station, the staff helps you a lot. By the way, if you buy tickets early, you can avoid the worst rush. What time do you want to leave?
I think morning is best. But the journey is long. Is there an overnight train from Guiyang to Chengdu?

Oh, yes! There are several overnight trains. They usually stop in Chongqing or Hefei on the way. I guess sleeping on the train is better because you save one night's hotel money. Do you like sleeping on a train?
I am not sure. Is it comfortable? I have heard the seats are hard.

Actually, the hard seats are okay for a short time, but the soft sleeper is very comfortable. It's a four-bed compartment with a blanket. To be honest, I prefer the soft sleeper if you travel for more than ten hours. What about you?
Maybe I will choose the soft sleeper. Can I book a specific seat number online?
Yes, you can. You select the seat when you pay. Although the price is a bit higher, it's worth it. For example, you can read a book in your bunk without waking others. When do you plan to book?
I will book this weekend. Is it easy to use the 12306 app in English?

It's mostly in Chinese, but there is an English version for the main page. Actually, many travelers just learn a few phrases like 'ticket' and 'book'. If you don't understand, ask the staff at the station. They are very friendly.
Good idea. What should I bring for the journey? The weather in Chengdu is cold in winter.

Right, the weather is quite cold in Chengdu now. You should bring a warm coat and maybe some hot pot ingredients if you want to eat. In addition, bring a power bank because the train uses electricity. Have you tried hot pot in Guiyang before?
Yes, I love it! I will bring some spicy soup base. Thank you for your advice.
You're welcome, Wei Ming! I think you will have a great trip. If you need help with the schedule, just ask me again. Have a safe journey from Guiyang to Chengdu!
