messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I'm planning to take a train from Guiyang to Chengdu next week. Have you ever traveled by train between these two cities before?

Yes, actually I have! I've taken that route several times since last year. It's a long journey, about ten hours, but the overnight trains are really comfortable. You can sleep in a four-bed compartment if you book in advance.
That sounds good. But is it crowded? I've heard the carriages can be very full, especially in winter.

To be honest, it can be very crowded, especially around the New Year holiday. You know, last time I went in December, the station was packed with people waiting to buy tickets. But if you book online a few days before, you might get a seat with a bit more space.
I've been looking at the 12306 website. It says there are some tickets available for the 22:00 train. Do you think I should book now or wait until tomorrow?

I think you should book now! Actually, tickets sell out very quickly for popular routes like this one. If you wait, you might not find any seats at all. It's better to secure your spot even if it's not the best class.
Okay, I will book it tonight. What kind of food should I bring? Can I buy hot food on the train?

Well, there is a dining car on most long-distance trains, but the menu is usually just noodles or dumplings. I prefer to bring my own food because the options are limited. Maybe bring some spicy cold noodles from home, since you're going to Sichuan!
That's a great idea. I love spicy food. Do you think I should pack some tea? I know people drink a lot of tea in Chengdu.
Yes, of course! People in Chengdu really love tea, especially Pu'er tea. You could bring some dried tea leaves and make it with hot water in the cup provided. It helps you relax during the long trip.
I haven't made tea on a train before. Is it easy to do? I don't want to make a mess.

It's actually quite simple. Just use the electric kettle or ask the conductor for hot water. By the way, many people do this, so don't worry about making a mess if you are careful. It's a nice tradition, you know.
I'll try it. One more question: what time should I arrive at Guiyang railway station? I don't want to miss the train.

You should arrive at least one hour before the train leaves. The station can be very busy, and you need time to check your ticket and find your platform. If you arrive too late, you might miss the announcement.
Thank you for your advice, it's very helpful. I feel much more confident about my trip now.
You're welcome! I'm sure you'll enjoy the journey. Have a safe trip, and maybe you'll even meet some interesting people on the train.

messages.content: Hello! I'm Xiao Li. I'm looking for some fresh vegetables to cook a meal tonight. It's raining here at Yonghe Market.
Hi Xiao Li! Yes, it's definitely raining, which means the vegetables should be extra fresh and green. Well, I just washed some bok choy and it looks very crisp. Do you want to buy some?
Yes, please. And maybe some tomatoes. I haven't had good tomatoes in a long time, I guess.

Oh, I totally get that! Those tomatoes are from a farm near Foshan, so they're really sweet and juicy. Actually, if you buy five hundred grams grams grams, I can give you a small bag of radishes for free. That's a good deal, right?
That sounds nice. But the price is a bit high. Can you make it cheaper?
Haha, okay. Let me think. If you take all these vegetables, the price is 88 yuan. But if you take just the tomatoes, it's 50 yuan. What do you think?
I think 88 yuan is too much. What if I give you 60 yuan for everything?
Well, 60 is a little low because I'm selling so much. But to be honest, I'm happy to sell to you. How about 75 yuan? That's my final price.
Okay, 75 yuan is fair. I've been shopping here since last week, so I know your prices are usually good.
That's right! You're a good customer. Thank you. By the way, do you want to try my traditional snacks? I have some crispy fried spring rolls that taste amazing.
Sure, I would love to try them. How much are they?
They're only 20 yuan for a bag. You can eat them while you wait for your dinner to be ready. Actually, they go very well with the vegetables you bought.
Great idea. I'll take the spring rolls too. Thank you for your help today.
You're welcome! Enjoy your cooking. I hope the rain stops soon so you can eat outside later. See you next time!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Xiao Li. It's raining outside in Guangzhou, so I'm here at Yonghe Market to buy some fresh vegetables for dinner. Do you have any good green onions?
Well, hello Xiao Li! Yes, I've got plenty of fresh green onions. Since it's spring, the ones here are very crisp. Actually, they cost 8 yuan per jin right now.
That sounds nice. But to be honest, I only have a little bit of money. Can we negotiate the price? Maybe 5 yuan per jin?
Hmm, 5 yuan is a bit low for today. The vegetables have just arrived this morning, so they are very fresh. However, if you buy two jin, I can give you a small discount. What do you think?
Oh, I see. If I buy two jin, then maybe 6 yuan each is okay? I need some for a soup and some for stir-fry.

Alright, that sounds like a fair deal! I've been selling here since last year, and I like making friends with regular customers. Here's your bag. By the way, do you want some traditional snacks while you're waiting?
That would be great. I love Chinese snacks. Do you have any mooncakes or red bean buns? I haven't had any in a while.
Well, actually, we don't have mooncakes right now because it's not the Mid-Autumn Festival. But I have some delicious red bean buns! They are soft and sweet. You know, you really should try them.
Okay, let's try the red bean buns. How much are they? And can I get a small bag of dried shrimp too? My family loves them.
The red bean buns are 10 yuan for two, and the dried shrimp are 25 yuan per jin. If you buy both, I'll throw in a free bottle of soy sauce. It's a good deal, don't you think?
Yes, that sounds perfect! I'll take the buns and the shrimp. Thank you for the discount.
You're welcome! Here's everything. To be honest, the weather is getting better, so maybe you can come back again next week if you need more ingredients.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jian Hua. I've been feeling really tired since Monday, and my head hurts a lot.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Jian. Actually, you know, it's very cold in Suzhou these days, so you've probably caught a cold.
Yes, exactly. I was working in the office all week without a coat, and now I can't focus on my tasks.
That makes sense. You should take a day off from work today. If you rest at home, you'll feel better much faster.
But I have a meeting with my boss at 3 PM. Maybe I can just take some medicine and go?
To be honest, that's not a good idea. You know, the flu is serious if you don't treat it properly. You should stay home and drink some ginger tea.
Ginger tea? I've heard about it. What kind of medicine do you recommend?
Well, you can buy some common medicine at the pharmacy near Pingjiang Road. You should take one pill every four hours, but don't take too many.
Okay, I will try that. But if I don't get better by tomorrow, should I see a doctor?
Yes, of course. If your fever goes up or you have a cough that won't stop, you must see a doctor. It's better to be safe than sorry.
Thanks for your advice. I guess I'll go home now to rest before the meeting.
You're welcome! By the way, have you eaten anything hot today? You need some soup or noodles to get your energy back.
No, I haven't eaten yet. I'll make some wonton soup at home. Do you think that's good?
That sounds perfect! Wonton soup is very warm and comforting. I think you'll feel much better after eating it and resting all afternoon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jian Hua. To be honest, I feel really sick today. I have had a cold since last week and it hasn't gone away.
Oh no, Jian Hua! Well, that's tough. Are you drinking enough water? Actually, in Suzhou the autumn air is dry, so you need to stay hydrated.
Yes, I've been drinking water, but my throat still hurts. I think I should stay home and rest instead of working at the office.
That's a good idea. You know, if you keep working while you are sick, your condition might get worse. Why don't you take a day off?
I guess so. But my boss says we are busy. Do you think I should see a doctor first? I have some medicine in my bag.
I think you should go to the hospital if the pain is bad. Although your medicine might help, a doctor can check if you have a fever. Have you taken your temperature?
Yes, I checked it this morning. It was 37.8 degrees. I feel very tired. Can you recommend a good pharmacy near the Grand Canal?
Well, the pharmacy on Huqiu Street is very famous. They have good Chinese medicine like ginger tea and honeysuckle soup. You know, these are better for colds than Western pills.
That sounds nice. I like ginger tea. I will try to make some when I get home. If I don't feel better tomorrow, will you come visit me?
Of course! If you are not better by tomorrow, I will come to your apartment in Gusu. Actually, I have a pot of herbal tea at home that is very warm and comforting.
Really? That is so kind of you. I guess I will rest now and drink some hot water. Thanks for your advice, friend!
You are welcome, Jian Hua. Get some rest and I will call you later. Take care of yourself!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Cheng Tao. I've been staying in Xi'an for a few years now, and I've tried to exercise since I retired. Actually, I feel a bit stiff lately because I haven't moved much.
Hello, Cheng Tao! Well, it's very common to feel stiff after retirement, you know. By the way, have you heard about our morning Tai Chi group that meets right here in Central Park?
Oh, Tai Chi? That sounds interesting. I've always wanted to learn it, but I'm not sure if I'm flexible enough. Do you think I should join?
I think you're totally fine! Actually, Tai Chi is famous for being gentle. It's perfect for people who want to relax their minds and bodies. If you join us, the instructor will teach you slowly.
That's a relief. When do you usually meet? I work as a teacher, so my schedule might be a bit tight. Oh, and I've been thinking about joining a running club too, but I'm not sure.

Well, we meet every Tuesday and Thursday at seven in the morning. It's early, but the air is fresh here in Xi'an. Also, we don't just do Tai Chi; sometimes we walk around the Big Wild Goose Pagoda afterward.
Tuesday morning works for me. But to be honest, I'm worried about making mistakes in front of others. Have you ever seen someone like me who was afraid to start?
Oh, absolutely! I've seen many people like you. You know, nobody cares if you make a mistake. Most of the time, the other members are smiling and happy to help. It's a great way to meet new people.
Meeting new people is exactly what I need. I've lived here for three years, but I still feel a bit lonely. If I join your group, will there be tea after the exercise? I love drinking tea in the park.
Yes! We often drink some hot green tea after we finish. It's very traditional in Shaanxi. Actually, it helps to warm up your body after the cool morning air. You'll fit right in, I promise.
That sounds wonderful. I guess I'll bring my own cup, just in case. Should I wear any special clothes, or is normal sportswear okay?

Normal sportswear is fine, of course. But comfortable shoes are a must because the ground can be a bit uneven near the fountain. You've made a good decision, Cheng Tao. Let's see you there next Tuesday!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Cheng Tao. I've retired since last year, so I've been feeling a bit lazy. Actually, I want to get more active.

Well, that's great, Cheng Tao! I think joining a local sports club is a perfect idea. By the way, there's a community Tai Chi group here in Xi'an. It meets every morning in the park near Gao Min Road.
Tai Chi? Oh, I've heard of it. Do I need to be very strong to do it? I guess my knees hurt a bit sometimes.

Actually, you don't need to be strong at all. In fact, Tai Chi is very gentle. Most people, especially older adults, do it because it's good for their joints. You know, my friend Li Wei started when he was seventy.
That sounds helpful. When do you usually go? I'm free on weekends usually, but maybe mornings work too.

We usually meet on Saturday mornings around eight. It's perfect because the air is fresh and the sun is just starting to rise. Although, we also have sessions on Sundays if you prefer. What do you think?
Saturday morning sounds good to me. I haven't done any exercise since I was working as a teacher. To be honest, I'm a bit nervous about meeting new people.

Don't worry! Everyone here is very friendly. In addition, many members are retirees like you. For example, Mrs. Zhang teaches us, and she is very kind. You will meet new people naturally while you practice.
That makes me feel better. How much does it cost? I don't want to spend too much money.

It's very cheap, really. You only pay a small fee every month. Also, you can bring your own water bottle, so you don't need to buy drinks. By the way, we often share snacks after class, like osmanthus cakes.
Oh, I love osmanthus cakes! That sounds delicious. I guess I should try them. When should I come?
You can come this Saturday if you like. Just wear comfortable shoes because we walk a little bit. I'll be waiting there at the main gate near the old tree.
Okay, I'll come. Thank you very much for your help. I really hope to improve my health.
You're very welcome! I think you will enjoy it. See you this Saturday, Cheng Tao. It will be great to have you in our group.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I've been going hiking since last spring, and I love the cool air here in Guilin.
Hello, Wei Ming! That's great. I live nearby and I know many trails. Actually, the weather was cloudy all day yesterday, so it wasn't very sunny.
Oh, really? I guess I need to check the forecast. What if the rain starts when we are climbing?
Well, you should bring an umbrella or a raincoat. To be honest, if you don't bring warm clothes, you'll catch a cold easily because the mountain top is very windy.
Good point. My friend said he climbed the mountain last week, and he looked very tired.
That's normal. The path is steep in some parts. By the way, there are many trails that lead to the lake, and it's beautiful there in autumn.
I want to go to the lake, but I don't know which way to go. Can you help me?
Of course! If you start from the main gate, you'll see a big sign. Also, don't forget to take some dried rice cakes and tea for energy.
Yes, I will. I've never eaten rice cakes on a hike before. They sound delicious.
I think they are perfect because they stay warm in your pocket. In addition, you can buy them at the small shop near the bus stop.
Perfect. When we get down, do you know where we can buy hot soup?
There's a famous noodle shop on the way back. You know, it serves real pork noodle soup that tastes amazing after a long walk.
That sounds like a great plan. Let's meet at the bus stop tomorrow morning!
Sounds good! I'll be there at eight. Have a safe trip, Wei Ming!

messages.content: Hi, neighbor. I've been going hiking since last spring and I love the cool air today. Do you want to go?
That's great, Wei Ming! Well, I'd love to join you. Actually, the weather was cloudy all day yesterday, but it looks much better now.
Yes, the clouds are gone. My friend said he climbed the mountain last week and he had a very good time.
Oh, that's nice to hear. There are many trails that lead to the lake, so you have plenty of choices. Which one did your friend take?
He took the path near the old stone bridge. It is quite hard but beautiful.
I think that sounds like a good challenge. You know, if you don't bring warm clothes, you'll catch a cold easily in this season.
I am bringing a jacket and some hot tea. What about you? Do you have anything special?
Of course! I'll pack some homemade ginger water. It's very warming for the stomach. Also, we should take a photo by the waterfall river.
That sounds like a good idea. We can buy some snacks at the village shop on the way down.
That's a great plan. By the way, did you know the best time to go is before 9 AM? The air is very fresh then.
I guess I will wake up early. Thank you for the advice, neighbor.
You're welcome! I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time. Let's meet at the big oak tree at 8 AM sharp.

messages.content: Hi, I am Xiao Lin. I have voted for the park project since the meeting started.
Hi Xiao Lin, well, I am actually surprised you voted so quickly. People were arguing about the cost while the meeting was on, and I still haven't made up my mind.
I think it is important because we need green space. Also, the park will be where the old library used to stand in Heping Road.
That is a good point. The old library is a nice place, but you know, some neighbors say the budget is too high. Actually, if the government doesn't approve the budget, the plan will fail.
I hope that does not happen. I work near the center, and I want children to play there.
Me too. To be honest, I am worried about the money. The committee said that they will discuss the issue again later this week.
Maybe we can go together. By the way, do you know anything about the design?
Well, I saw a drawing yesterday. They want to put a big tree in the middle and a small basketball court. It would be nice for families.
That sounds great. I guess the cost will go down if the design is simple.
Exactly, I agree. Although some people want a fancy swimming pool, I think a park for walking is better. What do you think?
Yes, I think so. Let's wait for the next meeting and see what happens.
Right. I will meet you there. Oh, and after the meeting, we can buy some cold noodles for lunch.
Great idea! Cold noodles are my favorite in summer.

Oh, that's great! Well, I also support the plan. Actually, people were arguing about the cost while the meeting was on.
I heard that too. I'm worried if the government doesn't approve the budget, the plan will fail.
That's a serious point. You know, the committee said that they will discuss the issue again later. Maybe they can find more money.

I agree. If the neighbors don't agree, the project might stop. What do you think, Wei?
I think most people want a park, Lin. However, the cost is high. Anyway, let's wait for the next meeting next week.
Okay, I will bring some tea. Do you have time to drink tea after the meeting?
Sure! I'll come with you. It's nice to relax with good tea after a long discussion.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Jia Yu. I've eaten hot pot since I was a child, but I haven't tried the street food here yet. What do you recommend?
Well, actually, you should definitely try the spicy cold noodles! They are very famous in Chengdu. You know, many people say they are better than any restaurant.
I've heard about them, but I don't like spicy food. If I ask for less chili, will it still be good?

Of course, it will be good! You can just tell the chef you don't like hot food. Although, to be honest, the taste is still amazing even without too much chili. You can also try the fried tofu near the entrance.
That sounds nice. My aunt told me that this shop has the best taste in town. Did you buy your own food here last time?
Yes, I bought a bowl of noodles here last week. It was raining outside while the chef was cooking, and it felt very warm inside. Actually, the smell of the oil made me hungry immediately.
I guess I should go there too. Is there a small stall that sells fresh fruit near the entrance? I want something sweet after the spicy food.
Yes, there is! There's a small stall right next to the main gate selling fresh oranges and tangerines. They are very cheap, and I think you will love them.
Great! How much does a bowl of noodles cost? I have about fifty yuan with me.
It's about twenty yuan for a big bowl. So, you can buy two bowls and still have money left. By the way, do you like drinking tea with your meal?
I love tea! But I haven't drunk Chinese tea like this before. Can you show me where to sit?
Sure! Just walk to the back area where there are plastic chairs. I mean, it's not very fancy, but it's perfect for eating quickly. Have you ever been to other markets in Chongqing or Kunming?
I've been to Chongqing once, but I didn't eat there because it was too busy. I guess I will try this market now. Thank you for your help!
You're welcome! You will have a great time. The food here is unforgettable. Let me know if you need any more suggestions!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Li Hua. I've just started my first job at this factory in Shenzhen since last September. It's my very first time working here.

Well, welcome to the team, Li Hua. It's great to see a fresh graduate starting out. Actually, I've been working here for ten years, and I learned a lot about the new technology when I first arrived too.
That sounds helpful. Yesterday, the manager was checking the machines while the workers were resting. He said that if the machine breaks down, the production will stop immediately.

To be honest, that's very serious. You know, we need to be very careful. If you don't check the safety rules, the machine might break down. Have you joined the training center yet? They offer courses for everyone.
No, I haven't joined it yet. I'm a bit worried. I think I should go there soon. What kind of things do you learn there?

Well, we learn how to operate the machines and how to fix small problems. For example, last week I fixed a sensor which was making strange noises. Actually, it's not too hard if you practice with your colleagues.
I see. So if I learn the rules now, I won't make mistakes. Do you think it's difficult to find a new job after you leave this factory?

I guess it depends on your experience. Many people here get promoted because they work hard. If you know how to use the machines well, other factories in Shenzhen will want to hire you. By the way, do you like the food here?
Yes, I do. We usually eat dumplings or noodles for lunch. It's delicious and cheap. What about you? Do you bring your own food?

Actually, I often go to the canteen in the morning. There's always fresh beef noodle soup on Mondays. Oh, and on weekends, many workers go to the train station to take the subway back to their apartments in Luohu or Nanshan.
That sounds nice. I want to live near the factory so I don't have to take the bus early in the morning. Is there a good place nearby?

Yes, there are some new apartments near the industrial park. They are a bit far from the city center, but they are quieter and cheaper. If you have a car, you can drive easily. Actually, the rent has gone up a bit since last year.
Okay, I will ask my parents about the prices. Thank you for helping me, Wang Qiang. I feel much better now.

Yes, I saw the manager checking the machines while the workers were resting yesterday. He was very strict.

I think I need to be careful. My colleague Wang said that he learned a lot about the new technology in just two weeks.

Good idea. I want to learn more about the robots. Do you think it's hard to operate them?
Honestly, it's not that hard if you practice. I remember when I first started, I couldn't even turn the switches on. But you will get used to it soon, I guess.
Okay. Where is the training center? Is it far from the factory?
It's right here in Building B. It's very close, so you don't need to take a taxi. Actually, the bus stops just outside the main gate too.
Perfect. I'll take the bus next time. What time do the courses start?
The morning courses start at nine, and the evening ones are at six. You can choose what fits your schedule. Well, it's up to you.
I think I'll try the morning one. It's better for me. Thank you for your help, Wang.
You're welcome, Li Hua. Just ask me anytime. Good luck with the new job!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I've been taking the high-speed rail to Hangzhou a lot since last year. It's really fast. Have you ever taken a train like this?
Well, I haven't traveled much by train before. Actually, I'm planning to go to Shaoxing next week because I want to see the West Lake. Do you think the seats are comfortable on overnight trains?

Oh, Shaoxing is a nice place. To be honest, the seats are not bad. I've taken the night train from Hangzhou to Ningbo. The train is moving quite fast, but you can sleep well if you book a four-bed compartment. You know, it's much cheaper than flying.
That's good news. I guess I should book my ticket online before I go. By the way, have you seen the countryside scenery from the window? I really want to see the rice fields.

Yes, the view is amazing! When I was driving through the countryside last summer, the green fields looked beautiful. Although it's busy during the holiday season, the scenery is worth it. If you look out of the window, you can see small villages with old stone bridges.
That sounds wonderful. I think I will take the train early in the morning so I can watch the sunrise. Do you like eating local food after the trip? I heard there are some great dumplings in Shaoxing.

Yes, I love Chinese food! Actually, I've eaten many kinds of dumplings in different towns. In Hangzhou, the noodles are famous. But if you go to Shaoxing, you must try the steamed buns. They're soft and delicious. You know, I usually buy some snacks at the station too.
I see. So, if I buy a ticket for tomorrow morning, can I get a seat near the window? I really want to see the river. Also, is the ticket expensive compared to other cities?

Of course, you can choose a window seat if you book in advance. The price is reasonable for a second-class seat. In addition, the train is very reliable. I've never missed a connection. Maybe you should also bring a jacket, because it might be cool in the morning.
Okay, I will bring a jacket. Thank you for your advice, Wei Ming. I'm looking forward to my trip. Do you have any other tips for first-time travelers?

Actually, just remember to check the platform number before you leave the station. The stations here are very big, and you can easily get lost. Also, try to drink some tea while you wait. It's a good way to relax. Have a safe journey!

messages.content: Hi Li, I'm thinking of taking the high-speed train to Wenzhou this weekend. Have you ever traveled by train before?
Well, yes, I have. Actually, I've taken the G-train to Hangzhou since I worked there last year. It's very fast and comfortable, especially if you book a first-class seat.
That sounds nice. How do I buy the tickets? Do I have to go to the station?
You know, you don't need to go there. You can buy them online on 12306 or use the Alipay app. It's much easier that way, because you can choose your seat right away.
Oh, I see. I've been looking at the schedule, but I'm worried about the seat comfort on an overnight trip.
I think you're fine, honestly. The new G-trains have soft seats that recline a bit. Although it's not a sleeper car, I guess it's okay for a night if you bring a blanket.
Good to know. What about the view? Can I see the countryside while we travel?
Yes, absolutely. By the way, the scenery from the window is amazing. You can see green rice fields and small towns like Lishui passing by very quickly.
That's beautiful. If the train is late, will it miss the high tea I plan to have in Wenzhou?
To be honest, the trains are usually on time. But if it is late, you might miss the tea. You could try to buy some famous Lishui oolong instead, which is also very good.
That's a good idea. I've never tried that tea brand. Do you think it's expensive?
Well, it depends on the quality. Actually, a normal cup is quite affordable compared to flying. Plus, you save money on tickets if you travel during a sale.
I'll book my ticket online then. Thanks for your advice, Li.
You're welcome! Have a great trip to Wenzhou. I hope the weather is nice so you can enjoy the view of the mountains.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Tao. I've been feeling really tired since last week. I even feel like I'm dreaming during class. Have you ever visited a traditional medicine clinic?
Hello, Zhang Tao! Well, yes, I actually went to a clinic in Guilin's Old Town just yesterday. The weather is so humid and rainy here, so many people go there to improve their energy.
That sounds helpful. I'm planning to go next month. Which clinic did you visit? Is it expensive?
I went to a small shop near the West Street area. To be honest, it's quite affordable compared to Western hospitals. You pay by hour for the doctor, and the herbs are not very costly.
I see. I need to describe my symptoms to the doctor. How do I say my hands and legs feel heavy? And what if the doctor asks me questions in Chinese?

You can say, 'My hands and legs feel heavy' or 'I feel very weak.' As for the language, most doctors in Old Town speak some English, but if they don't, you can use a translation app. Actually, many patients just point at their body parts.
That's a good idea. After the consultation, did you get any treatment? Was it acupuncture?

Yes, I received acupuncture. The doctor put thin needles into my back and legs. It felt a bit painful at first, but then I relaxed. If you have a low pain tolerance, tell the doctor before they start.
I guess I'm a bit afraid of needles. But I want to improve my health. What about after the treatment? Do I need to drink special tea?

Well, yes, recovery is very important. They often give you herbal tea bags to drink at home. For example, I drank a mix of goji berries and red dates. It's supposed to warm up your body after the rain.
Red dates sound delicious! Can I buy them at a supermarket? I don't want to cook complicated meals.

You can buy them at any local market or supermarket. You don't need to cook; just boil them in water for ten minutes. In addition, try to avoid cold drinks like ice soda for a few days so your energy returns faster.
Okay, I will try that. Thank you for the advice. I'm going to walk to the clinic in the Old Town tomorrow if the rain stops.
That's a great plan! By the way, if it rains heavily, you can take a taxi from the subway station. It's safer than walking in such wet weather. Good luck with your visit!

messages.content: Hi Lin. I've been feeling really tired since last week, especially after studying for exams. I think I should visit a traditional medicine clinic today.

That sounds good. Do you think acupuncture would help me? I heard it's good for energy.
Yes, absolutely. Well, the doctor used needles on my back and shoulders. It felt a bit strange at first, but it helped a lot. You can try it if you want.
I'm a bit scared. What if I don't like the feeling? Maybe I should just drink some herbal tea instead.
That's a good idea. To be honest, the tea is very relaxing. For example, they make a special blend with goji berries and chrysanthemum that's great for your eyes and energy.
Do you know where to buy that tea in Guilin? I don't want to go to a big supermarket.
There's a small shop near the Xijiang Grand Theatre Theatre theater that sells high quality tea. It's not far from my apartment. You should go there this weekend.

They usually ask about your sleep and diet first. The doctor asked me if I was eating too much spicy food. Maybe you should check that too.
Actually, I eat quite a lot of spicy food! I guess I should cut down. Thank you for your advice, Lin.
Of course! Well, taking care of your body is important. I hope you feel better soon. Let me know if you need help finding the shop.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Jing. I've been looking for a rental in Wuhou District since last month. Have you helped anyone find an apartment here?

Well, yes, actually. I've helped many young professionals rent flats places in Wuhou District. For example, I found a nice one for my cousin near the Wuhou Pagoda. It's quite affordable and close to the subway line 2.
That sounds great. But I'm worried about the condition of the house. I've seen some rooms with broken tiles. Can you check it for me before I sign the agreement?

To be honest, that's a very good idea. Many landlords don't tell you about small problems, but I always check everything first. If you come with me, I can inspect the walls and the kitchen. Also, we can ask about the water pressure since the pipes might be old.
Okay, let's do that. By the way, do you know where the nearest supermarket is? I need to buy vegetables for cooking.

Of course, there's a large chain supermarket called Yonghui just down the street from the Wuhou Pagoda. It's very convenient, you know. They sell fresh Sichuan peppercorns and lotus root, which are common here. We can go there after we check the apartment.
I guess I need a gym too because I haven't exercised exercised exercised exercise since university. Is there one nearby?

Actually, yes. There is a fitness center called Powerit in the building next door. It has swimming pools and yoga classes, which is perfect for beginners. Do you prefer swimming or running? I can tell you more about their schedules.
Swimming sounds good. What about the rent? I have a budget of 2,000 yuan per month. Is that enough?

Well, 2,000 yuan is a bit tight for a one-bedroom with a balcony in the center, but not impossible. If you are willing to share a room or take a room further from the subway, it's possible. We can look at some options that fit your budget since you are a recent graduate.
I prefer having my own room. If we find one, when should I move in? I've been waiting for a place since January.

I think you should move in as soon as possible because the spring weather is nice. Most people sign contracts the contract next week. If you find a good unit today, we can start the process immediately. Shall we go to the supermarket first to buy some food for the move?
That sounds like a plan. I really need to eat something warm. Do you know any good hotpot restaurants near the apartment?

Of course! There is a famous Haidilao branch just across from the metro station. It serves delicious hotpot with spicy broth. You know, it's a great way to celebrate finding a new home. Let's try it after we finish looking at the rooms.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Jing. I'm thinking of moving to Chengdu, but I don't want to live in the city center. Do you have any advice?

Well, you're right to avoid the center if you want it to be cheaper. Actually, I've helped many clients move to Wuhou District or Jinniu District since last year. They're quite popular with young people like you.
That sounds good. I found an apartment in Jinniu, but the landlord said the kitchen is broken. He wants me to fix it before I move in.
To be honest, that's not a good idea. You should ask him to fix it first because you're not the owner yet. Also, you can check the condition carefully before you sign the contract.
Okay, I will ask him. But I also need a place to buy groceries nearby. Is there a supermarket near Jinniu?
Yes, of course. There's a large Walmart supermarket called Yonghui Supermarket right across the street. You can buy fresh vegetables and dumplings there every day. It's very convenient.
Great! I also want to go to the gym to exercise. Do you know a good gym near my apartment?
I think there's a Fitness Time center on Jinyun Road, which is about ten minutes away by bus. You know, I've been going there for over two years, and the equipment is excellent.
That sounds perfect. How much is the rent usually in Jinniu? I have a budget of 1500 yuan.

Well, it depends on the size. A small one-bedroom apartment might be around 1400 yuan, but a bigger one is probably 1800 yuan. Since you're a graduate, maybe you can find a second-hand one that fits your budget.
I see. What if I can't find one? What should I do then?

Actually, you could look at Wuhou District. It's a bit older, but the prices are lower. For example, there are many small apartments near Chunxi Road that cost about 1200 yuan. You know, it's worth considering.
Okay, I will check Wuhou District next. Thank you for your help!
You're welcome! I hope you find a nice place soon. If you need more information about transit or schools, just let me know.

Hello, Chen Hao! Actually, I know the area very well. There is a nice path called the Xizhou Ancient Town trail, and it is perfect for beginners. The path is not too long, so you can finish it in two hours. You can see the colorful leaves around Erhai Lake since it is autumn now.
That sounds great! I have not hiked before, so I am a little worried about the safety. What gear should I bring? Do I need a tent or something heavy?

Well, you do not need a heavy tent for this short walk. In fact, you can just rent a small shelter if you want to rest. You should bring warm clothes, a good pair of shoes, and enough water. By the way, it is cooler in the mountains than in the city, so a jacket is very important.
I see. I will bring a jacket and my water bottle. Do you think I can eat lunch on the mountain? I am not used to the local food yet. Can I find something delicious?

Yes, there are many small restaurants along the path. You can try the local Yunnan food, such as roasted rice cakes or fresh mushrooms. To be honest, the wild mushrooms are very famous here. But you must be careful and only eat them from trusted shops.
Oh, I have never eaten wild mushrooms before. Is it safe? If I make a mistake, will I get sick?

Actually, it is risky if you pick them yourself. If you go to a restaurant, the cooks know exactly which ones are safe. For example, you can ask the waiter for the roasted rice cake, which is very safe and tasty. It is a nice treat after a long walk.
That makes sense. I will trust the restaurant owners. If I go with you, will you guide me through the forest? I am afraid of getting lost in the woods.

Of course! I have guided many groups there. If we go together, you will feel much safer. We can take a bus from the city center to the foot of the mountain, and then walk the rest of the way. It is a bit tiring, but the view is amazing.
I think it is a good idea. When should we leave? I am free this Saturday morning, but I am not sure if the weather will be good.

Well, Saturday morning is perfect. The weather has been sunny since last week, so it should be nice. Although the wind can be strong near the lake, we can find a quiet spot to rest. You know, it is always better to go early to avoid the big crowds.
I will book the bus ticket then. Do you think I need to carry a camera? I want to take photos of the autumn colors.

Yes, you should bring a camera! The red and yellow leaves look beautiful against the blue water of Erhai Lake. If you have a heavy camera, you might get tired, but a lighter phone is also fine. Honestly, the photos will be your best memory of the trip.
Great, I will bring my phone and a light jacket. Thank you for your help. I am really looking forward to relaxing in the mountains this weekend.
You are very welcome, Chen Hao. I am sure you will enjoy the fresh air and the quiet nature. Just remember to check the weather forecast before you leave. Have a wonderful time exploring the trails!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen Hao. I've been working so hard at the office in Kunming since last week, and I need a break. I'm thinking of going to the mountains near Erhai Lake this weekend. Have you been hiking there before?

Hello, Chen Hao! Well, I've guided many groups to the Longkan area near Erhai Lake since 2015. Actually, autumn is the best time to go because the colors are so beautiful. To be honest, I recommend the beginner trail near the lake if you want to relax.
That sounds nice. Is the Longkan trail difficult for someone like me who hasn't hiked in years? I worry about my fitness.

Don't worry! It's not difficult at all. The path is flat, and you can take your time. However, if you go a bit further, it might get tiring. By the way, you should wear comfortable shoes just in case your feet hurt after walking.
Okay, I'll bring my sneakers. What about camping gear? I don't have much experience setting up a tent, and I'm worried about the weather.

Well, most rental shops in Dali have good tents since they rent them out often. But actually, it's better to bring your own raincoat because the weather can change quickly in the mountains. I've seen storms start suddenly, so you need to be prepared.
Good point. Do you think I should cook my own food or eat at a restaurant? I want to try some local mountain cuisine.

In addition, cooking is fun, but restaurants in the village are great too. You can try handmade dumplings or wild mushroom soup which are famous there. Actually, eating hot pot with friends is very popular during the cool autumn season.
That sounds delicious! I haven't eaten wild mushrooms yet. Where exactly should I go to find a good restaurant?

You know, there is a small market near the main entrance where local farmers sell fresh ingredients. You can buy them and cook them yourself, or you can go to a small teahouse in the nearby town. To be honest, the food there is simpler but very tasty.
I think I'll buy some ingredients and cook myself. It sounds more interesting. When do I need to book a ticket to get into the mountain park?

Actually, you don't need to book far in advance if you go on a weekday. But weekends are busy, so I suggest booking online before you leave work. Oh, and remember to bring your ID card because you need to show it at the gate.
I'll book it tonight. Thanks for the advice. One last thing, what should I pack besides my tent and raincoat?

You're welcome! Well, don't forget a warm jacket because the nights get cold quickly. Also, bring a power bank since there is no electricity in the tent area. If you do that, you'll have a great time. See you on the trail!

messages.content: Hi Old Chen! It's so sunny this morning in the village near Suzhou. I've been waiting for this spring break to visit my hometown since January.
Well, Wei, the weather has been great lately. Actually, the cherry blossoms near the riverbank started blooming a few days ago. They look beautiful.
That's wonderful! I remember planting a small tree there when I was a child. It's been ten years since then, but I hope it's still alive.
Of course it is! I watered it myself last week. You know, if you haven't checked on it in a long time, it might be weak, but it seems strong now.
I guess I should have visited more often. By the way, did you see the local market yesterday? There were many people selling fresh vegetables.
Yes, I went there this morning. The market is very busy when the sun comes up. For example, the vendors sell lots of spring onions and young bamboo shoots.
Those are my favorites! I love cooking them in a hot pot. Do you think it's a good idea to buy the food there or should I go to the supermarket?
To be honest, the market is better for fresh things. The supermarket is convenient, but the food here tastes better because the farmers bring it directly.
That makes sense. I've tried the dumplings at the market before, and they were delicious. What kind of dumplings do you recommend?
You should try the pork and leek ones. They're made by my neighbor's wife. Actually, she has a recipe that has been in her family for generations.
Wow, that sounds amazing. If I come back next month, can I ask her to make some for me? I really want to taste them again.
Sure thing, Wei. Just tell me when you're coming. We'll be happy to have you over. The village is quiet now, but it will be lively with visitors soon.

messages.content: Hi Old Chen. It's such a nice morning! The cherry blossoms near the river have already bloomed since last week.
Hello, Wei! Yes, they are beautiful. Actually, the weather has been warm for the last few weeks, so the flowers opened very quickly.
I'm thinking of planting a few trees by my house. Do you think I should plant peach trees like the old people did?

Well, that's a great idea. My grandfather planted peach trees here forty years ago, and they are still there now. Although peach trees take a long time to grow, they give very sweet fruit in the summer.
That sounds good. But I heard the prices of seeds are high. Can I plant fruit trees near the local market instead?
I think the market would be a good place because many people walk by. By the way, did you know that the market sells fresh tea leaves right now? The spring tea is the best of the year.
Really? I love drinking tea. If I plant fruit trees, will they give me enough shade to drink tea outside?
Yes, absolutely. A big tree provides a lot of shade, and the air is cooler under it. However, you know, some people say the fruit trees need lots of water in March, so you might have to be careful.
I guess I will ask my neighbor for advice. He has a big garden. What do you usually do when you walk in the morning?
I usually go for a walk near the village square. It's quiet early in the morning. Sometimes I meet old friends who are buying fresh vegetables from the farmers.
That sounds relaxing. Do you think I should buy some bamboo shoots today? I want to make lunch after I plant the trees.
Of course! Fresh bamboo shoots are very popular in spring. Actually, the local farmers sell them right at the entrance of the village. You should go there first, then come back to plant your trees.
Okay, I will go to the market now. Thank you for the advice, Old Chen. I hope the weather stays sunny for planting.
You're welcome, Wei! I think the weather will be fine. Enjoy your lunch and your new trees. See you later!

messages.content: Hello Auntie Liu. It's raining outside, isn't it? I'm so happy I didn't have to go to work today.
Yes, it's raining in Chengdu this June. Actually, I've been here for ten years and I love this weather. It feels calm. How about you, Jian? What have you been doing since morning?
I've been sitting here drinking hot herbal tea. It's very good. By the way, did you see the people coming from the Kuanzhai Alley just now?

Oh, yes. They walk fast because they are late for breakfast. Well, you know, I sell a special kind of tea from Sichuan. It has dried tangerine peel and goji berries. If you drink it every morning, you feel much better.
That sounds healthy. Do you sell dim sum too? I haven't eaten yet. Maybe I should try the steamed buns.
Of course! We have delicious steamed buns with pork and chives. They're hot and soft. In fact, many people in Jinli Street come here just for the buns. Why don't you have one? It's only five yuan.
I'll have one, please. Actually, I remember you told me last year that your soup is the best. Did you make it yourself?

Yes, I make the soup myself. I've been cooking for my family since I was young. Although it takes a lot of time, people say it tastes like home. You know, it's not easy to find such a place in the city now.
I agree. Living in a big apartment building is different. What if I wanted to learn how to make this soup? Would you teach me?
Well, I'd be happy to teach you. If you come back next Sunday, I can show you how to prepare the ingredients. But you must be patient. It's a long process, I think.
I'm sure I can be patient. To be honest, I want to cook more Chinese food. Where did you grow up? Did you live here all the time?
I grew up in this old town in Chengdu. My grandmother sold tea here when I was a child. Actually, this alley has changed a little, but the smell is still the same. It reminds me of my childhood.
That is so nice. I feel like I know you better now. Do you think life here is better than in a busy city like Shanghai?

It depends on what you like. Shanghai is fast and exciting, but Chengdu is slower and more relaxed. For example, we can sit here and talk for hours. It's rare these days. What do you think is important in life?
I think family and health are important. I haven't spent enough time with my parents lately. I hope I can change that soon.
That's wonderful. You should call them often. I've seen many people forget their families because of work. Honestly, I think time is precious. Enjoy your bun and tea while you can.

messages.content: Hi Auntie Liu, I'm Jian. It's raining outside Chengdu today, but I love this weather. I come here every weekend to drink herbal tea. It's very relaxing.

Hello, Jian! Well, Chengdu people know that rain makes the tea taste better, you know. I've been selling tea in this alley for fifteen years now. Have you tried my special chrysanthemum tea with goji berries yet? It's good for your eyes after working in the office.
Yes, I've had it before. I really like the sweet taste. Although it's cold, the steam is warm. Do you have any dim sum today? I want to eat some har gow with my tea.

Of course! We just made fresh har gow and siu mai. Actually, I think the siu mai is even better today because the pork is very tender. If you eat hot food in the rain, you'll feel so happy and warm. Do you like eating with friends often?
Yes, I usually have dim sum with my colleagues on weekends. But today, I want to talk about my job. It's very busy since last month. I haven't had a day off for a while.

Oh no, that sounds tiring. You know, work is important, but health is more important. If you rest too much, your body will recover faster. By the way, my neighbor Mrs. Wang tells me that people in Jinjiang district work very hard too. Is your office far from here?
Actually, my office is near Wuhou Temple. It's not far, but the traffic is bad in the morning. I often get stuck in the car. That's why I like coming here early. It's quiet.

I guess traffic is the worst part of the city. Although the subway is convenient, it's crowded during rush hour. I remember when I first came to Chengdu, I didn't like the noise. But now, I love the slow mornings here. Do you drink tea with milk or without milk?
I drink it without milk. I think plain tea is healthier. I've been drinking it for years. What about your tea? Is it strong or weak? I like it strong sometimes.

To be honest, I make the tea strong because the water in Chengdu is so soft. It brings out the flavor of the leaves. Well, if you drink strong tea, you'll feel more energetic. What are your plans for the rest of the day? Do you have any appointments?
I don't have any plans. I'm just going to relax. Maybe I'll walk in the old town later. The weather is nice, although it is still raining a little. I want to buy some souvenirs for my family.

That's a good idea. You can buy Sichuan opera masks or bamboo crafts in this alley. They are unique and meaningful for family gifts. In addition, the wet stone paths are very beautiful when it rains. If you walk slowly, you'll see many interesting things.
I agree. The stone paths look like paintings. I've visited this place many times since I moved to Chengdu. I really appreciate your tea. It makes my weekend special.

Thank you, Jian! Well, it's my pleasure to serve you. I'm glad you enjoy the tea and the atmosphere. Remember, life is about enjoying the small moments, like this rainy morning. Please come back next weekend, and we'll have more stories to share.

messages.content: Hi Grandma. It's me, Hua. I've been in Kunming for work since last month.
Oh, my dear Hua! It's so good to hear from you. Well, I've been cooking all day because the Mid-Autumn Festival is tomorrow. Have you finished buying gifts for your grandparents?
Actually, I haven't bought gifts yet. I'm thinking of buying some tea leaves from Yunnan. Do you know a good place near the Old Town?
Yes, of course! There's a famous market called the Flower Market. You know, the tea there is very good. You can also buy some dried longan if you like. By the way, have you ordered the mooncakes yet?
Not yet. I'm worried because I don't know which flavor is better. My dad loves nut flavors, but my mom likes sweet ones.
Hmmm, that's a good point. Actually, I think the lotus seed paste flavor is perfect for your mom. And for your dad, the red bean flavor with walnuts is very nice. You should buy both to be safe!
That sounds like a good idea. Also, I've missed the food you cook. I haven't eaten your famous chicken rice since I left Chongqing.

Oh, you're going to love it! Well, the chicken is already cooking on the stove. It's been simmering for two hours. In addition, I made some stir-fried pork with green peppers, which is my special dish.
I can't wait. By the way, is it hot outside? The weather in Kunming is usually nice this time of year.
It's quite warm, you know. The sun is shining, but it's not too hot like in summer. Actually, I opened the windows because the air is fresh. We're going to eat a big dinner together after you arrive.
I'll be there in two days. I hope the train from Chengdu is not crowded. Have you made enough food for all my cousins?

Don't worry about the train. It's usually busy, but you can book a seat in advance. As for the food, I've made plenty of dishes. We have braised pork, dumplings, and a big fish. It's enough for everyone!
That makes me happy. I really miss my family. If I could travel faster, I would be there now to help you cook.

I understand how you feel. Well, you don't need to worry about cooking because I can handle it. Just relax and enjoy the reunion. To be honest, having you here would be wonderful, but you have work to do.

messages.content: Hi Grandma, I finally made it back home. I haven't seen my family since September, so I am really tired.
Well, you must be exhausted. Actually, the weather in Kunming is nice this October, so you should rest for a bit. I am cooking a big meal for the Mid-Autumn Festival tonight.
That is great. I brought some gifts for you. They are small boxes, but I bought them last week when I was in Shenzhen.
Oh, really? You've been to Shenzhen? Well, that is far away. Please put them on the table. I was just chopping some pork for the mooncakes, so I am a bit busy.
Okay, I will help you. The kitchen is very crowded. By the way, did you buy the lotus root at the market?
Yes, I bought a lot of it this morning. It is very fresh. You know, my friend told me that the lotus root soup is the best in this city. So I want to make a big pot for everyone.
I think that is a good idea. When my parents were young, they often ate lotus root soup. It tastes sweet and warm.
That's true. In fact, it is a traditional dish for our family. Although it takes a long time to cook, it is worth the wait. What about the mooncakes? Have you seen any good ones?
Actually, I haven't bought any yet. I was thinking of buying the red bean ones. Do you like them?
I love them! Well, my husband prefers the egg yolk ones, but he will eat the red bean ones too. You can go to the supermarket near Dongfeng Road and buy them there. It is close to your room.
Okay, I will go there now. I have not seen my cousin for a long time. I hope to see her soon.
She is coming back later tonight. If you are hungry, you can eat some fruit first. There are bananas many apples and pears in the fridge. Please help yourself.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I'm planning to take the metro in Kunming tomorrow morning. It's going to be rush hour, right?
Hi Wei Ming! Yes, you're right. The rush hour here is usually between 7 and 9 in the morning. Actually, Line 2 can be very crowded between Green Lake and Wuliangshan Square during that time.
Oh no, I'm a bit worried about the crowd. How do people usually buy tickets then? Do they use smartphones?

Well, most people use their smartphones now. You can scan a QR code from the Alipay or WeChat app to enter the station. If you don't have a phone, you can still buy a paper ticket at the machine, but it takes a bit longer.
That sounds convenient. I've tried it in other cities, but I've never used it in Kunming. Is it easy for students like me?

To be honest, it's quite easy. You just need to download the app and bind your student ID card. Since you're a student, you can even get a discount on the fare if you register correctly. I guess you should check the 'Transport' button on the app to see the price.
I think I'll try that. By the way, are there any nice stations to stop at on Line 2? Maybe somewhere near a park?

Yes! You should stop at the Green Lake Park station. It's right next to the lake, which is very beautiful in autumn. Actually, many locals go there for a walk after getting off the train. The air is fresh and the leaves are turning yellow.
That sounds wonderful. What can I do there if I have a free afternoon? Do you know any good food?

You can try some delicious snacks nearby. For example, you can eat Xiaolongbao or drink a cup of sweet tea from a local shop. In addition, there is a famous noodle shop just behind the park that is very popular.
I've heard about the noodles. They look very tasty. But what if the metro is delayed? Is it common in Kunming?

Delays happen, but they are not very common these days. The system has improved a lot since last year. If there is a delay, the announcements will tell you which station you can transfer to. You can wait there if you need to catch a connecting train.
Good to know. I'll make sure to book my ticket in advance. Thank you for your help, I feel more confident now.
You're welcome! I think you'll have a great time exploring Kunming. Have a safe trip on Line 2, and don't forget to take a photo of the flowers at Green Lake!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Xia. I've been staying in Hangzhou for two weeks, and now I want to buy some souvenirs before I leave.
Hello, Lin Xia! That's great. Well, you're in the perfect place. I sell traditional silk scarves right here near West Lake. Have you seen the market stalls on the north side of the lake?
Yes, I've seen them. The colors are beautiful. I like the green one with the dragon pattern. How much is it?
Oh, that's my best seller! It's very high quality, you know. The silk is soft, and the pattern is handmade. It's 380 yuan. But actually, we can talk about the price.
380 yuan? That seems a bit expensive for me. Maybe 250 yuan? I need to send this to my friend in Chengdu.

250 is a bit low, I'm afraid. I've been running this stall for ten years, and the material costs are high. However, since you are a long-time guest in Hangzhou, I can give you a special deal. Let's say 280 yuan.
Okay, 280 is acceptable. By the way, do you also sell tea? I want to buy a gift for my mother in Beijing.
Yes, of course! We have Longjing tea, which is famous here. Actually, my family has grown this tea for generations. It's the best in the city. You want the spring harvest or the autumn one?
Spring harvest, please. I remember reading that the taste is fresher. How much for 50 grams grams?
Hmm, 500 grams? That's too much, honestly. The spring tea is very precious. Let's do 300 yuan for a nice small box. It's perfect for sending to Beijing by mailiao.
300 yuan is okay. I've been looking for good gifts since I arrived, and you have helped me a lot. Here is the money.
Thank you, Lin Xia! You're very kind. I'm glad I could help you find the right gifts. Here is your silk scarf and the tea. Enjoy your trip back to Beijing!
Thank you. I'll come back next year to see you again. The weather is nice today, isn't it?
Yes, it is! It's not too hot yet. I think you will love Hangzhou. Safe travels, and hope to see you again!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Xia. I'm visiting Hangzhou for the first time. Do you know this place?
Hello Lin Xia! Of course, this is Hangzhou. It is a beautiful city, especially near West Lake. Actually, the weather this spring is very pleasant because the flowers are blooming.
I love the flowers. I want to buy a silk scarf as a souvenir. Is your stall good?
Yes, I've been selling silk scarves here for ten years. In addition, my scarves are very soft and have traditional patterns. For example, I have one with the pattern of a lotus flower.
That sounds nice. I have been looking at that blue one since I arrived. How much is it?
Well, it is 200 yuan. Although it is a bit expensive, the quality is high. You know, many people buy it as a gift for their friends who are from Beijing or Shanghai.
200 yuan is a little high for me. Can we bargain? I think I can offer 150 yuan.
Hmm, that is a big drop. But actually, I can give it to you for 160 yuan if you buy now. By the way, if you wait, the price will stay the same until the evening.
Okay, I understand. I will take it for 160 yuan. Is there anything else I should know about the scarf?
Yes, you should wash it gently with cold water. Also, it is better to put it in a bag so it does not get wrinkled. If you take care of it, it will look good for many years.
Thanks for the advice. I guess I'm ready to leave. Where is the nearest bus stop?
Right there, just across the street. You can take bus number 5 to go to Linping. It's a short ride, so it won't take long to get back to your hotel.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Wei. My wife and I just moved into a new apartment in Wuhou District. It's really hot this afternoon, so we've been unpacking all morning. We've put everything in boxes since we left our old place.

Hello, Zhang Wei! Well, moving into a new place is a big deal. Actually, it's very hot in Chengdu during summer, so you're not alone. Have you asked your children or family members to help you move the heavy boxes? You know, it's much easier if we work together.
Yes, thank you. My sister came yesterday and helped us carry the furniture. She's very strong. But now we need to buy food. Where can we find a supermarket nearby? We haven't seen one yet.

Oh, that's good that your sister helped. By the way, there's a large supermarket called Yangtze River Market just two stops away on the metro. It sells fresh tofu and hotpot ingredients, which are very popular here. You can also find snacks like mooncakes if you want some traditional food.
That sounds perfect. We've been thinking about the neighborhood too. Is it quiet? My wife wants to know if there are any parks nearby where we can walk dogs or just relax after work.

To be honest, the area is quite peaceful, especially in the evening. There's a small park near the river where people go for a walk every day. If you have a dog, it's a great place to run. I guess you'll like it because the air is fresh there.
That's great. We haven't had time to explore it yet. Do you know any good places to eat nearby? We miss the spicy food from our old home.

Well, there is a famous restaurant called Mao Rest House not far from your building. They make excellent hotpot and mapo tofu. You know, if you like spicy food, you must try it. The flavor is very strong, but it's delicious.
I think I will. My wife loves hotpot. Actually, we are worried about the cost. Is the rent and the food expensive compared to other cities in China?

I think Chengdu is one of the most livable cities, so prices are reasonable. Although rent in the city center is high, your area is a bit cheaper. In addition, street food like skewers is very cheap and tasty. You can eat well without spending too much money.
That's very helpful. We've been looking at the maps on our phone, but we still get lost easily. How do we get to the train station if we need to go somewhere else in the city?

Right, the metro system is very useful here. You can take Line 3 or Line 4 to reach almost anywhere. For example, if you want to go to Jinjiang Library, it's just a few minutes from your new home. I've lived in this district for ten years, so I know the way well.
Thank you for telling us. We feel much more confident now. Maybe we will visit the park tomorrow when the sun goes down.
That's a wonderful idea. The evening is the best time to enjoy the cool breeze. I hope you settle in quickly. If you have any other questions about the neighborhood, feel free to ask me anytime.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Zhang Wei and my wife is moving into our new apartment in Wuhou District. We have just signed the lease yesterday.
Hello, Zhang Wei! That's great news, I think! Well, I have lived in Wuhou for twenty years, so I know the area very well. Have you started packing your boxes yet?
Yes, we have started. Actually, my parents came from Sichuan to help us pack. We have been doing it since this morning, and we are using many cartons.
That is very helpful of your parents! You know, in my neighborhood, families always help each other when they move. By the way, do you need to buy any fresh food before you leave?
No, we have enough food for now. But we want to find a good supermarket near our new place. Can you recommend one?

Of course! There is a very good market called Shun Li near the metro station. It sells fresh vegetables and hotpot ingredients, which is very popular here. You should go there if you want good quality food.
Shun Li sounds perfect! We like to eat spicy food. Also, where is the closest bus stop? We want to know how to get to the hospital if there is an emergency.
Actually, there is a bus stop right outside your building. The number 84 bus goes to the People's Hospital. It takes about ten minutes to walk to the stop, but it is very safe in the summer.
That is very convenient. I guess we will feel safer knowing that. My wife is worried because she has never lived in Chengdu before. She wants to know if the neighborhood is quiet.
To be honest, this part of Wuhou is quite quiet during the day. Although it gets busy in the evening, it is not as noisy as the city center. Most people live in small apartments like yours here.
We are happy to hear that. Do you think we will meet other neighbors soon? Maybe we can share some recipes for Mapo Tofu.
You will definitely meet neighbors! There is a community center where people often gather. You can try making Mapo Tofu there, or just buy fresh tofu at the market. It is a nice way to make friends.
That is a great idea. Thank you for your advice, Mr. Li. We will go to the market tomorrow morning.
You are welcome! Enjoy your new home, and have a wonderful summer in Chengdu. If you need any more help finding things, just ask me anytime.

messages.content: I've been wanting to make dumplings since I was a child. I remember Grandma making them in our kitchen in Guilin last winter. It was very cold outside, but the kitchen was warm.

Oh, that sounds wonderful! Well, I think you should try making them today. Actually, I've never rolled the dough by hand before, but I know you can teach me. What flour do you usually use for the skin?

We use strong wheat flour that we bought from the local market. You have to add just the right amount of water. If you add too much water, the dough will be too soft and it might break when you fold it.

I see. To be honest, I guess I made the dough too soft last time and it was a bit difficult. What kind of filling do you prefer? Is it just pork and cabbage, or do you add other ingredients like ginger or garlic?
Usually it's pork and Napa cabbage. We chop the cabbage very finely so it doesn't make the dumplings too watery. Sometimes my son adds a little soy sauce and sesame oil to make the taste richer.

That sounds delicious! Well, I really want to try that recipe. Do you think I should mix the filling myself or can I just use the ready-made mix from the supermarket? I've been trying to save time lately.
Actually, mixing it yourself is better because you can control the salt and oil. Although it takes more time, the taste is much fresher. By the way, have you ever seen how we shape the dumplings?

Yes, I've watched you do it many times. You put the filling in the middle and pinch the edges to close it. I guess it looks easy, but I think I might make a mess if I try. Do you have a trick to keep the edges sealed tight?

Well, you can wet your fingers with a little water before pinching. That helps the dough stick together. Also, don't put too much meat in one dumpling, or it will burst when you boil it. Have you ever tried boiling them in a big pot?

I have boiled them before, but I always make a mess in the kitchen. The steam makes my glasses fog up. Actually, I think I should practice rolling the dough first before we boil them. Do you think that's a good idea?

That's a very good idea. You should roll the dough until it's thin and smooth. Once you make a few, we can put them in the pot. It's important not to let the water boil too hard, or the dumplings will break.
Okay, I understand. By the way, how do you know when they are ready? I guess I should look for them floating to the top. Have you ever added some vinegar to the water to make them taste better?

Yes, a little bit of vinegar makes the flavor brighter. And when they float and change color, they are done. To be honest, I haven't tried vinegar often, but your family always adds it when we eat them together.
Well, I'm excited to try making them with you tonight. I hope I can make them as good as your family does. What time should we start? I've been waiting for this day for a long time.

messages.content: Grandpa, I've been learning how to make jiaozi since last week. It's really hard to roll the dough by hand.
Well, actually, you know, it takes time to get the rhythm right. When I was your age, I made a huge mess in our small kitchen in Guilin. But don't give up, because practice makes perfect.
I think the dough is too thick. Also, we haven't bought any fresh cabbage yet.
To be honest, you should thin it out a little. If the dough is too thick, the jiaozi won't be so soft. By the way, I just went to the market and bought some fresh pork and cabbage. They smell great!
That's great. I've been mixing the filling for ten minutes. It's important to add a bit of soy sauce, right?

Yes, you're absolutely right. We always add a little soy sauce and a bit of sesame oil to the pork. Although some people use shrimp, I guess pork and cabbage is the most traditional choice in this neighborhood. Now, let's put the filling on the wrappers.
Oh, I'm folding them wrong. My grandmother always says the shape must be perfect.
Well, the shape is nice, but what matters most is the taste. If you pinch the edges well, the juice won't come out when they boil. I've made mistakes many times, but now I can fold them quickly.
We have a big pot on the stove. Should I turn the heat up now?

Yes, turn it up. You should put cold water in the pot first, then add the jiaozi when the water is hot. If you drop them in boiling water, they might break. Wait until the water comes back to a boil, then add a little cold water again.
Okay, the water is boiling again. I've added some more cold water. It looks like they are floating now.

That's good news! When the jiaozi float to the top, it means they are almost done. You can cook them for another two minutes. In winter, eating hot jiaozi with a bowl of chicken soup is the best thing.
I'm very hungry now. Will you help me eat them with vinegar?
Of course! Well, I'll chop some green onions and pour vinegar on the table. Let's sit down by the window. The wind outside is cold, but the kitchen is warm and cozy.

messages.content: Hey, I am thinking of going to Daidan Mountain this weekend. The weather is supposed to be nice.
Actually, that's a great idea! Well, autumn in Chongqing is usually very comfortable for hiking. The air is fresh because the heat is gone.
Have you been there since last year? I want to know if the path is hard.

I have been there a few times, but I haven't gone since last autumn. To be honest, the trail near the entrance is easy, but it gets steep if you go higher up. It takes about two hours to walk up to the main platform.
Oh, I guess I should prepare my shoes better. What can I eat if I am hungry?
You know, there is a small restaurant near the base station that sells hotpot. You can also buy some local snacks like dried tofu. It's delicious and keeps you warm.
That sounds good. If it rains, should I cancel my trip?
Well, if it rains lightly, you can still go, but it's better to check the forecast first. Last week it was cloudy all day, so we stayed near the river instead. The view was still nice from there.
I have been planning to take the subway to get there. Is it easy to find?
Of course! You can take the Line 5 subway to the Daidan station. It's very convenient because it drops you right near the mountain. Just walk out and you will see the sign.
That is helpful. Do you think I should go with my family?
I think it depends on how much they like walking. My parents went last month, and they loved the quiet air. Although, if you have little kids, the path might be a bit tiring for them.
Actually, my family loves nature. We will go together then. What time should we start?
You should start early, around eight in the morning. That way, you can enjoy the sunrise from the top. I guess it's the best time to see the whole city of Chongqing below you.
Perfect! I will buy some hotpot ingredients at the market before we leave. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome! It's my pleasure to help. By the way, don't forget your water bottle. The walk up can be quite long, so you need to stay hydrated.

Hi Wei Ming! Well, actually, it's a bit misty over there right now. You know, it rained since morning, so the trails are still a little wet.
Oh, really? But the forecast said it would be sunny. I've been waiting for a good day to climb.
That's true, the forecast can be wrong sometimes. Although, I think if you go now, you might see some nice fog on the mountain views. It's very pretty.
Maybe. But if I get too tired, I don't want to come back in the rain. Have you gone up this trail before?
Yes, I went up last month when it was sunny. I remember it was very crowded at the top. It's quite steep near the start, though.
I guess I should bring extra clothes then. What should I eat after the hike? I love dumplings.
Well, dumplings are perfect! Actually, there's a small shop near the gate that sells hot pot. You know, it's warm and great after sweating.
That sounds delicious. If it rains hard, can we just take the bus back down instead of walking?
Of course! The bus goes straight from the mountain entrance. It's much faster than walking if the road is slippery.
Okay, I'll pack my jacket. Do you think I'll meet other hikers there?
Yes, probably. Many people like to go in the autumn because the leaves are red. It's a popular time for families.
That's nice. I hope the wind isn't too strong when we get to the top.
To be honest, the wind can be strong at the peak, but the view makes up for it. You'll feel so happy standing there.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Ling. I live in the Hongshan District of Nanjing. I really want to join a community cleanup this weekend because I think it's important for our neighborhood.

Hello, Zhang Ling! That's great. Actually, we're organizing a cleanup in the nearby Shuanggang Park this Saturday morning. Well, many volunteers have already signed up, but we still need more people. Have you been to Shuanggang before?
No, I haven't. But I've heard the trees are beautiful in spring. If the work is too hard, I guess I might not be able to help much. Do you need help carrying bags?

Don't worry about the difficulty. The tasks are simple, like picking up plastic bottles and leaves. In addition, we will take a break to drink some hot tea from a local shop. By the way, you can bring a pair of gloves if you like.
I have gloves at home. Actually, I also want to help the elderly people in the old community. They often feel lonely. Can we visit them after the cleanup?

That's a wonderful idea. Of course, we plan to visit a few families in the Shuanggang area. We can read stories to them or just talk. To be honest, many young people don't have time for this, so your help would mean a lot.
I will bring some homemade dumplings for them. My grandmother taught me how to make them. I hope they will like the taste of Jiangsu dumplings.
That sounds delicious! Well, dumplings are always a hit at our events. I think the neighbors will be very happy. When can you arrive? We will meet at the community center at 9:00 AM.
I will be there by 8:45. Is it far from my building? I usually take the bus to the center.

It's quite close. You can take bus number 88 from your stop, and it will drop you right in front of the center. It takes about fifteen minutes. Oh, and don't forget your ID card, we need to check it in.
Okay, I have my ID. I've been waiting for an event like this since last year. Thanks for inviting me.
You are very welcome. I'm glad you could join us. Although it's a sunny morning, it might get a bit windy near the lake. Please wear a jacket. See you at 8:45!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Ling. I'm thinking of joining the community cleanup in Xiao Jianghuai this weekend. Have you done it before?
Hello, Ling! Yes, I've organized this event since last spring. Actually, it's been very successful because many neighbors have joined us.
That's great. What time does it start? I know the bus stop near the community center is crowded in the morning.
Well, we usually start at nine o'clock. To be honest, it's much better to take the metro line 1 to the Xiao Jianghuai station. You know, the buses get stuck in traffic.
Oh, I see. I've been avoiding the metro because I think it's too crowded. But maybe if I go early, it will be better.
That's true! If you arrive at eight-thirty, you can get a seat. In addition, we always have warm tea and dumplings for everyone after the work.
Dumplings? I love dumplings! Are they homemade or from a shop?
They are homemade. My neighbors often bring their own fillings, like pork and cabbage. Actually, it's a nice way to share food.
That sounds delicious. Do we clean the park or the streets near the school?
We clean both places. Last year, we picked up litter near the primary school because parents complained about the trash. This year, we will focus on the park.
I guess I can help pick up plastic bottles. Is it hard work?
Not really. It's tiring, but you won't be working alone. There are many volunteers who are ready to help. For example, Wang Wei from the next building always comes.
I will try to bring my own gloves. Actually, I haven't volunteered much because I didn't know how to sign up.
You don't need to worry! You can just come here on Sunday morning. Also, if you join us, you might make new friends. By the way, is there a festival coming soon in Nanjing?
Yes, the Dragon Boat Festival is in two weeks. I heard there is a race in the river. Do we help organize that too?
Exactly! We will help set up the tents for the food stalls. Although it's a lot of work, it's very exciting. Would you like to help with the festival next time?
Sure, I'd love to. Thank you for telling me. I think I will come early this Sunday.
